Entries.Title: TV5
Entries.Description: TV5 is a major Philippine television network offering a mix of local and international programming, including news, entertainment, and sports.

Entries.Title: A2Z (ABS-CBN)
Entries.Description: A2Z is a Philippine free-to-air blocktime broadcast television network based in Quezon City, with its studios located in Ortigas Center, Pasig. It serves as a flagship property of ZOE Broadcasting Network, the broadcast media arm of Jesus Is Lord Church Worldwide, in partnership with ABS-CBN Corporation as its main content provider through a blocktime agreement.

Entries.Title: Night
Entries.Description: Night has to trick the mother of the missing child into sleeping to save her soul.

Entries.Title: Moana 2
Entries.Description: After receiving an unexpected call from her wayfinding ancestors, Moana journeys alongside Maui and a new crew to the far seas of Oceania and into dangerous, long-lost waters for an adventure unlike anything she's ever faced.

Entries.Title: The Green Dinosaur
Entries.Description: When the world around him is mysteriously erased, a little green dinosaur named Diplodocus must travel through the pages of a comic book and adventure through time to bring color back to his land. Alongside a wizard and two scientists, Diplo’s plans go awry as he learns that there may be a dimension to his world that he never considered.

Entries.Title: SuperKlaus
Entries.Description: Santa Claus's wish comes true when he accidentally bumps his head and starts believing he's SuperKlaus. With the help of Billie and Leo his elf-xecutive assistant, SuperKlaus will take on a toy-obsessed businessman to save Christmas.

Entries.Title: Inside Out 2
Entries.Description: Teenager Riley's mind headquarters is undergoing a sudden demolition to make room for something entirely unexpected: new Emotions! Joy, Sadness, Anger, Fear and Disgust, who’ve long been running a successful operation by all accounts, aren’t sure how to feel when Anxiety shows up. And it looks like she’s not alone.

Entries.Title: Despicable Me 4
Entries.Description: Gru and Lucy and their girls—Margo, Edith and Agnes—welcome a new member to the Gru family, Gru Jr., who is intent on tormenting his dad. Gru also faces a new nemesis in Maxime Le Mal and his femme fatale girlfriend Valentina, forcing the family to go on the run.

Entries.Title: Mufasa: The Lion King
Entries.Description: Mufasa, a cub lost and alone, meets a sympathetic lion named Taka, the heir to a royal bloodline. The chance meeting sets in motion an expansive journey of a group of misfits searching for their destiny.

Entries.Title: The Girl Downstairs Extra: Promised Future
Entries.Description: Freshman Yuan Juntang applied to Minsong University in order to get closer to Zhu Zhu, whom he has had a crush on. At the university, he meets Li Shiya who used to be his idol, and takes a temporary absence from school.

Entries.Title: The Wild Robot
Entries.Description: After a shipwreck, an intelligent robot called Roz is stranded on an uninhabited island. To survive the harsh environment, Roz bonds with the island's animals and cares for an orphaned baby goose.

Entries.Title: Kung Fu Panda 4
Entries.Description: Po is gearing up to become the spiritual leader of his Valley of Peace, but also needs someone to take his place as Dragon Warrior. As such, he will train a new kung fu practitioner for the spot and will encounter a villain called the Chameleon who conjures villains from the past.

Entries.Title: Flow
Entries.Description: A solitary cat, displaced by a great flood, finds refuge on a boat with various species and must navigate the challenges of adapting to a transformed world together.

Entries.Title: The Bad Guys: Haunted Heist
Entries.Description: The crafty Bad Guys crew embarks on a high-stakes Halloween heist to swipe a priceless amulet from a spooky mansion. What could go wrong?

Entries.Title: Solo Leveling -ReAwakening-
Entries.Description: Over a decade after 'gates' connecting worlds appeared, awakening 'hunters' with superpowers, weakest hunter Sung Jinwoo encounters a double dungeon and accepts a mysterious quest, becoming the only one able to level up, changing his fate. A catch-up recap of the first season coupled with an exclusive sneak peek of the first two episodes of the highly anticipated second season in one momentous theatrical fan experience.

Entries.Title: The Garfield Movie
Entries.Description: Garfield, the world-famous, Monday-hating, lasagna-loving indoor cat, is about to have a wild outdoor adventure! After an unexpected reunion with his long-lost father – scruffy street cat Vic – Garfield and his canine friend Odie are forced from their perfectly pampered life into joining Vic in a hilarious, high-stakes heist.

Entries.Title: Strawberry Prince Movie: The Beginning - Strawberry School Festival!!!
Entries.Description: An anime movie based on the boy band Strawberry Prince.

Entries.Title: Miraculous World: London, At the Edge of Time
Entries.Description: To save the future from a terrible fate, Marinette becomes Chronobug and teams up with Bunnyx to defeat a mysterious opponent who travels through time. Who is this new supervillain, and why are they obsessed with exposing Marinette's secret superhero identity? Marinette's only hope is to defeat her new opponent to prevent the end of Ladybug and time itself!

Entries.Title: Transformers One
Entries.Description: The untold origin story of Optimus Prime and Megatron, better known as sworn enemies, but once were friends bonded like brothers who changed the fate of Cybertron forever.

Entries.Title: given the Movie: To the Sea
Entries.Description: Mafuyu doubts his place in the band, but a familiar face could be the spark that brings him back to the stage.

Entries.Title: Memoir of a Snail
Entries.Description: Forcibly separated from her twin brother when they are orphaned, a melancholic misfit learns how to find confidence within herself amid the clutter of misfortunes and everyday life.

Entries.Title: Panda Bear in Africa
Entries.Description: A young adventurous panda travels from China to Africa to rescue his best friend, Jielong the Dragon, who has been kidnapped. On his journey, he discovers a strange amazing new world of mountains, deserts and jungles.

Entries.Title: Angels Fallen: Warriors of Peace
Entries.Description: When an Iraq War veteran receives a calling from a higher power, he embarks on a mission to stop a fallen angel from raising an army of the dead to take over the world.

Entries.Title: Sonic the Hedgehog 3
Entries.Description: Sonic, Knuckles, and Tails reunite against a powerful new adversary, Shadow, a mysterious villain with powers unlike anything they have faced before. With their abilities outmatched in every way, Team Sonic must seek out an unlikely alliance in hopes of stopping Shadow and protecting the planet.

Entries.Title: Long Distance
Entries.Description: After crash-landing on an alien planet, an asteroid miner must contend with the challenges of his new surroundings, while making his way across the harsh terrain to the only other survivor – a woman who is trapped in her escape pod.

Entries.Title: The Twisters
Entries.Description: A deadly patchwork of destructive cyclones is on an apocalyptic path of convergence at a populated Midwest city center. There, the twisters will merge into one mega tornado that threatens to obliterate the cities for hundreds of miles around.

Entries.Title: Deadpool & Wolverine
Entries.Description: A listless Wade Wilson toils away in civilian life with his days as the morally flexible mercenary, Deadpool, behind him. But when his homeworld faces an existential threat, Wade must reluctantly suit-up again with an even more reluctant Wolverine.

Entries.Title: Crazy Lizard
Entries.Description: A young man climbs into the mountains to pick up a meteorite that has fallen there and is killed by something. The "thing" descends to the village and begins to eat the inhabitants one by one, terrorizing the entire island.

Entries.Title: Venom: The Last Dance
Entries.Description: Eddie and Venom are on the run. Hunted by both of their worlds and with the net closing in, the duo are forced into a devastating decision that will bring the curtains down on Venom and Eddie's last dance.

Entries.Title: First Shift
Entries.Description: NYPD veteran Mike and rookie Angela tackle a high-stakes day on New York's toughest streets, diving headfirst into a vortex of danger and action. Their adrenaline-fueled pursuits and unexpected threats unfold as they navigate perilous encounters. Amidst the chaos, intense challenges forge unbreakable bonds.

Entries.Title: Gladiator II
Entries.Description: Years after witnessing the death of the revered hero Maximus at the hands of his uncle, Lucius is forced to enter the Colosseum after his home is conquered by the tyrannical Emperors who now lead Rome with an iron fist. With rage in his heart and the future of the Empire at stake, Lucius must look to his past to find strength and honor to return the glory of Rome to its people.

Entries.Title: The Roundup: Punishment
Entries.Description: 'Monster Cop' Ma Seok-do investigates an illegal online gambling business led by a former STS Baek and an IT genius CEO Chang. Ma proposes an unexpected alliance to Jang and begins hunting down the criminals.

Entries.Title: Kraven the Hunter
Entries.Description: Kraven Kravinoff's complex relationship with his ruthless gangster father, Nikolai, starts him down a path of vengeance with brutal consequences, motivating him to become not only the greatest hunter in the world, but also one of its most feared.

Entries.Title: Utopia
Entries.Description: A soldier searching for his missing wife breaks into a high-tech facility, believing she's been caught in a human trafficking ring. But beyond its walls, he finds a surreal, futuristic fantasy park where reality and illusion blur. As he navigates this seductive and dangerous world, a shocking truth pulls him deeper into a deadly game where nothing is as it seems.

Entries.Title: Hunt the Wicked
Entries.Description: The film tells the story of narcotics police officer Huang Mingjin and the "mysterious figure" Wei Yunzhou. Through completely different means and methods, in the process of calculating and wrestling with each other, they tear apart the facade of urban tranquility, exposing the underground drug network woven by the hidden hand "Long Wang", and ultimately eradicate the darkness with the sword of justice, revealing the dawn of light.

Entries.Title: Road House
Entries.Description: Ex-UFC fighter Dalton takes a job as a bouncer at a Florida Keys roadhouse, only to discover that this paradise is not all it seems.

Entries.Title: Red One
Entries.Description: After Santa Claus (codename: Red One) is kidnapped, the North Pole's Head of Security must team up with the world's most infamous tracker in a globe-trotting, action-packed mission to save Christmas.

Entries.Title: Life After Fighting
Entries.Description: Retired martial arts world champion Alex Faulkner has settled into a simple life, when the disappearance of two of his students leads to an unthinkable discovery close to home. Just when all hope of finding the children is lost, he locates the imprisoned girls and unsurfaces an international child trafficking operation, which draws him back into the fight of his life against those behind it.

Entries.Title: Apocalypse Z: The Beginning of the End
Entries.Description: When a kind of rabies that transforms people into aggressive creatures spreads across the planet, Manel isolates himself at home with his cat, relying on his wits to survive; but soon they must go out in search of food, by land and by sea, dodging many dangers.

Entries.Title: Godzilla x Kong: The New Empire
Entries.Description: Following their explosive showdown, Godzilla and Kong must reunite against a colossal undiscovered threat hidden within our world, challenging their very existence – and our own.

Entries.Title: Bad Boys: Ride or Die
Entries.Description: After their late former Captain is framed, Lowrey and Burnett try to clear his name, only to end up on the run themselves.

Entries.Title: Bambi: A Life in the Woods
Entries.Description: The life of Bambi, a male roe deer, from his birth through childhood, the loss of his mother, the finding of a mate, the lessons he learns from his father, and the experience he gains about the dangers posed by human hunters in the forest.

Entries.Title: Dune: Part Two
Entries.Description: Follow the mythic journey of Paul Atreides as he unites with Chani and the Fremen while on a path of revenge against the conspirators who destroyed his family. Facing a choice between the love of his life and the fate of the known universe, Paul endeavors to prevent a terrible future only he can foresee.

Entries.Title: Kingdom of the Planet of the Apes
Entries.Description: Several generations following Caesar's reign, apes – now the dominant species – live harmoniously while humans have been reduced to living in the shadows. As a new tyrannical ape leader builds his empire, one young ape undertakes a harrowing journey that will cause him to question all he's known about the past and to make choices that will define a future for apes and humans alike.

Entries.Title: Furiosa: A Mad Max Saga
Entries.Description: As the world falls, young Furiosa is snatched from the Green Place of Many Mothers into the hands of a great biker horde led by the warlord Dementus. Sweeping through the wasteland, they encounter the citadel presided over by Immortan Joe. The two tyrants wage war for dominance, and Furiosa must survive many trials as she puts together the means to find her way home.

Entries.Title: Séance Games: Metaxu
Entries.Description: Social media stars unite to play METAXU, an online séance game, only to find they have unwittingly unleashed the Gates of Hell.

Entries.Title: Nudus
Entries.Description: As she awakens from a prolonged coma, a woman is shocked to learn all the details of her life her captors her captors have access to.

Entries.Title: The Substance
Entries.Description: A fading celebrity decides to use a black market drug, a cell-replicating substance that temporarily creates a younger, better version of herself.

Entries.Title: The Hangman
Entries.Description: Troubled father Leon takes son camping in Appalachia. Local cult summons evil Hangman demon. Son goes missing. Leon must confront cult, monster to find him amid rising body count.

Entries.Title: Alien: Romulus
Entries.Description: While scavenging the deep ends of a derelict space station, a group of young space colonizers come face to face with the most terrifying life form in the universe.

Entries.Title: Conjuring the Cult
Entries.Description: After discovering his blood-soaked daughter dead in the bathtub, David Bryson attends a self-help group to help save him from his ghostly nightmares. But when a group of mysterious cult-like women offer to help him resurrect his daughter. David's choices will not just decide his fate... but the fate of his dead daughter's SOUL.

Entries.Title: The Cellar
Entries.Description: A young girl wakes up imprisoned underground, with amnesia. She must escape, unravel the mystery behind her captivity, and confront her personal struggles. A suspenseful tale of survival, truth, and inner turmoil unfolds.

Entries.Title: Terrifier 3
Entries.Description: Five years after surviving Art the Clown's Halloween massacre, Sienna and Jonathan are still struggling to rebuild their shattered lives. As the holiday season approaches, they try to embrace the Christmas spirit and leave the horrors of the past behind. But just when they think they're safe, Art returns, determined to turn their holiday cheer into a new nightmare. The festive season quickly unravels as Art unleashes his twisted brand of terror, proving that no holiday is safe.

Entries.Title: Spirit in the Blood
Entries.Description: After a young girl is found dead in a secluded religious mountain community, a pack of teenage girls decide to fight against the evil spirits they believe killed her by embracing their own dark nature.

Entries.Title: Smile 2
Entries.Description: About to embark on a new world tour, global pop sensation Skye Riley begins experiencing increasingly terrifying and inexplicable events. Overwhelmed by the escalating horrors and the pressures of fame, Skye is forced to face her dark past to regain control of her life before it spirals out of control.

Entries.Title: Nosferatu
Entries.Description: A gothic tale of obsession between a haunted young woman and the terrifying vampire infatuated with her, causing untold horror in its wake.

Entries.Title: Saint Catherine
Entries.Description: An orphaned girl is rescued from a satanic ritual and taken to Saint Catherine Institute for homeless youth. There she will learn new skills while facing demons that stalk her.

Entries.Title: A Quiet Place: Day One
Entries.Description: As New York City is invaded by alien creatures who hunt by sound, a woman named Sam fights to survive with her cat.

Entries.Title: Subservience
Entries.Description: With his wife out sick, a struggling father brings home a lifelike AI, only to have his self-aware new help want everything her new family has to offer... Like the affection of her owner and she'll kill to get it.

Entries.Title: Lembayung
Entries.Description: Arum and Pica, who wanted to complete their internship at Lembayung hospital, had to face mysterious terror from a woman satan who was suspected of hanged herself in the bathroom. The situation became even more tense after they asked others for help to the point where they threatened their own lives and those closest to them.

Entries.Title: Seeds
Entries.Description: A Mohawk woman is hired as a social media influencer but is caught in a deadly cat-and-mouse game as she's forced to go to war to preserve her people's heritage from corporate interests.

Entries.Title: Heretic
Entries.Description: Two young missionaries are forced to prove their faith when they knock on the wrong door and are greeted by a diabolical Mr. Reed, becoming ensnared in his deadly game of cat-and-mouse.

Entries.Title: Blink Twice
Entries.Description: When tech billionaire Slater King meets cocktail waitress Frida at his fundraising gala, he invites her to join him and his friends on a dream vacation on his private island. But despite the epic setting, beautiful people, ever-flowing champagne, and late-night dance parties, Frida can sense that there’s something sinister hiding beneath the island’s lush façade.

Entries.Title: Absolution
Entries.Description: An aging ex-boxer gangster working as muscle for a Boston crime boss receives an upsetting diagnosis.  Despite a faltering memory, he attempts to rectify the sins of his past and reconnect with his estranged children. He is determined to leave a positive legacy for his grandson, but the criminal underworld isn’t done with him and won’t loosen their grip willingly.

Entries.Title: Oddity
Entries.Description: After the brutal murder of her twin sister, Darcy goes after those responsible by using haunted items as her tools for revenge.

Entries.Title: Immaculate
Entries.Description: An American nun embarks on a new journey when she joins a remote convent in the Italian countryside. However, her warm welcome quickly turns into a living nightmare when she discovers her new home harbours a sinister secret and unspeakable horrors.

Entries.Title: Trap
Entries.Description: A father and teen daughter attend a pop concert, where they realize they're at the center of a dark and sinister event.

Entries.Title: Watchmen: Chapter II
Entries.Description: Suspicious of the events ensnaring their former colleagues, Nite Owl and Silk Spectre are spurred out of retirement to investigate. As they grapple with personal ethics, inner demons and a society turned against them, they race the clock to uncover a deepening plot that might trigger global nuclear war.

Entries.Title: Love Lies Bleeding
Entries.Description: Reclusive gym manager Lou falls hard for Jackie, an ambitious bodybuilder headed through town to Las Vegas in pursuit of her dream. But their love ignites violence, pulling them deep into the web of Lou’s criminal family.

Entries.Title: Exhuma
Entries.Description: After tracing the origin of a disturbing supernatural affliction to a wealthy family's ancestral gravesite, a team of paranormal experts relocates the remains—and soon discovers what happens to those who dare to mess with the wrong grave.

Entries.Title: The Watchers
Entries.Description: A young artist gets stranded in an extensive, immaculate forest in western Ireland, where, after finding shelter, she becomes trapped alongside three strangers, stalked by mysterious creatures each night.

Entries.Title: Vina: Before 7 Days
Entries.Description: Victim of atrocities by motorbike gangs in Cirebon, VINA did not accept that her death was called a single accident. Her spirit enters to reveal the facts. Before 7 Days, what actually happened?

Entries.Title: Badland Hunters
Entries.Description: After a deadly earthquake turns Seoul into a lawless badland, a fearless huntsman springs into action to rescue a teenager abducted by a mad doctor.

Entries.Title: Case Closed: The Million-Dollar Pentagram
Entries.Description: A message has arrived from Kid the Phantom Thief, that he will steal a Japanese sword belonging to wealthy Onoe Family in Hakodate, Hokkaido. Conan and Heiji Hattori, who happened to be in Hakodate, are on the case to capture Kid. Coincidentally the family lawyer of Onoe is found murdered in the warehouse district, apparently slaughtered by a Japanese sword. The suspect is an investor/arms dealer who is said to be after Onoe family’s hidden treasure. In the North among cherry blossoms, the exciting hunt for treasure begins!

Entries.Title: Orion and the Dark
Entries.Description: A boy with an active imagination faces his fears on an unforgettable journey through the night with his new friend: a giant, smiling creature named Dark.

Entries.Title: Sleeping Dogs
Entries.Description: Roy Freeman, an ex-homicide detective with a fractured memory, is forced to revisit a case he can't remember. As a man's life hangs in the balance on death row, Freeman must piece together the brutal evidence from a decade-old murder investigation, uncovering a sinister web of buried secrets and betrayals linking to his past. With only instincts to trust, he faces a chilling truth - sometimes, it's best to let sleeping dogs lie.

Entries.Title: Monster Summer
Entries.Description: When a mysterious force begins to disrupt their big summer fun, Noah and his friends team up with a retired police detective to embark on a monstrous adventure to save their island.

Entries.Title: Caddo Lake
Entries.Description: When an 8-year-old girl mysteriously vanishes on Caddo Lake, a series of past deaths and disappearances begin to link together, forever altering a broken family’s history.

Entries.Title: Imaginary
Entries.Description: When Jessica moves back into her childhood home with her family, her youngest stepdaughter Alice develops an eerie attachment to a stuffed bear named Chauncey she finds in the basement. Alice starts playing games with Chauncey that begin playful and become increasingly sinister. As Alice’s behavior becomes more and more concerning, Jessica intervenes only to realize Chauncey is much more than the stuffed toy bear she believed him to be.

Entries.Title: Oshi no Ko -The Final Act-
Entries.Description: Goro is a gynecologist and idol fan who’s in shock after his favorite star, Ai, announces an impromptu hiatus. Little does Goro realize that he’s about to forge a bond with her that defies all common sense! Lies are an idol’s weapon!

Entries.Title: Look Back
Entries.Description: Popular, outgoing Fujino is celebrated by her classmates for her funny comics in the class newspaper. One day, her teacher asks her to share the space with Kyomoto, a truant recluse whose beautiful artwork sparks a competitive fervor in Fujino. What starts as jealousy transforms when Fujino realizes their shared passion for drawing.

Entries.Title: Drawing Closer
Entries.Description: With only a year left to live, 17-year-old Akito finds new meaning in life by bringing joy to a terminally ill girl who has just six months remaining.

Entries.Title: Attack on Titan: THE LAST ATTACK
Entries.Description: A colossal-sized omnibus film bringing together the last two episodes of Attack on Titan in the franchise's first-ever theatrical experience. After venturing beyond the walls and separated from his comrades, Eren finds himself inspired by this new truth and plots the "Rumbling," a terrifying plan to eradicate every living thing in the world. With the fate of the world hanging in the balance, a motley crew of Eren's former comrades and enemies scramble to halt his deadly mission. The only question is, can they stop him?

Entries.Title: BLUE LOCK THE MOVIE -EPISODE NAGI-
Entries.Description: When apathetic gamer Nagi agrees to join his rich classmate Mikage in soccer, their partnership leads to the famous Blue Lock program — and to changes.

Entries.Title: Chijin no Ai
Entries.Description: Kawai Joji, an aspiring screenwriter who has won a screenplay competition but has yet to make his professional debut, meets a beautiful woman, Naomi, in a rundown bar one day. Naomi says she is working at the bar while aiming to become an actress. On another day, Joji is asked by his screenplay instructor if he would like to write a screenplay for a film based on Tanizaki Junichiro's "A Fool's Love" on his behalf. Joji is determined to succeed this time, but struggles to write the script. Meanwhile, Joji meets Naomi again, and the two of them quickly become closer, but...

Entries.Title: The Colors Within
Entries.Description: Totsuko is a high school student with the ability to see the 'colors' of others. Colors of bliss, excitement, and serenity, plus a color she treasures as her favorite. Kimi, a classmate at her school, gives off the most beautiful color of all. Although she doesn't play an instrument, Totsuko forms a band with Kimi and Rui, a quiet music enthusiast they meet at a used bookstore in a far corner of town. As they practice at an old church on a remote island, music brings them together, forming friendships and stirring affections.

Entries.Title: The Real You
Entries.Description: Why had a mother who seemed happy desired to end her own life? Desperate to uncover his mother’s true intentions, Sakuya ventures into uncharted technological territory. He turns to VF (Virtual Figure), a technology that aggregates personal data from one’s life to create a “human” in a virtual space.

Entries.Title: 11 Rebels
Entries.Description: When the brutal Boshin War breaks out in Japan, a group of inmates on death row unite to defend a fortress against the Imperial army.

Entries.Title: Umamusume: Pretty Derby – Beginning of a New Era
Entries.Description: Jungle Pocket, a.k.a. Pokke, is a Umamusume girl who has been running free in freestyle races, aiming to be the strongest. On a whim, Pokke watches a race in the Twinkle Series. She is shocked by Fuji Kiseki's performance in the race, and decides to challenge for the Twinkle Series herself. Pokke enters "Toresen Academy," where Umamusume girls gather, and under the guidance of trainer Tanabe, who raised Fuji Kiseki, she takes on the "Classic Triple Crown Race," a race she is allowed to attempt only once in her lifetime. What awaited him there were rivals of the same generation who were even more talented than Pokke. Dedicated to her work, Dantsu Flame continues to work hard and honestly. Manhattan Cafe, running after a "friend" that only she can see. And Agnes Tachyon, a mad scientist who seeks beyond the possibilities of Umamusume. These Umamusume girls put their pride, their will, and their souls on the line. The hot and fierce battle opens the door to a new era.

Entries.Title: Grande Maison Paris
Entries.Description: Famous Japanese chef Obana opens a new restaurant in Paris in the quest for his elusive third Michelin star. But Obana finds life as an outsider in Paris difficult, and even has trouble sourcing ingredients. His ambition causes tension with his team, including pâtissier Yuan, and sous chef Rinko. When his menu for a gala proves a disaster, Obana promises his former mentor that if he doesn't get three stars, he will leave Paris. Can he pull it off?

Entries.Title: Mobile Suit Gundam SEED FREEDOM
Entries.Description: In C.E.75, the fighting still continues. There are independence movements, and aggression by Blue Cosmos... In order to calm the situation, a global peace monitoring agency called COMPASS is established, with Lacus as its first president. As members of COMPASS, Kira and his comrades intervene into various regional battles. Then a newly established nation called Foundation proposes a joint operation against a Blue Cosmos stronghold.

Entries.Title: Doctor X: The Movie Final
Entries.Description: The star-studded casts of the drama series come together for the highly anticipated movie adaptation of "Doctor X"! The secret of Michiko Daimon is finally revealed. "I never fail." How was the solitary surgeon Michiko Daimon born? What is the dark and mysterious tumultuous half-life of Michiko?

Entries.Title: April, Come She Will
Entries.Description: Shun Fujishiro is a psychiatrist and works at a university hospital in Tokyo. He is engaged to Yayoi Sakamoto. One day in April, when he is about to marry Yayoi Sakamoto, he receives a letter from his first love Haru Iyoda. They dated 10 years ago. Suddenly, his fiancé Yayoi Sakamoto disappears.

Entries.Title: Cloud
Entries.Description: Ryōsuke Yoshii, an ordinary reseller, carelessly earns grudges by people and becomes entangled in a life-threatening struggle.

Entries.Title: Doraemon the Movie: Nobita's Earth Symphony
Entries.Description: Music exists in our daily lives for granted. But what would happen if music disappeared from the earth? This is a completely original story about Doraemon and his friends who are trying to save the earth from a crisis with the familiar theme of music!

Entries.Title: Happyend
Entries.Description: In a near-future Japanese city bracing for a devastating earthquake, a group of teenage friends navigate personal struggles and fractured bonds amid rising tension.

Entries.Title: Faceless
Entries.Description: Kaburagi was arrested as a suspect in a brutal murder case, but he escapes. He continues to hide and move all around Japan. During this time, he meets Sayaka, Kazuya and Mai. Detective Matanuki is on the trail to capture Kaburagi. He interrogates the people who met Kaburagi, but they all describe Kaburagi differently from each other. Kaburagi has been missing for 488 days. Who really is Kaburagi? What is his plan?

Entries.Title: Last Mile
Entries.Description: On the night before ‘Black Friday,’ which is the one of the busiest commerce days, a cardboard box, that is delivered from the world's largest shopping site, explodes. Soon after, a series of mysterious explosion cases occurs. The entire nation becomes terrorized by the shocking events. Funado Erena has just began to work as the center director for a large distribution warehouse that covers three-quarters of the Kanto area. Erena must gain control over this unprecedented situation with team manager Nashimoto Ko.

Entries.Title: Blue Period
Entries.Description: Yatora is the perfect high school student, with good grades and lots of friends. It's an effortless performance, and, ultimately… a dull one. But he wanders into the art room one day, and a lone painting captures his eye, awakening him to a kind of beauty he never knew. Compelled and consumed, he dives in headfirst—and he's about to learn how savage and unforgiving art can be!

Entries.Title: Wonderland
Entries.Description: In a world where an AI programme allows people to communicate with their deceased loved ones, a flight attendant and a mother question the meaning of reality and humanity.

Entries.Title: Uprising
Entries.Description: In the Joseon Dynasty, two friends who grew up together — one the master and one the servant — reunite post-war as enemies on opposing sides.

Entries.Title: Escape
Entries.Description: After completing his required decade of military service and being honored as a hero, a North Korean sergeant makes a sudden shocking attempt to defect to the South, risking life and limb for the chance to finally determine his own destiny.

Entries.Title: Bogotá: City of the Lost
Entries.Description: After moving to Bogotá for a chance at a better life, a young Korean man rises through the Colombian black market — risking peril for a shot at success.

Entries.Title: Mistress
Entries.Description: After finishing his long career as a government official in Hanyang, His Excellency returns home with his gisaeng lover. His mistress, who washed her identity as his foster daughter, can't adjust to the boring country life and becomes lonely. On the other hand, His Excellency keeps paying attention to his female servant, a familiar face in his hometown full of memories, and becomes increasingly neglectful of his mistress. The mistress, who is saddened by His Excellency's actions, receives comfort for her body and mind from his male servant. One day, an imperial scholar comes to visit and takes control of his mistress, but when His Excellency does not take any action, she becomes greatly disappointed. However, the male servant, who watched the scene, seeks revenge for her from the imperial scholar but is caught by His Excellency and beats him. At the end, his mistress decides to run away with the male servant in the middle of the night.

Entries.Title: Dirty Money
Entries.Description: Two detectives in need; Myung-deuk looks after gang and takes bribes for his sick daughter; Dong-hyeok helps Myung-deuk to settle his gambling debts. One day they hear an information that Chinese gang is shipping a big amount of cash abroad and decide to steal it for themselves. But things go wrong and they're now chased both by police and Chinese gang.

Entries.Title: Firefighters
Entries.Description: Even in the harshest environments, firefighters must focus on extinguishing fires and rescuing everyone there. At 3:47 AM on March 4, 2001, the 119 emergency call center receives a phone call about a fire that has broken out in the Hongje-dong neighborhood. Firefighters, including newcomer Cheol-woong, rush to the scene.

Entries.Title: Hear Me: Our Summer
Entries.Description: A job seeking dreamer Yong-jun works part-time at his parents' lunch box house. Yeo-reum lives only to support for hearing-impaired swimmer sister. One day, Yong-jun meets Yeo-reum while delivering lunch boxes and falls in love at the first sight. Yeo-reum slowly opens her heart to warm-hearted Yong-jun.

Entries.Title: 장모님의 육체적 본능
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: My Name Is Loh Kiwan
Entries.Description: After defecting from North Korea, Loh Kiwan struggles to obtain refugee status in Belgium, where he encounters a dejected woman who has lost all hope.

Entries.Title: Love in the Big City
Entries.Description: When a carefree woman learns that her closeted friend is gay, the two form an inseparable bond and find comfort in each other's company.

Entries.Title: Heavy Snow
Entries.Description: Su-an, a performing arts high school student, becomes close with Seol, an actress and celebrity. During a trip, they realize that they have feelings for each other. However, misunderstandings pile up too much, and Seol leaves Su-an. Su-an later becomes an actress and returns to the winter sea, longing for Seol.

Entries.Title: Ms. Apocalypse
Entries.Description: Young-mi, the bookkeeper at a factory, is ridiculed for her dowdy appearance and called 'Ms. Apocalypse' by her colleagues. Do-young, a delivery driver, is the only one to show her any decency and kindness. As her feelings for him grow, Young-mi strives to get him off the hook even when she finds out that Do-young has been embezzling company money. It becomes the last day of 1999, and in the midst of people's fear that the world will come to an end, Young-mi gets arrested for aiding Do-young's crime. And thus, her new millennium starts wretchedly. As she walks out of prison after a few months, she comes across Do-young's wife, Yu-jin, waiting for her and this unexpected visitor makes an implausible but compelling offer.

Entries.Title: The Taste of Emotion
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Sister in law's Emperor VIP Service
Entries.Description: Myeong-hoon usually likes to go to massage shops, where he can even have sex with the masseuse. Then one day, her younger brother introduced him to the woman he would marry, and the woman who would become his sister-in-law was the masseuse he met recently at a massage shop! Myeong-hoon makes a secret proposal to the embarrassed woman, and she accepts it for the sake of her smooth married life, and their dangerous relationship begins.

Entries.Title: Amazon Bullseye
Entries.Description: Once an Olympic medalist in archery but now the top target for restructuring, Jin-bong heads to the Amazon to seize one last chance offered by his company. After barely surviving a life-threatening ordeal, Jin-bong arrives in the Amazon, where he meets three warriors with god-given archery skills: Sika, Eba, and Walbu! Believing he has found a way to save himself, Jin-bong teams up with Bbang-sik, a Korean-Bolédorian interpreter, and brings the three archery masters to Korea… Now, Jin-bong’s comeback depends entirely on the Amazon trio!

Entries.Title: A Normal Family
Entries.Description: Jae-wan, a successful lawyer, takes on the case of a rich executive's son, who has purposely run over and killed a man and left his daughter seriously injured. It's Jae-wan's job to defend a murderer, just another rung on his career's golden-stepped ladder. His younger brother, on the contrary, is a scrupulous and upstanding paediatrician, who always puts the health of his patients over profit and money, often contravening the rules of the private clinic where he works. The brothers meet once a month with their wives for fine dining in expensive restaurants, but when an unexpected situation involving their teenage kids arises, their consciences are questioned and their usual dinner conversation takes an unexpected turn.

Entries.Title: What Happened in My Black Boyfriend's Room
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Posted Grudge Spirit Footage Vol.116: Revenge Edition
Entries.Description: This is the 116th installment of the “Posted Grudge Spirit Footage” film series.

Entries.Title: Ju-on: The Grudge
Entries.Description: When social worker Rika is sent to check on a traumatized old lady whose family have moved in at the site of the notorious Saeki family murder case, she unwittingly unleashes a cycle of terror that is transmitted via its victims further and further from its original source.

Entries.Title: The Seven Deadly Sins: Grudge of Edinburgh Part 2
Entries.Description: Reunited with Lancelot for the first time since their tragic accident, Tristan must learn to conquer his inner demons in order to save his mother's life.

Entries.Title: Ju-on: The Grudge 2
Entries.Description: When the cast and crew of a paranormal TV reality program decide to shoot in the house of the original Saeki hauntings, a series of strange events unfold at the location.

Entries.Title: Ju-on: The Curse
Entries.Description: When elementary school teacher Kobayashi investigates the absence of one of his young pupils from the classroom, he finds himself at the doorstep of an anonymous suburban house that harbours a horrible secret, and into which all who enter are doomed.

Entries.Title: Ju-On: Black Ghost
Entries.Description: The supernatural grudge manifests itself by way of a strange cyst growing in the body of a young woman, slowly draining all life from her in revenge for... what?

Entries.Title: Ju-on: The Final Curse
Entries.Description: Following the events of Ju-on: The Beginning of the End, Mai, the older sister of elementary schoolteacher Yui Shono, goes to look for her sister, who disappeared after a year while working in an elementary school. Mai soon discovers the Teriyaki household who tells her about what happened to her sister. Mai will now uncover the dark secrets of Ju-on and will try to end the curse once and for all.

Entries.Title: Ju-on: The Live
Entries.Description: Ju-On, the Japanese horror classic that sent Japan into a whirlpool of shivers, will once again plunge Japan into the depths of terror this summer as a terrifying live entertainment experience....

Entries.Title: Ju-on: The Curse 2
Entries.Description: On his request, the sensitive sister of a real estate agent visits a house he intends to put up for sale, only to cross paths with its resident curse.

Entries.Title: Ju-On: White Ghost
Entries.Description: An apparitions of a young schoolgirl in a yellow rain hat, a family massacre, and a law student's suicide after he fails his bar exam are linked by the ominous recordings discovered on an audio cassette.

Entries.Title: Ju-on: The Beginning of the End
Entries.Description: A school teacher visits the home of a boy who's been absent from school for a long period of time, unaware of the horrific tragedy which occurred in the boy's household many years ago.

Entries.Title: Everyone Loves Me
Entries.Description: On the day Yue Qianling resigned, she coincidentally crossed paths with her secret crush, Gu Xun, who had just joined as the head of the 9th Business Unit. She didn't hesitate to return to the company to boldly pursue Gu Xun, but he remained indifferent. He even harshly rejected her confession in front of the entire school. Little did she know, Gu Xun had long fallen for his fearless online friend "Sticky Dough Twist". Who would have expected that his online friend turned out to be Yue Qianling herself? Upon discovering the truth, Gu Xun had no choice but to embark on a humorous and heartwarming "reverse pursuit" journey.

Entries.Title: Riverside Code at Qingming Festival
Entries.Description: During the Northern Song Dynasty, the Zhao family—comprising Zhao Buyou, his wife Wen Yue, and their three children—lives in Bianliang's Que'er Alley. Zhao Buyou, a lowly clerk, seeks a simple life, while Wen Yue is focused on improving their living conditions. Despite frequent disagreements, the family remains close. An unexpected event thrusts them into a significant case, leading them on a journey of personal growth and discovery, while uncovering deeper truths and protecting their community.

Entries.Title: Embrace in the Dark Night
Entries.Description: Wen Xi is drawn into an underground fight club and becomes the prize for champion Xu Zheqing, who is secretly a security consultant tasked with saving her. Three years later, after her twin sister’s mysterious death, Wen Xi assumes her sister’s identity at a company, where she reunites with Xu. Now on opposite sides, can they reconcile their feelings and uncover the truth?

Entries.Title: The Land of Warriors
Entries.Description: After the final match of the Continental Advanced Soul Master Academy Elite Tournament, Tang San and his friends reluctantly bid each other farewell, promising to reunite in five years. They then set off on their separate life journeys until Bibi Dong from the Spirit Hall secretly plotted to dominate the Douluo Continent by sweeping away the major sects. In response, Tang San gathered his friends to establish the Tang Sect, committed to the pursuit of justice and determined to shoulder the heavy responsibility.

Entries.Title: Best Choice Ever
Entries.Description: Mai Chenghuan, a post-95 girl born into an ordinary family in Shanghai, agrees to marry her boyfriend, Xin Jialiang, under her mother’s urging. However, the economic gap between them creates an imbalance in their relationship, ultimately leading to its end. Mai Chenghuan then gains her grandmother's approval and is entrusted with the heavy responsibility of managing a hotel. Through cooperation, Mai Chenghuan and the professional hotel manager Yao Zhiming become working partners and go hand in hand. Mai Chenghuan transitions from being under her family's control to achieving self-fulfillment, forging her own path.

Entries.Title: Inverse Identiy
Entries.Description: Yan Lu, pursued by enemies, accidentally kidnaps Jian An, the adopted heir of the Jian family. After failing to escape, Yan Lu becomes Jian An's reluctant bodyguard. Their dynamic shifts as Jian An, intrigued by Yan Lu, playfully torments him. A fight reveals a birthmark on Yan Lu, hinting at deeper secrets. When Jian An loses his memory, he relies on Yan Lu, leading to a growing bond between them. However, as Jian An's memories return, he fears the truth will come out, unaware that Yan Lu understands everything and only wants to protect him.

Entries.Title: Love Endures
Entries.Description:
In an aerospace city in the north, seven children who were born an only child became closer than siblings and called themselves "The Big Dipper." They all promised to conquer the college entrance examinations so they can go to Beijing together but seventeen came and went and only Huang Yingzi made it.

"The Big Dipper" was no more as everyone parted ways. Huang Yingzi went to Beijing for school and Jiang Yi left for the States. "Who do you like at the age of seventeen" has become a mystery lingering in the hearts of the seven people. As newcomers in the workplace, they were bruised and battered from the skirmishes between their ideals and reality. Their once pure emotions are like shining stars in the night sky. Huang Yingzi wants to reunite the group only to realize that there a question remains. Meanwhile, Jiang Yi and the others have already been presented their answer.

Entries.Title: Spy x Sect
Entries.Description: In a captivating tale of sacrifice and rebirth, a brilliant hacker named Chen Ning dies to save humanity from a rogue AI, only to be reincarnated as the leader of a powerful sect in a realm of immortal cultivation. Chen Ning must maintain a low profile while handling new responsibilities and guarding against spies within his sect and the encroaching AI threat. Hidden beneath his cold exterior is a deep care for others, as he navigates a world of martial arts, mystical powers, and political intrigue. With the mysterious system agent Jiang Que at his side, Chen Ning unleashes his true potential and commands both allies and foes. As hidden truths of this mystical world reveal themselves, Chen Ning races against time, merging his hacking prowess with newfound mystical abilities, to thwart an impending apocalypse and save another world from destruction.

Entries.Title: Blossom
Entries.Description: After a troubled childhood, Dou Zhao retreats to a village, where she meets Song Mo, a merchant with a hidden past. To navigate family schemes and personal challenges, they form an alliance, growing from reluctant partners to trusted allies as they strive to protect what matters most.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: In the winter of the 27th year of Emperor Cheng Ping's reign, General Song Mo of the Cavalry launched a night raid on the capital. Meanwhile, Dou Zhao discovers the Marquis of Ji Ning's secret.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Knowing the future events, Dou Zhao seizes the opportunity to secure her future amongst the shifts within her family.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Dou Zhao returns to her family manor for a matchmaking event, masked as a reunion.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Dou Zhao and Song Mo unknowingly attend the same performance at the theater. Back at Cui Manor, Dou Zhao learns medicinal skills from Yuantong and as a natural disaster unfolds, both Dou Zhao and Song Mo do their best to aid the people.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Jiang Meisun is urgently summoned back to the capital by the emperor. Meanwhile, Song Mo seeks refuge at Cui Manor.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Dou Shishu, aiming to gain more power in court, persuades Wang Yingxue to arrange a meeting with Wu Shan, Wei Tingyu, and the Dou ladies.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Song Mo angers Dai Jian and Dou Shishu by helping Dou Zhao and Dou Zhao assert her opinions on marriage.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: The Emperor orders an investigation into the Duke of Jing's case. Meanwhile, Dou Zhao works from the outside to help Song Mo.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Wu Shan argues with his grandfather over his proposal to marry Dou Zhao. While Dou Zhao loses Song Mo's trust and leaves for Fu Ting to uncover the truth.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Dou Zhao and Song Mo board the ship, seeking clues to the case, and find that there is more to the case than meets the eye.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: Song Mo disbands the Ding Army and Dou Zhao helps the Miao family during their crisis in Fu Ting.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Song Mo leaves for Liaodong and is called home to visit his sick mother and Dou Zhao returns to the capital to be under house arrest.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: Song Mo takes over to perform the rites for his mother's funeral while Dou Zhao is accused of bringing dishonor to the family.

Episodes.Title: Episode 14
Episodes.Description: Dou Zhao participates in the Ladies' Etiquette Contest while Song Mo participates in the harvest hunting contest.

Episodes.Title: Episode 15
Episodes.Description: Discussions about Dou Zhao and Wei Tingyu's marriage are progressing, leaving Song Mo and Dou Ming feeling uneasy.

Episodes.Title: Episode 16
Episodes.Description: The marriage proceeds as planned and Dou Ming finally stands up to Wang Yingxue.

Episodes.Title: Episode 17
Episodes.Description: Dou Shiying stands up for Dou Zhao and Song Mo confesses his feelings.

Entries.Title: Are You The One
Entries.Description: The clever and decisive Liu Miantang, as the first lord of Mount Yang, led the people of Mount Yang to punish the wicked, promote goodness, and uphold justice. However, she suffered serious injuries under the attack of various evil forces and was rescued by Cui Xingzhou, the Prince of Huai Yang. When Liu Miantang woke up, she had no memory of Mount Yang, mistaking Cui Xingzhou for her husband, Cui Jiu. However, if their identities were exposed, can they face it honestly while enduring hardships?

Episodes.Title: Meeting of the Couple
Episodes.Description: Liu Mian Tang came to Lingquan Town with Nanny Li. Liu Mian Tang had forgotten the past due to head injury. She learned from Nanny Li that her husband Cui Jiu had spent all his wealth in order to cure her. So Liu Mian Tang moved from the capital to Lingquan Town. But after meeting her husband, Liu Mian Tang found that the relationship between the two was very awkward, not like the loving couple that others said. So Liu Mian Tang became suspicious.

Episodes.Title: Doubting Each Other
Episodes.Description: The garrison's nephew Chen Tu saw Liu Mian Tang on the street and tried to offend her, but he was easily subdued by Liu Mian Tang. The hidden guard on the street reported to Cui Xing Zhou. Cui Xing Zhou doubted that Liu Mian Tang had already recovered her memory.

Episodes.Title: Shooting Fish in a Barrel
Episodes.Description: Spy from Mount Yang reported to Zi Yu and Yun Niang that Liu Mian Tang was found. The next day at the banquet, Cui Xing Zhou deliberatly created an opportunity for Lu Wen to rescue Liu Mian Tang. When Lu Wen came, he would be caught easily with Cui Xing Zhou's setup.

Episodes.Title: Joining the Trade Guild
Episodes.Description: Liu Mian Tang came to the He's Porcelain Shop and learned that if she wanted to be success in the business, she needed to join the Town's trade guild. Liu asked He Zhen to help her joining the trade guild, but He Zhen told her that the Guild did not accept women. Returned home, Cui Xing Zhou also disagreed with Liu Mian Tang's insistence on joining the Guild...

Episodes.Title: Eased Relationship
Episodes.Description: Liu Mian Tang told Cui Xing Zhou that he was not her cup of tea. If Cui Xing Zhou wanted to divorce, she would accept. Cui Xing Zhou felt depressed after hearing this.

Episodes.Title: Getting Recognized
Episodes.Description: Liu Mian Tang met Mr. Jia of the Trade Guild by selling paintings, so the traders thought Mr. Jia would cooperate with Liu Mian Tang. Soon, everyone in the Trade Guild approached Liu Mian Tang due to pressure.

Episodes.Title: Chess Game
Episodes.Description: Liu Mian Tang came to Qingzhou. Cui Xing Zhou and Liu Mian Tang were visiting a garden party when Tzuyu appeared in front of them...

Episodes.Title: Pursuit
Episodes.Description: Seeing that Cui Xing Zhou was depressed, Liu Mian Tang stepped forward to comfort him. Cui Xing Zhou and Liu Mian Tang talked about their inner reluctance and regret, and felt complicated under Liu Mian Tang's gentle comfort. Yang Shan has surrendered, and Cui Xing Zhou has decided to end this game.

Episodes.Title: Stay up All Night
Episodes.Description: Shi Xue Ji is getting married soon. Knowing her status as a concubine in the Shi family, she carefully chose one of the smallest rings. Liu Mian Tang, He Zhen and the merchants' wives gathered. The ladies talked about the news that King Huai Yang was about to get married, and began to tease He Zhen.

Episodes.Title: Leave without Saying Goodbye
Episodes.Description: He Zhen heard the ridicule of the female members of the He family. Not wanting to discover the lies Zhao Quan told during the previous diagnosis and treatment, He Zhen kidnapped Zhao Quan to Cui Zhai to inform Liu Mian Tang. (Source: Viu)

Episodes.Title: Worries
Episodes.Description: At the dinner at the Huaiyang Prince's Mansion, everyone talked about Cui Xing Zhou and Lian Rui Lan's wedding. When preparing for the wedding, Cui Xing Zhou was absent-minded, thinking only about how to arrange Liu Mian Tang.

Episodes.Title: I Won’t Marry Anyone but You
Episodes.Description: Liu Mian Tang proposed to rewrite the lost marriage certificate with Cui Xing Zhou. Both of them were reluctant and sad. The next day, when Liu Mian Tang woke up, she only saw a divorce letter left by Cui Xing Zhou. At this time, Cui Xing Zhou had already led the Zhenzhou army to go to war.

Episodes.Title: Decided to Confess
Episodes.Description: Under Jinjia Pass, Cui Xing Zhou was protecting the city at the frontline, while Liu Mian Tang was helping to keep Wuning Town in order. Cui Xing Zhou was touched when he saw what Liu Mian Tang did.

Episodes.Title: Nightmare
Episodes.Description: Liu Mian Tang came to the countryside to look for ghost roots, and suddenly had a hallucination. In her dream, someone cut her wrists and pushed her down the cliff.

Episodes.Title: Mysterious Convoy
Episodes.Description: A Gu Shan reported the Qi officials who had participated in provoking the war to Cui Xing Zhou in exchange for his life. Liu Mian Tang's memory was restored in her sleep, and she suddenly realized that she was very familiar with the western tribes.

Episodes.Title: Execution
Episodes.Description: Cui Xing Zhou and Zhao Quan found out that Pingyuan Escort Agency was related to the smuggling of iron ore. Qiao Xian Mu think of the memories she had recovered, she couldn't help but doubt her husband Cui Xing Zhou.

Episodes.Title: Revenge
Episodes.Description: The palace received news that the Zhenzhou army had defeated the western tribes and that Cui Xing Zhou had captured A Gu Shan alive. Empress Dowager became even more afraid of Cui Xing Zhou. At the market, Qiao Xian called Liu Mian Tang, and the two recognized each other.

Episodes.Title: True Identity
Episodes.Description: Cui Xing Zhou told Zhao Quan that he had decided to marry Liu Mian Tang. But on the other side, Liu Mian Tang and Qiao Xian cooperated to find out Cui Jiu's true identity.

Episodes.Title: Determination
Episodes.Description: Cui Xing Zhou was determined to marry Liu Mian Tang, but Liu Mian Tang suddenly became extremely cold towards him. On the other hand, Cui Xing Zhou asked someone's help to find Qiu Lin Xian.

Episodes.Title: Engagement
Episodes.Description: Mr. He wanted He Zhen to marry Lord Zhao to bring honor to the He family. He Zhen left home in anger. Cui Xing Zhou sent soldiers to search the Temple and rushed back to Cui's house to look for Liu Mian Tang. It happened that Liu Mian Tang and Li Mama went out to buy things and came home. Cui Xing Zhou learned that Liu Mian Tang did not go to the temple and he was just suspicious of her.

Episodes.Title: The Twists of Fate
Episodes.Description: Cui Xing Zhou looked into the ledger while Liu Mian Tang was in the kitchen, but found nothing suspicious. The marriage of Xing Zhou and Mian Tang was finally approved. However, Xing Zhou had figured out Mian Tang's identity, and he knew this wouldn't work between the two of them. Even so, he's deeply in love with Mian Tang.

Episodes.Title: I Owe You Nothing
Episodes.Description: Cui Xing Xhou ordered attacks on Liu Miantang. Mian Tang had a chance to kill Xing Zhou, but she just couldn't. Xing Zhou confronted Mian Tang, asking her if she still felt anything for him. Mian Tang said she only held hatred against him.

Episodes.Title: Another Game
Episodes.Description: Liu Mian Tang and Zi Yu met up. Zi Yu suggested helping Mian Tang to take her revenge, but Mian Tang rejected him. Zi Yu knew that Cui Xing Zhou would be in town, so he brought Mian Tang out for a walk so that Xing Zhou would see them.

Episodes.Title: Assassination of Prince Sui
Episodes.Description: Liu Mian Tang tried to shoot Prince Sui but failed. Zi Yu fled with Mian Tang. Just when the pursuers were about to catch up, Cui Xing Zhou appeared and stopped them.

Episodes.Title: Returning to Beizhou
Episodes.Description: Liu Mian Tang returned to Beizhou to reunite with her grandfather, Mr. Qiao. Cui Xing Zhou went to meet Lord Beizhou, but he actually came for Liu Mian Tang. Li Guang Cai revealed to Cui Xing Zhou that the Qiao family was looking for a son-in-law, and Cui Xing Zhou was worried.

Episodes.Title: Speak from the Heart
Episodes.Description: Liu Mian Tang's grandfather wanted to bring her and Lu Zhong together. Cui Xing Zhou brought a gift to celebrate Liangxin Escort Agency's re-opening, but he was stopped by Lu Zhong. Liu Mian Tang came and called Lu Zhong 'husband' in front of Cui Xing Zhou.

Episodes.Title: To Get the Bride
Episodes.Description: Lord Beizhou told Cui Xing Zhou that the daughter of Qiao family was getting married today. Cui Xing Zhou thought that Liu Mian Tang was getting married. Cui Xing Zhou stopped the wedding team on the street to get the bride.

Episodes.Title: Fight off the Assassin
Episodes.Description: The youngest son of the Lord of Beizhou lost control of his horse, and Cui Xing Zhou stepped forward to save him and broke his leg. Zhao Quan knew Cui Xing Zhou's intention and successfully rejected the marriage proposal from the Grand Empress Dowager. Zhao Quan inquired about He Zhen's whereabouts, and the two finally reunited.

Episodes.Title: Never Marry in This Life
Episodes.Description: Shi Xue Ji expressed to Zi Yu that she did not agree with what her father did. Liu Mian Tang saw the wound on Cui Xing Zhou's leg and truly understood Cui Xing Zhou's intentions.

Episodes.Title: Proposal
Episodes.Description: Zhao Quan stay in He Zhen's kiln as a laborer to make up for his mistake. He Zhen wanted to make him give up, but Zhao Quan insisted. Cui Xing Zhou came to Liu Mian Tang's room and proposed to her again. Still rejected by Liu Mian Tang, Cui Xing Zhou had made the final decision.

Episodes.Title: Return to Lingquan Town
Episodes.Description: Liu Mian Tang and Cui Xing Zhou returned to the Cui Mansion in Lingquan Town and held a new village banquet. Dowager Chu agreed to their marriage, but made things difficult for Liu Mian Tang.

Episodes.Title: Secure Your Life
Episodes.Description: He Er Lang invited Zhao Quan to He's house, hoping to control He Zhen with the fact that she escaped from marriage. However, Zhao Quan supported He Zhen, which made He Zhen moved.

Episodes.Title: Guilt
Episodes.Description: Lian's bribed Madam Wang to exchange the real night-glowing pearl hairpin for a fake one. On this day at the birthday banquet of Madam Zhao, everyone discovered that the pearl hairpin on Liu Mian Tang's head was not bright, so Lian's mother and daughter started to make a fuss and wanted to go to the palace to see the real pearl hairpin.

Episodes.Title: Attack on the Palace
Episodes.Description: Shi Yi Kuan used the excuse of insufficient supply to delay sending troops to support. Shi Xue Ji threatened Shi Yi Kuan to send troops. Upon hearing the news, Prince Sui was furious and decided to kidnap Cui Xing Zhou's family.

Episodes.Title: Wedding
Episodes.Description: As the wedding of Cui Xing Zhou and Liu Mian Tang approached, Cui Xing Zhou felt extremely nervous, while Liu Mian Tang was relaxed and calm.

Episodes.Title: Forgive and Forget
Episodes.Description: Cui Xing Zhou went to the capital to attend the court, and was criticized by the ministers for not going through the Ministry of Rituals for his wedding. Liu Mian Tang was invited to the palace to attend a tea party. Zi Yu had someone deliberately pour tea on Liu Mian Tang, so that he could meet Liu Mian Tang.

Episodes.Title: Sacrifice
Episodes.Description: Cui Xing Zhou learned about the grievances his sister had suffered in the Duke Qing's Mansion over the years, and told Cui Fu about his plan with Liu Mian Tang so that Cui Fu would not have to make such sacrifices for the Cui family anymore.

Episodes.Title: The Poisoner
Episodes.Description: Ziyu and Shi Xue Ji were poisoned at a banquet. The servant who poisoned the wine falsely accused Liu Mian Tang of ordering her to do so.

Episodes.Title: Rebellion
Episodes.Description: Prince Sui brought the edict and wanted to ascend the throne, but the Grand Empress Dowager was unwilling to give the Imperial Seal. At this time, news came that Tzu Yu's condition had improved...

Entries.Title: Amidst a Snowstorm of Love
Entries.Description: As a professional billiards player, Yin Guo has become quite a notable athlete. After receiving an invitation to play in a tournament in Hel, Yin Guo eagerly accepts. Little does she know that meeting former professional billiards player, Lin Yiyang, in Hel will change her life forever.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: A snowstorm traps Yin Guo and her cousin in a pub abroad. Despite her initial suspicions, a chivalrous stranger named Lin Yiyang helps them find shelter.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Yin Guo texts Lin Yiyang to thank him for helping Xiaotian. Later at a billiard room, they share a sweet moment after an intense game of pool.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Yin Guo discovers a promising lead for long-term accommodation. Meanwhile, Wu Wei notices that Yiyang appears to have developed a crush.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: After Yiyang helps Yin Guo move into her new apartment, he accepts a friendly challenge to a game of pool. Later, a hot pot dinner brings them closer.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: On an outing, Yiyang shares a private moment and a sweet surprise with Yin Guo. Soon after, she becomes curious about his past in professional billiards.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: A laundry room encounter leads to a bold confession from Yiyang, prompting Yin Guo — with a fluttering heart — to formulate an answer.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: A World Snooker champion's unexpected arrival throws Yin Guo's household into disarray, and Yiyang must face the challenge from his old rival.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Xiaodong and Jiang Yang meet to discuss the changes of an old pal. Meanwhile, a bleeding wound on Yiyang leads to an intimate moment with Yin Guo.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: After demonstrating his impressive billiards skills in front of Yin Guo's teammates, Yiyang must bid another emotional goodbye to her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Yin Guo makes a surprise visit to Yiyang, only to discover he's fallen ill. But for the first time, she begins to understand his life in another city.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: To help her practice, Yiyang takes Yin Guo to his favorite billiard hall. Afterwards, he treats her to a hearty meal and opens up about his family.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Yin Guo invites Yiyang to her first professional match overseas, unintentionally bringing up a poignant memory from his childhood.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: A formidable opponent confronts Yin Guo in the quarterfinals. After challenging Li Qingyan to a match, Yiyang has a serious talk with him.

Episodes.Title: Episode 14
Episodes.Description: Yin Guo learns why Yiyang abruptly ended his billiards career. Later, she receives a thoughtful surprise from him on their post-tournament getaway.

Episodes.Title: Episode 15
Episodes.Description: Yiyang and Yin Guo share a heartfelt night stargazing together. As Yin Guo heads back to China, Jiang Yang offers Yiyang a life-changing opportunity.

Episodes.Title: Episode 16
Episodes.Description: Driven by his new calling and Yin Guo's support, Yiyang returns to the field of professional billiards. His first stop: a China Open qualifier.

Episodes.Title: Episode 17
Episodes.Description: Yin Guo and Yiyang finally manage to have a brief reunion, yet they still have to endure long-distance challenges — until 18 months later.

Episodes.Title: Episode 18
Episodes.Description: Yiyang returns to China and begins to lay the groundwork for his new venture. At a gathering, a misunderstanding drives a wedge between him and Yin Guo.

Episodes.Title: Episode 19
Episodes.Description: A fight puts Yin Guo and Yiyang at odds — both still deeply care for one another, but they must find a way to mend things.

Episodes.Title: Episode 20
Episodes.Description: Xiaodong tries to get closer to Lin Lin, but suspects she likes someone else. At the Snooker China Open, a showdown unfolds between him and Yiyang.

Episodes.Title: Episode 21
Episodes.Description: Yiyang visits Mr. He's home after years of estrangement. With the blessing from his mentor, Yiyang aims for the championship at the Snooker China Open.

Episodes.Title: Episode 22
Episodes.Description: Returning to the city where they met each other, Yin Guo and Yiyang relive cherished memories and catch up with old friends.

Episodes.Title: Episode 23
Episodes.Description: Match after match, Yin Guo showcases her consummate pool skills against formidable opponents. Yiyang is put on the spot to publicly express his love.

Episodes.Title: Episode 24
Episodes.Description: Tragic news forces Yiyang to return to China immediately. Meanwhile, Yin Guo goes head-to-head against Liu Xiran, the player who once defeated her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 25
Episodes.Description: Bearing his grief, Yiyang prepares to take over his childhood pool club. Shortly after, he and Yin Guo reunite at Mr. He's memorial service.

Episodes.Title: Episode 26
Episodes.Description: After proposing an ambitious plan to save their pool club, Yiyang has a heartfelt phone call with Yin Guo that brings back memories of Mr. He.

Episodes.Title: Episode 27
Episodes.Description: Yin Guo gathers up courage and takes Yiyang home to meet her parents. For Yiyang, it's also an opportunity to reconcile a years-long rift with Wu Qian.

Episodes.Title: Episode 28
Episodes.Description: Yiyang and Yin Guo both secure their spots in the national team selection. In the closed training camp, Xiaodong and Lin Lin grow closer.

Episodes.Title: Episode 29
Episodes.Description: While Yin Guo faces off against Liu Xiran again in the final of the nine-ball championship, an injury casts doubt on Yiyang's almost certain victory.

Episodes.Title: Episode 30
Episodes.Description: Yiyang's secret social media account is uncovered by fans. On a post-match getaway, he nervously poses a question to Yin Guo on a post-match getaway.

Entries.Title: Snow Fall
Entries.Description: Shen Zhiheng is a gentleman in the Republic of China, and Mi Lan is the daughter of a wealthy businessman, who has been blind since childhood. They met on a fateful night when Mi Lan saves Shen Zhiheng from the brink of death. From then on they have been tied to each other and redeemed each other ever since.

Entries.Title: Guardians of the Dafeng
Entries.Description: Xu Qi’an, a recent police academy graduate, awakens in a strange world filled with Confucians, Taoists, Buddhists, demons, and warlocks. Facing imminent exile to a remote frontier town, he seizes the chance to change his fate by joining a powerful organization of guardians.

Episodes.Title: Time Travel to Dafeng
Episodes.Description: During a team-building activity playing a murder mystery game, Yang Ling unexpectedly travels to a world called Dafeng, taking on the identity of a constable at the Changle County Yamen—Xu Qi An.

Episodes.Title: New Goal
Episodes.Description: Xu Qi An decides to remain in this world and live well. His first goal is to make money.

Episodes.Title: A Torturing Job
Episodes.Description: Xu Qi An dreams of becoming a Night Guardian. But after solving the case, he is forced to go through report after report every day at the yamen. It's torturing.

Episodes.Title: Imprisoned in the Dungeon
Episodes.Description: While Xu Qi An is being escorted, Xu Ping Zhi attempts a rescue but is outnumbered. He ends up being imprisoned in the Ministry of Justice’s dungeon together with Xu Qi An.

Episodes.Title: Outstanding Talent
Episodes.Description: Xu Qi An uses 20 Exhortation to Learning poems to convince Scholar Zhang Shen and Li Mu Bai to let his female family members stay in the academy. When Huai Qing sees his "Exhortation of Learning" poem collection, he is secretly impressed.

Episodes.Title: Journey as a Night Guardian Begins
Battle of the Gold Guardians
Episodes.Description: Jiang Lv Zhong, Nangong Qian Rou, and Yang Yan have a disagreement and take it to the training grounds for a fight. Xu Qi An, ever curious, rushes over to watch the spectacle, only to discover that he himself is the cause of the conflict.

Episodes.Title: Strange Phenomenon
Episodes.Description: A ceremony is held at Sangbo Lake. As Xu Qi An is guarding over the area, the Jade Mirror suddenly emits a sound.

Episodes.Title: Asset Seizure
Episodes.Description: Xu Qi An and the rest are beaten up in public by the Silver Guardian leader, Zhu Cheng Zhu. Xu Qi An endures every difficult moment and humiliation thrown at him by Zhu Cheng Zhu.

Episodes.Title: An Opportunity
Episodes.Description: Huai Qing sends someone to find out more about the attack on the Silver Guardian. What she finds increases her admiration and respect for Xu Qi An.

Episodes.Title: Colluding with the Kui Tribe
Episodes.Description: Xu Qi An and the Night Guardians investigate Sangbo Lake. They find a formation underwater...

Episodes.Title: Male Escort
Episodes.Description: Wei Yuan takes Xu Qi An to the palace. He wants him to find Princess Royal to proceed with the investigation. Huai Qing's personal eunuch comes to lead the way. He asks him about his relationship with Princess Lin An...

Episodes.Title: The Spirit Dragon
Episodes.Description: Huai Qing tells Xu Qi An the story of Princess Ping Yang, who has fled her arranged marriage and run away from home. Meanwhile, Lin An is frustrated over how Xu Qi An has chosen to serve Huai Qing instead.

Episodes.Title: Annihilation
Episodes.Description: Xu Qi An reports to Wei Yuan that the clues he discovers are pointing towards Qinglong Hall. Tiandi Society's No. 6, Heng Yuan is also missing.

Episodes.Title: Formidable Foe
Episodes.Description: Yang Qian Huan teams up with four Gold Guardians to fend off Heng Hui. Heng Hui is devoured by the demonic arm. He escapes after receiving a devastating blow. Yang Qian Huan knows that Xu Qi An, the main investigator of the case, is quite capable. He thinks of him as a formidable foe.

Episodes.Title: Survival
Episodes.Description: Officials of the imperial court are fighting for the position of Minister of War. Wei Yuan gives up on the opportunity and asks for Xu Qi An to be spared.

Episodes.Title: Actions Speak Louder than Words
Episodes.Description: Xu Qi An encourages Lin An to pursue her freedom, and it motivates her.

Episodes.Title: Revenge
Episodes.Description: The news of Xu Qi An's sacrifice on the battlefield reaches the capital, and the officials turns down the request to honor him with a posthumous title.

Episodes.Title: Mysterious Person
Episodes.Description: Xu Qi An analyzes Shen Shu's origin and realizes that he has been caught in a conspiracy.

Episodes.Title: 3,000-li Massacre
Episodes.Description: Wei Yuan reports the rumor of a 3,000-li massacre. Emperor Yuanjing is shocked and alarmed.

Episodes.Title: A Determined Heart
Episodes.Description: Xu Xin Nian and Xu Qi An arrive at the designated location to meet Wang Si Mu. Wang Si Mu agrees to Xu Qi An's request to enter the Ministry of Personnel.

Episodes.Title: The Confidential Letters
Episodes.Description: Wei Yuan gives Xu Qi An the confidential letters containing evidence of corruption and malpractice committed by Duke Cao and other unaffiliated officials. If the Wang faction presents them to the Emperor, it could help Wang Zhen Wen overcome his crisis.

Episodes.Title: Empty Names
Episodes.Description: Xu Qi An and Su Su enter the Ministry of Personnel to look at the files. He finds a blank space in the file where the name should be. Xu Qi An realizes that there is an unimaginable force at work.

Episodes.Title: Engaging the Celestial Realm
Episodes.Description: Nangong Qian Rou finds Xu Qi An. She tells him that His Majesty had ordered him to engage the dharma statue as Dafeng's representative. Xu Qi An worries that the Imperial Astronomer has found out about Shen Shu, who's inside his body at the moment.

Episodes.Title: The Battle of the Celestial Realm
Episodes.Description: The battle begins. Everyone is here to witness this battle with the Celestial Realm. Xu Qi An dones on his battlesuit and walks out of the Imperial Observatory.

Episodes.Title: Illusion
Episodes.Description: Xu Qi An falls into an illusion. Du Ku shows up and asks Xu Qi An the meaning of his life. He tells him that it's better to live in despair. In return, Xu Qi An asks Du Ku the meaning of his life and it challenges his resolve.

Episodes.Title: Departing for Chuzhou
Episodes.Description: The Emperor appoints Xu Qi An as the chief investigator to travel to Chuzhou and investigate the holocaust case. Xu Qi An uses the jade mirror to contact Li Miao Zhen and asks for her assistance. They travel north together.

Episodes.Title: Attacked on the Ship
Episodes.Description: Xu Qi An realizes that Mu Nan Zhi is on the ship with them. He predicts that Mu Nan Zhi is a member of Lord of the North's Residence. He also speculates that they will encounter an ambush.

Episodes.Title: The Culprit
Episodes.Description: Xu Qi An finds out that the Lord of the North is the real culprit behind the holocaust case from his spy.

Episodes.Title: Just Deserts
Episodes.Description: Jili Zhigu wages war against Lord of the North, but is knocked to the ground. At this moment, Xu Qi An appears and announces the crimes of Lord of the North to the masses.

Episodes.Title: Uphold Justice
Episodes.Description: Xu Qi An advices Emperor Yuan Jing to uphold justice for the people of Chuzhou by convicting the Lord of the North. But Emperor Yuan Jing asks everyone to leave.

Episodes.Title: Fighting for Justice
Episodes.Description: On the court, the imperial relatives try to twist the facts, making it so that Lord of the North is a hero of the state as he sacrificed himself to defend the state. Zheng Xing Huai insists on fighting for justice.

Episodes.Title: A Clear Conscience
Episodes.Description: Zheng Xing Huai is executed. When Xu Qi An finds out, he arrives at the palace gate. Wei Yuan advices Xu Qi An that it's not the right time and asks him to go back.

Episodes.Title: Legend of Dafeng
Episodes.Description: Xu Qi An makes Que Yong Xiu confess that Lord of the North massacred the city. The Imperial Guards arrive at the scene. Tiandi Society and the Night Guardians show up to stop them.

Entries.Title: The Princess Royal
Entries.Description: Because of political reasons, princess Li Rong and Pei Wenxuan got married at the age of 18. In the end they drifted further and further afar from each other. After 20 years of a loveless marriage, they were manipulated into turning against each other, leading to their deaths. However, they wake up back at 18, before their marriage, facing the hardest time of their lives. The two of them are given second change together, to save those around them.

Episodes.Title: Reborn
Episodes.Description: Princess Royal Li Rong and Prime Minister Pei Wen Xuan are husband and wife, but they're not in a harmonious state. They also have different political views. Emperor Li Chuan of the Great Xia is in danger of death due to elixir poisoning, and it's urgent to appoint a crown prince. Li Rong advocates that the son of Empress Shangguan Ya be the crown prince, while Pei Wen Xuan insists on supporting the son of Concubine Qin Zhen Zhen to inherit the throne. The two, who have been living separately, will be at loggerheads again because of this matter when they meet.

Episodes.Title: The Spring Banquet
Episodes.Description: Returning to her 18-year-old self, Li Rong intends to use the Spring Banquet to choose a prince consort again. Despite her previous entanglements with Pei Wen Xuan, she now sees him as nothing more than an inexperienced young man under 20. Thus, she plans to tease him a little for her amusement.

Episodes.Title: Assassination
Episodes.Description: Li Rong and Pei Wen Xuan test each other and arrive at the same conclusion, the other person has also come back in time. Both of them stop hiding their pasts and think there is no need to repeat their past mistakes. Pei Wen Xuan no longer suggests being the prince consort and even explains the best prince consort candidate to Li Rong.

Episodes.Title: Consensus
Episodes.Description: The next morning, Li Chuan and Su Rong Qing, who serves as the Vice Minister of Justice, lead a group of men to find Li Rong and Pei Wen Xuan. Just having learned that the one who killed her was Su Rong Qing, Li Rong feels a mix of guilt and conflicted emotions upon seeing him again.

Episodes.Title: Test
Episodes.Description: Pei Wen Xuan has just left Qionghua Palace when he is summoned to the Imperial Study by Li Ming. Yang Quan is already waiting there, his eyes burning with envy at the sight of Pei Wen Xuan. Despite Pei Wen Xuan's sarcastic remarks, Yang Quan has no choice but to implore Li Ming to grant his marriage to Li Rong. However, Li Ming remains indifferent.

Episodes.Title: Investigating the Yang Family
