Episodes.Description: Pei Wen Xuan takes advantage of the situation to file a report on Yang Quan to Li Ming. After Yang Quan fails to kidnap the princess, he assassinates a court official. Moreover, he continues to get defeated on the northwest battlefield. Wen Xuan voices out that there's something fishy going on. Li Ming takes that opportunity to promote Pei Wen Xuan to a censor and asks him to investigate the Yang family.

Episodes.Title: Imprisonment
Episodes.Description: Li Rong and Pei Wen Xuan argue frequently, their bickering a daily occurrence, yet they exhibit perfect harmony when it comes to strategy. While investigating the Yang family, they simultaneously begin amassing military strength for the crown prince. In a display of tacit understanding, they temporarily set aside their past grievances involving Qin Zhen Zhen and travel together to Jiulu Mountain, seeking to enlist the help of Qin Zhen Zhen’s brother, the brave General Qin Lin, who has been living in seclusion in the mountains.

Episodes.Title: Coming to Terms
Episodes.Description: After Li Rong is imprisoned, Liu Chuan visits her in prison. A lady was following him. It turns out that the lady is Qin Zhen Zhen. Pei Wen Xuan thought that Qin Zhen Zhen canceled the marriage because her family forced her to do so. However, Qin Zhen Zhen says that she did so of her own accord.

Episodes.Title: Getting Married
Episodes.Description: To promote Prince Su, Li Ming decides to send Consort Rou's brother, Xiao Su, to the frontline to replace Li Chuan. A day before the wedding, Pei Wen Xuan hands out red envelopes to other officials. And Su Rong Qing shows up unexpectedly.

Episodes.Title: Join Hands
Episodes.Description: On their wedding night, Li Rong and Pei Wen Xuan can't sleep well. Instead, they discuss plans for after their divorce. Pei Wen Xuan deliberately arranges for Su Rong Qing to pick her up during their wedding day, while Li Rong is also thinking about how to stop Qin Zhen Zhen from entering the palace.

Episodes.Title: Qixi Festival Banquet
Episodes.Description: Li Chuan musters enough courage and heads to Jiulu Mountain to confess to Qin Zhen Zhen. The Qixi Festival Banquet begins. Pei Wen Xuan receives news that Consort Rou held an incense-making contest for the ladies to help her niece, Xiao Wei, enter the Eastern Palace.

Episodes.Title: Reconciliation
Episodes.Description: Pei Wen Xuan expresses that Li Rong was the only person he loved in the past. He never had any feelings for Qin Zhen Zhen. Li Rong becomes speechless, and she chooses to avoid him. Her cold attitude chills Pei Wen Xuan's heart.

Episodes.Title: Inspectorate
Episodes.Description: Pei Wen Xuan suggests to Li Rong that she establish the Inspectorate, leaving Li Rong in a dilemma. Qin Zhen Zhen is grateful to Li Rong for saving her life, while Li Rong plans for Qin Zhen Zhen to live on under the identity of a guard, Xun Chuan.

Episodes.Title: Targeted
Episodes.Description: Li Rong orders Xun Chuan to find the veterans and obtain their testimonies. At the same time, she intends to acquire information from the Ministry of Justice. Pei Wen Xuan was bullied in the Censorate as he went against the noble families. He has to work overtime day after day.

Episodes.Title: Prince Consort
Episodes.Description: Su Rong Qing is happy when Li Rong invites him to a meal. He goes to the restaurant, but Li Rong doesn't appear. He is sad. Su Rong Hua knows Su Rong Qing is sad, so they get drunk together. Back at home, Li Rong helps Pei Wen Xuan dress his wounds. Both of them have a heart-to-heart talk. Pei Wen Xuan feels very touched and sleeps with Li Rong in his arms.

Episodes.Title: Eliminate the Witnesses
Episodes.Description: Upon returning to Pei's Residence, Pei Wen Xuan and Li Rong engage in a fierce argument to reclaim the inheritance left by Pei Wen Xuan's father, only to be met with adamant refusal from Pei Li Xian and their other relatives. At a crucial moment, the timid Madam Wen, inspired by Li Rong's unwavering support, finds her voice and boldly denounces the Pei family members for their ungratefulness.

Episodes.Title: Escape Plan
Episodes.Description: With no other options, Li Rong secretly sends Pei Wen Xuan out of the capital to gather evidence. He has to return before the scheduled execution of the Qin family. Li Rong, under immense pressure, rescues the Qin family from the Ministry of Justice and shelters them in her residence, while Su Rong Qing arrives to intervene.

Episodes.Title: Disappointed Return
Episodes.Description: At the execution site, the noble families keep applying pressure on Li Ming. Just when Li Ming is about to execute them, Pei Wen Xuan finally returns with the evidence.

Episodes.Title: Best Friends
Episodes.Description: Li Rong solves the case and becomes the Head Inspector of the Inspectorate. The Inspectorate is established officially. At the same time, Li Ming assigned Su Rong Hua as the Vice Inspector to control Li Rong.

Episodes.Title: Butterfly Canyon
Episodes.Description: Upon learning of the prince consort's assassination, Li Rong is consumed by fury. She vows to bring the perpetrators to justice. Disguising her true intentions as a simple outing, Li Rong decides to use herself as bait to lure the assassins out of hiding.

Episodes.Title: Unresolved Feelings
Episodes.Description: Li Rong uncovers the identity of the assassin leader and learns about the mastermind behind. Li Rong proposes a deal with Lin Fei Bai to assassinate Xie Lan Qing instead. Lin Fei Bai finds himself in a dilemma.

Episodes.Title: Past
Episodes.Description: The next morning at the imperial court, Xie Lan Qing brings Lin Fei Bai to accuse Li Rong of an assassination attempt according to Su Rong Qing's instructions but it backfires when Li Rong counters his accusation.

Episodes.Title: Lunar New Year
Episodes.Description: Lin Fei Bai was sentenced to military exile to the southwest border. Before his departure, Shangguan Ya goes to see him off. The intensity of their conflict was greatly reduced. Before Lin Fei Bai's departure, Shangguan Ya gives him a set of Leaf Cards, forming an affinity between them.

Episodes.Title: Sabotage
Episodes.Description: With the supplementary examination approaching, Pei Wen Xuan is determined not to be outdone and is pulling out all the stops to attract scholars, engaging in a competition with Su Rong Qing. Unexpectedly, Su Rong Qing’s enthusiastic efforts to host scholars from all over the country seem to have an ulterior motive.

Episodes.Title: Flower Boat
Episodes.Description: Li Rong and Pei Wen Xuan make decisive choices, using their past investigations to come up with countermeasures. But they feel that Consort Rou alone cannot come up with such plots. However, she's familiar with the delay of Crown Prince's wedding. They realize that Su Rong Qing taught Li Rong that idea in their past life. Only then did they realize that Su Rong Qing was...

Episodes.Title: Fire at the Hall of Memorials
Episodes.Description: Pei Wen Xuan decides to pretend to divorce Li Rong and uses the opportunity to point out that the marriage talisman was forged by Consort Rou, in order to alleviate Li Ming's suspicions.

Episodes.Title: Tense Situation
Episodes.Description: Li Rong and Su Rong Qing confront each other in front of Li Ming at the imperial study. With Hong De's suicide and his son's disappearance, Li Ming suspects Su Rong Qing. Li Ming questions Su Rong Qing if he is the culprit.

Episodes.Title: Appreciation Gift
Episodes.Description: Pei Wen Xuan asks Li Rong out on a date during her off day. But Li Rong has promised Cui Yu Lang that they'll discuss the imperial examination case on her off day. So, she rejects Pei Wen Xuan. Pei Wen Xuan becomes suspicious and decides to follow Li Rong.

Episodes.Title: Caught in a Difficult Situation
Episodes.Description: Li Rong plays along and reveals to Consort Rou her intention to hand over control of the Inspectorate. Meanwhile, Consort Rou hints that since Li Rong and Pei Wen xuan are divorced, it would be best for them to meet less frequently. It seems Consort Rou has discovered their secret meetings, making Li Rong feel threatened.

Episodes.Title: Decisive Actions
Episodes.Description: Consort Rou is in charge of investigating the examination fraud case. She's in trouble as the noble families make things difficult for her. Li Ming suggests her to use Pei Wen Xuan. Pei Wen Xuan acts as if he's loyal to the emperor. Consort Rou is happy with his performance. She has no idea that Pei Wen Xuan has ulterior motives.

Episodes.Title: Tool
Episodes.Description: Li Rong waits patiently for the conflict between Consort Rou and the noble families to reach its climax. After that, she arranges for Chen Hou Zhao to return to the capital. She prepares evidence and threats of Consort Rou's threats to dissuade students from filing complaints, launching a vigorous counterattack in court and defeating Consort Rou in one fell swoop.

Episodes.Title: Severe Ties
Episodes.Description: Feeling desolate after losing Consort Rou, Li Ming summons Xiao Qian to the palace. Upon hearing this, Li Rong deduces that Li Ming intends to recall the troops to the capital.

Episodes.Title: Winter Celebration
Episodes.Description: Li Ming proposes to hold a Winter Celebration, hoping to make a final stand at the banquet. During the banquet, everyone has their own schemes. Lin Fei Bai and Su Rong Hua compete in a lion dance fight as a performance. But they are actually fighting against each other as love rivals over Shangguan Ya. The fight is fierce and intense. In the end, both are injured.

Episodes.Title: Past
Episodes.Description: In the past, Su Rong Qing did not kill Li Rong. He gave Pei Wen Xuan a fragrance pouch to slow down the poison of Fragrant Beauty. It means Li Rong was already poisoned before she fell ill. Li Rong never expects that instead of her husband, who has opposed her for decades, and Su Rong Qing, who has a deep grudge against her, it is her brother, Li Chuan, who wants to harm her.

Episodes.Title: Corrupt Policies
Episodes.Description: Li Cheng dies from poisoning. Xiao Qian brings in Li Cheng's double and burns his corpse.

Episodes.Title: Truth
Episodes.Description: Pei Wen Xuan knows Li Rong's issue has been resolved and guides her patiently. He tells her the truth about the past and hopes Li Rong can untie the knot in her heart.

Episodes.Title: Dream
Episodes.Description: Li Rong sees Li Chuan again. They reminisce about the past together. Li Chuan says that his wish is to embark on a northern expedition as his mother said that the northern part was plagued by war. If they lose the war, Li Rong, his eldest sister, will be sent there to establish a marriage alliance.

Episodes.Title: Regime Change
Episodes.Description: With the regime undergoing a major shift, the fate of Pei Wen Xuan's family hinges on who holds the family master's token and the key to the treasury.

Episodes.Title: Confrontation
Episodes.Description: Li Rong heads to the grand hall alone to confront the soldiers of the noble families. Su Rong Qing and the soldiers of the Su family arrive at the grand hall. They thought that Li Chuan would be in the hall, but instead, it was Li Rong.

Episodes.Title: Spend the Rest of Youth Together
Episodes.Description: When the crown prince attacks the capital with Xun Chuan's troops, Consort Rou enters the palace and abducts Li Ming. She was shot to death with an arrow. Su Rong Qing realizes he is at a disadvantage and goes to find the emperor's dying edict. Pei Wen Xuan pursues him and they fight each other.

Entries.Title: The Story of Pearl Girl
Entries.Description: After narrowly escaping an abusive pearl farm, a young woman with unmatched talent carves out her own fate as treachery meets the world of jewelry.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Raised in torture and abuse, Duanwu risks her life every day harvesting pearls from the sea — but one daunting task offers her a slim chance of freedom.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Duanwu's performance dazzles the guests at the pearl auction. As she plots a path to a new life, a sudden turn of events exposes a buried secret.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: In a state of panic, Cui Ding devises a plan to flee with his wealth. Meanwhile, Yan Zijing sees an opportunity to exact his revenge.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Duanwu sees an opportunity in discarded gemstone scraps. A heated encounter unfolds between her and Cui Shijiu at Yan Zijing's poetry contest.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: By helping Yan Zijing, Duanwu earns a chance to sell gemstone scraps in town. However, her first business venture quickly faces bitter setbacks.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: A meeting further stokes Cui Shijiu's fury toward Yan Zijing. Hoping to make a sale, Duanwu resorts to a scheme that she later regrets.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: As a challenge from Cui Shijiu threatens Yan Zijing's business in Guangzhou, Duanwu steps up and confronts dangerous trials.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: While Duanwu's jewelry gains traction in the market, Zhang Jinran's investigation leads him to seek shelter in Yan Zijing's fleet.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: A sudden surprise derails Duanwu's crucial business client meeting, leaving her and Yan Zijing scrambling to address the consequences.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: With Yan Zijing away, Duanwu must take the lead to protect the wealth of his fleet — especially the prized pearls set to be sold at auction.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: A scroll raises questions about the identity of Duanwu's birth father. To save her family, Cui Shijiu agrees to an arranged marriage.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: On his visit to a renowned jeweler, Yan Zijing notices something unusual about her. Meanwhile, a sinister conspiracy lurks within the Yue family.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: A brutal truth from Yue Yunxiu's dad leaves Yan Zijing devastated. Cui Shijiu, desperate to redeem herself, seeks help from a banished family member.

Episodes.Title: Episode 14
Episodes.Description: As a mysterious ailment looms over the Cui family, Yan Zijing sets out on a journey to the west. Zhang Jinran has a heartfelt talk with Duanwu.

Episodes.Title: Episode 15
Episodes.Description: Cui Shijiu makes a devious move against Yan Zijing—a desperate act that triggers a treacherous fight for his priceless jewels.

Episodes.Title: Episode 16
Episodes.Description: Duanwu and Cui Shijiu seize a chance to escape. Meanwhile, Zhang Jinran visits Cui Ba to rescue Yan Zijing and his crew.

Episodes.Title: Episode 17
Episodes.Description: While his bond with Duanwu grows deeper, Yan Zijing gets closer to the bandits who destroyed his family. Zhang Jinran visits a general for military aid.

Episodes.Title: Episode 18
Episodes.Description: After racing to rescue a loved one in trouble, Yan Zijing faces a vicious ambush that could wipe out everything he's built.

Episodes.Title: Episode 19
Episodes.Description: Duanwu, wounded and distraught, tries to make sense of the deadly ambush. Taking shelter at a suspicious inn, she unexpectedly stumbles into a reunion.

Episodes.Title: Episode 20
Episodes.Description: As Cui Shijiu hits rock bottom, her family also faces serious trouble. Meanwhile, Duanwu's search for Yan Zijing leads her to Yangzhou.

Episodes.Title: Episode 21
Episodes.Description: Hoping to promote her jewelry, Duanwu tries to approach Yangzhou's socialites and performers. But Yan Zijing is also vying for their attention.

Episodes.Title: Episode 22
Episodes.Description: Huan Lang receives a lucrative offer from Yan Zijing. Soon after, the competition heats up among Yangzhou's top performers.

Episodes.Title: Episode 23
Episodes.Description: Yangzhou's talent go all out to shine on a career-making stage, but some performances don't go as planned. Su Muzhe's risky bet pays off.

Episodes.Title: Episode 24
Episodes.Description: Cui Shijiu approaches Su Muzhe to form an alliance. Concerned about a damaged royal artifact, the Zheng family reluctantly turns to Yan Zijing for help.

Episodes.Title: Episode 25
Episodes.Description: Huan Lang receives an emotional plea from her ex-fiance. Su Muzhe's shop becomes the target of a shadowy conspiracy.

Episodes.Title: Episode 26
Episodes.Description: A murder investigation leads Zhang Jinran to a shocking discovery. To prove her innocence, Su Muzhe must find a way to collaborate with Zheng Zhiheng.

Episodes.Title: Episode 27
Episodes.Description: While Su Muzhe's fate hinges on the outcome of a public trial, Zhang Jinran and Yan Zijing are determined to help her through the crisis.

Episodes.Title: Episode 28
Episodes.Description: An uninvited guest shows up at Huan Lang's funeral and sows discord, sparking an unprecedented crisis for Su Muzhe's business.

Episodes.Title: Episode 29
Episodes.Description: Zheng Zhiheng threatens to withdraw his investment from Su Muzhe's liquidated business. Yan Zijing faces another deadly trap.

Episodes.Title: Episode 30
Episodes.Description: Su Muzhe shows compassion to a wounded Yan Zijing. As her business struggles, Cui Shijiu scores a victory in her revenge plan.

Episodes.Title: Episode 31
Episodes.Description: Su Muzhe's new jewelry becomes an instant hit on the market, prompting her competitors to hatch a sabotage campaign.

Episodes.Title: Episode 32
Episodes.Description: Zhang Jinran interrogates Cui Shijiu over a suspicious discovery in her inventory. Xu Nanying plots a secret move from prison.

Episodes.Title: Episode 33
Episodes.Description: Su Muzhe's team reaches a breakthrough in manufacturing techniques. Meanwhile, Yangzhou's jewelry dealers battle to impress a discerning buyer.

Episodes.Title: Episode 34
Episodes.Description: Kang Ming's choice of supplier causes upheaval in the Yangzhou jewelry market. The Zheng family must tackle a shortage of essential materials.

Episodes.Title: Episode 35
Episodes.Description: Zhang Jinran faces numerous challenges in his investigation. As Zheng Zhiheng's life hangs in the balance, his father presents him with a tough choice.

Episodes.Title: Episode 36
Episodes.Description: An esteemed guest sparks a design idea for Su Muzhe. In the meantime, Zheng Shiyuan vows to exact revenge for his son.

Episodes.Title: Episode 37
Episodes.Description: Zhang Jinran and Yan Zijing scramble to locate Su Muzhe. A startling revelation gives Yan Zijing a bitter dose of reality.

Episodes.Title: Episode 38
Episodes.Description: A grieving Cui Shijiu plots her revenge against Zheng Shiyuan — a move that leads to a reconciliation with a longtime enemy.

Episodes.Title: Episode 39
Episodes.Description: Just as Zhang Jinran gets an opportunity to hold Yuchi Wuyi accountable, the poison afflicting Yan Zijing threatens to claim his life.

Episodes.Title: Episode 40
Episodes.Description: With his lifelong dream fulfilled, Yan Zijing must face a harsh reality. Su Muzhe unveils a showstopper at a prestigious jewelry contest.

Entries.Title: The Double
Entries.Description: Xue Fangfei, the daughter of a well-off county magistrate lost everything after a major upheaval. Saved by Jiang Li, the daughter of the Secretariat Director, she took on the identity of Jiang Li and returned to the capital.  With the help of Duke Xiao Heng and others, she overcame numerous hardships, tirelessly fought against injustice, rescued her father who had been wrongly imprisoned, assisted Xiao Heng in upholding justice, protecting the common people, and ultimately regained a beautiful life.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Framed for having an affair, Xue Fangfei faces a deadly betrayal from her husband. On the brink of despair, an encounter reignites her will to live.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Tong'er confronts Fangfei about her audacious plan to avenge Jiang Li. Soon after, they begin to hatch a scheme to escape their current residence.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: As Fangfei reaches the Jiang residence under her new identity, she faces distrust and sabotage from Jiang Li's stepmother.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Triggered by someone from her previous life, Fangfei reveals a secret to Tong'er. Later, a display of vulnerability helps her connect with Jiang Yuanbai.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Fangfei faces a series of schemes as an important coming-of-age ceremony approaches. Meanwhile, Xiao Heng grows suspicious about Fangfei's true identity.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Fangfei is blamed for causing Jiang Ruoyao's allergy. In an attempt to get rid of her, Ji Shuran tries to arrange a marriage for Fangfei.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Hoping to join the ranks of a school for talented youths, Fangfei must confront Shen Yurong in Jiang Li's identity.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: While trying to de-escalate Meng Hongjin and Ye Shijie's argument, Fangfei gets into more trouble — but her kind acts earn her several study partners.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: As a bet against Hongjin threatens Fangfei's future, she must rally support and help. Xiao Heng seeks out an unusual doctor to treat Fangfei's old injury.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: The annual exam kicks off, and Fangfei's team faces four grueling tests that will determine the fate of their high-stakes bet.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: Fangfei faces off against Ruoyao in a music showdown. Following their consummate performances, the judges must vote to decide the ultimate winner.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Fangfei's triumph in the annual exam not only garners widespread recognition, but also the affection of some colleagues and an audience with the emperor.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: At the royal banquet, a scheme to destroy Fangfei's reputation quietly brews. Meanwhile, Jiang Yu'e finds an opportunity to be with someone she admires.

Episodes.Title: Episode 14
Episodes.Description: After the fallout with the Jiang sisters, Fangfei plans to visit the Ye family in Luyang. Later, a favor for Xiao Heng puts her in unexpected danger.

Episodes.Title: Episode 15
Episodes.Description: At the Ye family's home, Fangfei is greeted with Ye Jia'er's reluctant hospitality. But Jia'er soon notices that Fangfei is no ordinary relative.

Episodes.Title: Episode 16
Episodes.Description: Fangfei steps up to defuse a crisis targeting the Ye family before enlisting her uncle to find out who's behind the deadly scheme.

Episodes.Title: Episode 17
Episodes.Description: Having lost his bet, Lai Biao discloses a crucial lead to Fangfei. Meanwhile, the Ye family faces an exorbitant demand for the release of Ye Mingxuan.

Episodes.Title: Episode 18
Episodes.Description: Fangfei shares a cherished moment with Xiao Heng after making a bold confession. Later, Qiongzhi's shocking revelation gives Fangfei a new mission.

Episodes.Title: Episode 19
Episodes.Description: Fangfei finds herself in danger on her way to meet a long-lost acquaintance. As more clues about Xue Huaiyuan surface, she proposes a deal to Xiao Heng.

Episodes.Title: Episode 20
Episodes.Description: Defying danger, Xiao Heng helps Fangfei rescue Xue Huaiyuan's followers before she faces off against the man who tortured her father for years.

Episodes.Title: Episode 21
Episodes.Description: Fangfei faces numerous obstacles on her way escorting Xue Huaiyuan to the capital. A devastating famine places their convoy in the chaos of mobs.

Episodes.Title: Episode 22
Episodes.Description: Trapped in the city by mobs, Fangfei notices that someone is orchestrating the riot. She — and the Jiang family — are now targets of an insidious plan.

Episodes.Title: Episode 23
Episodes.Description: Xiao Heng visits Fangfei in prison before she's briefly brought home. On the imperial trial day, she makes an audacious request before the emperor.

Episodes.Title: Episode 24
Episodes.Description: Princess Wanning's serious accusation threatens to blow Fangfei's cover. After the trial, Shen Yurong finds himself lost in memories of his ex-wife.

Episodes.Title: Episode 25
Episodes.Description: While scheming to get rid of Fangfei, Ji Shuran unexpectedly runs into an old lover. Meanwhile, Yu'e endures a harsh reality in her married life.

Episodes.Title: Episode 26
Episodes.Description: Fangfei's defiant act causes a disturbance in front of the Jiang family. Amidst their confrontation, danger sneaks up on both Ruoyao and Fangfei.

Episodes.Title: Episode 27
Episodes.Description: Ruoyao's blunt rejection of marriage stuns her parents. Soon after, Ji Shuran confronts Ji Yanlin about her wretched past.

Episodes.Title: Episode 28
Episodes.Description: Ruoyao's sudden illness requires an unusual treatment. The Jiang family witnesses an exorcism ritual spiral out of control.

Episodes.Title: Episode 29
Episodes.Description: While Ji Shuran faces the grave consequences of her years of misconduct, Fangfei must grapple with a devastating loss herself.

Episodes.Title: Episode 30
Episodes.Description: Fangfei steps into her new role as an imperial performer. An encounter with Shen Yurong stirs conflicted emotions in both of them.

Episodes.Title: Episode 31
Episodes.Description: Hoping to find Fangfei a music partner, Shen Yurong gets himself in a sticky situation. Wanning grows increasingly worried about her husband's loyalty.

Episodes.Title: Episode 32
Episodes.Description: At his family banquet, Shen Yurong confronts Fangfei about her real identity and unwittingly ignites a cascade of seismic problems.

Episodes.Title: Episode 33
Episodes.Description: After a heartbreaking reunion, Fangfei must weigh a treacherous bargain with Wanning — a deal that could land her in grave peril.

Episodes.Title: Episode 34
Episodes.Description: While Fangfei and the Jiang family reel from an imperial marriage mandate, Xiao Heng makes a heartfelt confession about his true feelings for her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 35
Episodes.Description: A startling turn of events pushes Wanning to pursue the consort she wants. Meanwhile, Xiao Heng is pressured to enter into a diplomatic marriage.

Episodes.Title: Episode 36
Episodes.Description: As Wanning reluctantly marries into the Li family, Xiao Heng has to seek a major favor from Jiuyue. Fangfei meets with General Xiao for the first time.

Episodes.Title: Episode 37
Episodes.Description: With Fangfei's help, Xiao Heng finds an opportunity to make amends with his estranged dad. Wanning and Li Jin's newlywed life takes a tumultuous turn.

Episodes.Title: Episode 38
Episodes.Description: As a crisis looms over the regime, members of the Jiang and Shen families must reassess their loyalty and strategize for their survival.

Episodes.Title: Episode 39
Episodes.Description: Imprisoned by Wanning, Fangfei gets a surprise visitor. Amidst a violent coup, Shen Yurong and Xiao Heng's tension reaches a boiling point.

Episodes.Title: Episode 40
Episodes.Description: As Xiao Heng's life hangs by a thread, Fangfei risks her own safety to join him and face off against an unhinged Shen Yurong.

Entries.Title: Fangs of Fortune
Entries.Description:
During the Zhenyuan era, the accidental death of the Bai Ze goddess, who governed both human and demon realms, leads to chaos as demon beasts run rampant. Disguised as Zhao Yuanzhou, the demon leader Zhu Yan offers to form a demon-hunting bureau to help restore order.

Wen Xiao, suspicious of Zhao Yuanzhou, joins the bureau along with her childhood friend Zhuo Yichen, skilled archer Pei Sijing, and the talented but timid doctor Bai Jiu. Together, they confront the creatures from "The Classic of Mountains and Seas" and uncover the darker truths behind the chaos.

Entries.Title: The Spirealm
Entries.Description: Jiu Shi’s skills are pushed to the edge as he faces life-or-death challenges inside a brutal VR maze.

Episodes.Title: Snow Village (1)
Episodes.Description: Ling Jiushi, a VR game designer, decided to resign due to the frustrations at work. A beta game named "Spirit Realm" helped him forget his worries. Just when he was struggling to find the complete version of the game, he unexpectedly received a game disc sent from abroad. After a car accident, he found himself in a corridor with twelve iron doors. Entering through one of the doors, a mysterious person helped him escape from the clutches of wolves in the forest and snow-capped mountains and welcomed him to the world behind the doors.

Episodes.Title: Snow Village (2)
Episodes.Description: Ling Jiushi helped the injured mysterious person enter the inn in the village to take a rest. He learned from a man named Xiong Qi that in order to leave this game world, one must solve puzzles and find the key. The mysterious person claimed to be named Ruan Baijie. He warned Ling Jiushi not to tell his real name, but Ling Jiushi didn't listen. That night, a player was killed by a woman in white. Everyone learned that the cause of his death was violating the taboos inside the door. In order to find the key, everyone agreed to the village head's request to ask a carpenter to make a coffin, which should be related to the key.

Episodes.Title: Snow Village (3)
Episodes.Description: On the way to the carpenter's house, Ling Jiushi noticed that every household in the village had a well. Originally, these wells were the entrances to the caves dug to avoid wolf disasters. But now a monster had emerged, so they had no choice but to seal up the wellheads. To make coffins, the carpenter asked everyone to go up the mountain to cut down trees. The innkeeper reminded the three of them that carrying the trees together would save their strength. Unexpectedly, this move attracted the attack of a female monster. Ruan Baijie asked everyone to change to the method of dragging the trees instead, and finally they returned to the village safely. Then the innkeeper suggested that everyone should enter the ancestral hall in the village one by one to pay their respects. Ling and Ruan went in and out together and managed to escape disaster.

Entries.Title: Love Game in Eastern Fantasy
Entries.Description: Pulled into the pages of a fantasy novel, a woman is shocked to find herself stuck in the role of a villain. Now, she must battle to rewrite her destiny.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: After being transported to another world and turning into a minor villain, Ling Miao Miao meets Lin Lu Shan, who looks just like her father.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Mu Sheng becomes suspicious of Ling Miao Miao. After Ling Miao Miao figures out how to change Mu Yao's treatment, saving her life, they become friends.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Ling Miao Miao helps Mu Yao and Liu Fu Yi, but the system forces her to work toward her task. Meanwhile, Mu Sheng grows increasingly suspicious.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: In order to return to the real world, Ling Miao Miao must earn Mu Sheng's trust and find a way to make him happy.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: At the lantern festival, Ling Miao Miao revives childhood memories for Mu Yao. Corruption comes to light when a fire breaks out at a granary.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: After resigning, Lin Lu Shan takes up a simpler life thanks to Ling Miao Miao. Mu Sheng keeps watch on Ling Miao Miao, in the hope of exposing her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Mu Sheng's demonic form is revealed when he is seriously injured, but Ling Miao Miao remains fearless. The Water Demon King escapes unnoticed.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Mu Sheng's feelings for Ling Miao Miao grow, leading to a romantic encounter under the moonlight.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Ling Miao Miao is determined to hone her sorcery skills. The protagonists investigate the Valley of the Lost and uncover Guo Xiu's deception.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: As the protagonists delve deeper into the Valley of the Lost, in an effort to break the spells, their worst fears come to life before them.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: Ling Miao Miao and Mu Sheng find villagers trapped in giant water bubbles. Mu Sheng saves Dou Ya's father, but suffers an unexpected attack.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: The water demon escapes, and Mu Yao hurries to help Ling Miao Miao and Mu Sheng. When Guo Xiu puts an end to the chaos, peace is restored.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: Ling Miao Miao recovers, only to receive a summons to the Bureau of Astronomy — she is determined not to allow Mu Sheng to fall into darkness.

Episodes.Title: Episode 14
Episodes.Description: The Four Heroes of the Bamboo Forest enter the capital. Ancient weapons in the Bureau of Astronomy stir, as a legendary demon hunter is set to emerge.

Episodes.Title: Episode 15
Episodes.Description: Ling Miao Miao and Mu Sheng find something suspicious. The Imperial Astronomer summons the four to share some news about the princess.

Episodes.Title: Episode 16
Episodes.Description: Mu Sheng remembers some key clues. The reason for the princess's nightmares is revealed, and she launches a fierce attack on Liu Fu Yi.

Episodes.Title: Episode 17
Episodes.Description: Upon learning the shocking truth, Ling Miao Miao decides to play matchmaker. Mu Yao enjoys a romantic moment that brings back memories.

Episodes.Title: Episode 18
Episodes.Description: The truth about the great fire leaves Mu Yao stunned. Mu Sheng loses control after seeing Ling Miao Miao make a startling decision.

Episodes.Title: Episode 19
Episodes.Description: Heartbroken, Fu Yi and Mu Sheng get drunk together. The Four Heroes of the Bamboo Forest have been torn apart—just as a great demon is awakening.

Episodes.Title: Episode 20
Episodes.Description: Ruo Shi makes a bold move to find out Miao Miao's thoughts, while Miao Miao finally confirms Mu Sheng's feelings for her. The princess seems possessed.

Episodes.Title: Episode 21
Episodes.Description: Mu Sheng opens up to Miao Miao, and the Four Heroes of the Bamboo Forest join forces. The protagonists learn of former concubine Zhao's past misdeeds.

Episodes.Title: Episode 22
Episodes.Description: Former concubine Zhao admits to mistakes. Miao Miao addresses a crisis, and Mu Sheng saves the day. The Imperial Astronomy Bureau predicts disaster.

Episodes.Title: Episode 23
Episodes.Description: Miao Miao loses her memories of before. The protagonists follow Liu Fu Yi back to the valley, and, along the way, Mu Sheng reveals his demon form.

Episodes.Title: Episode 24
Episodes.Description: Lu Huai An puts pressure on Mu Yao. After the protagonists witness a terrifying scene, it's up to Mu Sheng to prevent a cataclysmic disaster.

Episodes.Title: Episode 25
Episodes.Description: Lu Huai An makes a bet with Mu Sheng. For everyone's sake, Mu Sheng absolutely must regain his memory. Mu Yao and Liu Fu Yi head for Cainan.

Episodes.Title: Episode 26
Episodes.Description: Mu Yao learns of Liu Fu Yi's inner demons, and Liu Fu Yi makes a startling discovery. Miao Miao and Mu Sheng struggle to retrieve their lost memories.

Episodes.Title: Episode 27
Episodes.Description: Mu Sheng recalls a painful memory. Liu Fu Yi and Mu Yao get married. Later, Mu Yao hears a familiar voice in a dream.

Episodes.Title: Episode 28
Episodes.Description: Mu Sheng finds out his mother's true identity. Feeling that something is wrong, Mu Yao asks for help.

Episodes.Title: Episode 29
Episodes.Description: Aunt Liu wants to get her hands on a demon core. Miao Miao finally regains her memory. Shi Niang Zi reveals the truth and helps Mu Yao tackle a demon.

Episodes.Title: Episode 30
Episodes.Description: Liu Fu Yi is freed. Mu Sheng reconciles with his past. The protagonists celebrate the Spring Festival together, but Mu Yao has her own plan.

Episodes.Title: Episode 31
Episodes.Description: Despite the danger, Mu Yao enters the Demon Trap Tower to kill the demon of resentment. Other protagonists bravely storm the tower to rescue her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 32
Episodes.Description: Miaomiao and Mu Sheng are separated when facing the catastrophe of heaven. Will the two lovers ever meet again?

Entries.Title: The Legend of Heroes
Entries.Description: In the late Southern Song Dynasty, as the Jin forces invaded, the Guo and Yang families faced tragedy. Taoist Qiu Chuji and the Seven Freaks of Jiangnan bet to train their descendants in martial arts. Guo Jing and Yang Kang, growing up under different circumstances, face various challenges. Guo Jing and Huang Rong develop a relationship amid turmoil, while Yang Kang's actions affect those around him.

Entries.Title: Lavender Fields
Entries.Description: The life of a simple flower farm girl is shattered when she falls for a charming accountant, who turns out to be a married gun cartel member. Targeted for his stolen money, she loses everything she holds dear and reinvents herself to seek justice.

Episodes.Title: The Trust of the Innocent
Episodes.Description: Life at San Remo is a matter of quiet routine for Jasmin. But when she falls in love with Arthur, his dangerous secret threatens to ruin them both.

Episodes.Title: Breaking Hearts
Episodes.Description: Jasmin makes an unexpected discovery even as Arthur is nowhere to be found. Meanwhile, his life begins to unravel back at home.

Episodes.Title: Death and Deception
Episodes.Description: Jasmin searches for answers after seeing Arthur's parting gift, but Iris and her family hunt him down for their own reasons.

Episodes.Title: Searching for Answers
Episodes.Description: Hoping to get payback, Vittorio sends his men to search for Jasmin in San Remo. The cops start looking deeper into Tyrone's death.

Episodes.Title: In the Face of the Enemy
Episodes.Description: Jasmin comes to terms with the aftermath of her harrowing encounter with Iris. Zandro puzzles over the unusual details of Tyrone's case.

Episodes.Title: The Escape of Jasmin
Episodes.Description: On the run from Iris and the police, Jasmin gives birth while in hiding. But soon, she meets another misfortune — and an unexpected ally.

Episodes.Title: The Birth of Lavender Fields
Episodes.Description: Jasmin clumsily hits back at Iris, but Aster soon teaches her a better way to take revenge: by assuming a charming new persona called Lavender Fields.

Episodes.Title: The Woman in Sheep’s Clothing
Episodes.Description: An upcoming party offers Jasmin the chance to get to know her enemies. But first, she must infiltrate Iris' circle of friends under her new identity.

Episodes.Title: Familiar Foe
Episodes.Description: Zandro refuses to give up on finding the culprit behind Tyrone's case. At the party, Jasmin lands in trouble with one of Vittorio's hired guns.

Episodes.Title: The Investigation
Episodes.Description: Determined to find her child, Jasmin sneaks around Max's house to look for clues — only to have a brush with the cops. Zandro reveals his suspicions.

Episodes.Title: Long Lost Daughter
Episodes.Description: Jasmin does Iris a favor and doubles down on her identity as Lavender. Soon, she faces the consequences of her scrap with Max and her recent mission.

Episodes.Title: Getting Close
Episodes.Description: On a visit to Max's family, Lavender discovers the truth about Angel. Meanwhile, Zandro follows a trail of clues that implicates her old persona.

Episodes.Title: Befriending the Enemy
Episodes.Description: Petunia's insensitive blunder gives Lavender the opportunity to befriend Iris, who opens up to her. Zandro starts looking into Aster's company.

Episodes.Title: The Good and Bad Memories
Episodes.Description: Zandro tries to figure out how Aster is involved in his case. Iris looks back on her relationship with Tyrone while Lavender continues to win her over.

Episodes.Title: Suspecting Lavender
Episodes.Description: Zandro believes that Lavender is hiding something after observing her up close. But his clever attempt to gather information doesn't go as planned.

Episodes.Title: The Uninvited Guest
Episodes.Description: Lavender works on a party at Vittorio's house and looks for a way to take down the Buenavidez family and clear her name.

Episodes.Title: Hook, Line & Sink Her
Episodes.Description: Zandro recovers surprising evidence from the party and tries to piece things together. Meanwhile, the search for Jasmin intensifies.

Episodes.Title: Finding Jasmine Flores
Episodes.Description: As the hunt for Jasmin continues, Aster advises Lavender to lie low. Zandro defies orders. Iris has a tense encounter with a stranger.

Episodes.Title: The Fugitive in Distress
Episodes.Description: Iris follows a lead that could point her in the right direction, leaving Lavender strapped for time. Mira grows curious about Jasmin.

Episodes.Title: Identity Crisis
Episodes.Description: While Zandro continues to investigate Lavender, somebody else tries to unmask her. A vengeful Iris decides to locate Jasmin's daughter.

Episodes.Title: The Victim
Episodes.Description: Zandro catches Lavender off guard and presses her about her true identity. Iris plots her next move after her accomplices fail to find Jasmin.

Episodes.Title: Hospital Hunt
Episodes.Description: Trapped inside a hospital, Lavender comes clean to Zandro and desperately searches for a way out as Vittorio and Iris close in on her.

Episodes.Title: The Innocent and the Guilty
Episodes.Description: Jasmin learns Aster's true motive for helping her. Because of his discovery and removal from the case, Zandro believes Jasmin is innocent.

Episodes.Title: Only Hope
Episodes.Description: Gio gets in trouble at school after JP calls him the son of a murderer. Jasmin invites Zandro to meet at the Luxe Grand Terraces and asks for his help.

Episodes.Title: Unlikely Encounter
Episodes.Description: Jasmin tells Zandro that her family's fate is in the hands of the Buenavidez. Iris is unhappy with Heather's arrival, so leaves and meets someone new.

Episodes.Title: Friend or Foe
Episodes.Description: Jethro approaches Iris at a bar and invites her to go somewhere else. Zandro recalls when his wife met Tyrone, then calls Jasmin to arrange a meeting.

Episodes.Title: Student and Master
Episodes.Description: Zandro trains Jasmin and starts planning how to get into the Buenavidez's illegal business. Iris tries to find a connection between Jethro and Jasmin.

Episodes.Title: Who is Back?
Episodes.Description: The DNA test confirms one of the three girls is Jasmin's daughter. After abducting Jethro, Iris hunts for someone she thought was long dead.

Episodes.Title: The Raid
Episodes.Description: Iris convinces Jethro to tell her the truth about Jasmin, who has no choice but to give in. Lavender joins Zandro and Eric to raid a pier.

Episodes.Title: Smuggled
Episodes.Description: Heather joins Vittorio's underground business. Zandro and Agent Pascual blocked Iris's operations, while Jasmin tries to rescue Jethro.

Episodes.Title: Unlikely Help
Episodes.Description: Iris stands firm that Jasmin and Jethro are working together. Jasmin proposed a deal with Jethro. Tyrone recalls how he escaped death.

Episodes.Title: Double Trouble
Episodes.Description: Jasmin and Zandro plans how to entrap Iris, with Jethro's help. But Iris outwits them, which caused an action-filled encounter.

Episodes.Title: Two Faces
Episodes.Description: Lavender goes out with Iris, who treats Heather with a cold shoulder. Lavender finds a chance to approach Camilla. Iris received an unexpected call.

Episodes.Title: Haunted by the Past
Episodes.Description: Iris is worried about the news of Tyrone's return. Lavender considers the possibility that Camilla is her daughter. Tyrone travels back to Carvallo.

Episodes.Title: Cleaning Up the Mess
Episodes.Description: Zandro tells Jasmin the reason he's suspicious of Tyrone. Vittorio loses his temper and blames Iris and Harry over the thwarted operations.

Episodes.Title: Rebirth of the Dead
Episodes.Description: Jasmin gets to know Zandro more when he told her what happened to his family. Vittorio seems to favor Heather, so Iris despises her sister more.

Episodes.Title: Love and Lies
Episodes.Description: Tyrone meets with a woman from his past and asks for another chance to make things right. Zandro forms a deeper connection with Lavender.

Episodes.Title: The Return
Episodes.Description: Iris wants to believe that Tyrone has changed, but Lily is not convinced. Lavender reminds Zandro of his late wife. The DNA test results are now out.

Episodes.Title: A Mother's Yearning
Episodes.Description: Lavender gets a chance to be with Camilla. Aster and Zandro remind her not to be so obvious. Lance is more determined to leave the Buenavidezes.

Episodes.Title: The Traitors
Episodes.Description: Lance meets a familiar face, making Harry more suspicious of him. Zandro searches for evidence to prove the Buenavidezes' involvement in Carvallo Port.

Episodes.Title: The Good Intentions
Episodes.Description: Someone unexpectedly helps Lance escape death, with Lavender risking her own safety in the process. Iris wants to know Tyrone's intentions.

Episodes.Title: Episode 43
Episodes.Description: Tyrone faces a furious Vittorio, who puts his loyalty to the test. Lily realizes the dangers that her family might experience from the Buenavidezes.

Episodes.Title: Unthinkable
Episodes.Description: Tyrone proves his loyalty to the family. Iris reveals her reason for accepting Tyrone back into her life and later puts Heather in her place.

Episodes.Title: A Race to the Truth
Episodes.Description: Jasmin goes to the hospital to check on Lance, while Tyrone is already there in secret. The Buenavidezes goes into action to get to Lance first.

Episodes.Title: Duplicity
Episodes.Description: The Buenavidezes manage to silence Lance for good. Lavender comforts, Lily, leading to an argument with Zandro. Tyrone uses Iris to cover his tracks.

Episodes.Title: Fated Connection
Episodes.Description: Tyrone looks back on the past and realizes he was destined to meet Jasmin. Lavender comforts Camilla, who's grieving her father's death.

Episodes.Title: Echoes of the Past
Episodes.Description: Tyrone visits the graves of people who pushed him to leave his dubious life, including Rosita's. Jasmin arrives to pay respect to her mother.

Episodes.Title: Condolences
Episodes.Description: Jasmin feels anger and grief again after seeing Tyrone. Tyrone makes amends with Iris' friends and Vittorio convinces them to just forget the past.

Episodes.Title: A Wrench to the Plan
Episodes.Description: Their world becomes more dangerous so Aster's fear for Jasmin and Mira intensifies. Tyrone confesses to Iris, and Zandro reveals something to Jasmin.

Episodes.Title: Pain of the Past
Episodes.Description: Lavender tries to avoid Tyrone during the anniversary. Amid the luxurious arrangements, tension fills the air when someone mentioned Marigold's name

Episodes.Title: Homebreaking
Episodes.Description: Mira was harmed when Vittorio's men break into Aster's house. Heather remembers the past when Marigold was mentioned. Tyrone spots a familiar face.

Episodes.Title: An Unexpected Knight in Shining Armor
Episodes.Description: Harry and Tyrone run after Zandro and Lavender. Zandro fights with Harry while Lavender tries to escape. Someone unexpectedly arrives to save her.

Episodes.Title: Ex-posed
Episodes.Description: Tyrone confesses everything to Lavender during their heated confrontation, and she reveals a secret. Zandro continues to hunt down Tyrone.

Episodes.Title: Secrets Within Secrets
Episodes.Description: A secret from the past hunts Vittorio. Tyrone spends time with an important person in his life. Zandro is disappointed with Tyrone helping Jasmin.

Episodes.Title: Cat in a Lion's Den
Episodes.Description: Despite people's objections, Lavender turns to the Buenavidezes to work with them against Aster. Harry catches Lavender and Tyrone together.

Episodes.Title: Sham Alliances
Episodes.Description: Tyrone and Lavender continue with their plans, but their enemies see through their lies. Zandro stays with Lavender, while Aster visits Mira.

Episodes.Title: Loyalty Check
Episodes.Description: As Harry discovers more, Vittorio continues to test Tyrone's loyalty. Lavender finds herself caught in the growing tension between Tyrone and Zandro.

Episodes.Title: Naked Truth
Episodes.Description: Lavender takes Tyrone to Aster's house so he can clean up after a fight with Zandro. Meanwhile, Iris is on her way there to catch them red-handed.

Episodes.Title: Irreplaceable
Episodes.Description: Iris finds a way to confirm the link between Lavender and Jasmin, without Tyrone noticing her moves. Zandro realizes what he feels for Lavender.

Episodes.Title: Hard Pill to Swallow
Episodes.Description: Aster finds the truth about what happened to Marigold. Lavender organizes Iris and Tyrone's anniversary, unaware of her archenemy's surprise for her.

Episodes.Title: Set the Record Straight
Episodes.Description: Tyrone reflects on what he truly feels for Iris and Jasmin. Lily discovered a recorded message from his late husband.

Episodes.Title: The Setup
Episodes.Description: Iris shocks everyone with her speech at the anniversary party. Vittorio's men abducted Aster and Mira. Aster learns the truth about her daughter.

Episodes.Title: The Big Reveal
Episodes.Description: Iris reveals that Lavender is Jasmin Flores. Mira manages to escape, but encounters Harry again after Myrtle finds her and brings her home.

Episodes.Title: Unforeseen Grief
Episodes.Description: While in hiding, Lavender learns what happened to Aster and Mira. Camilla accidentally watched Lance's video message for Lily.

Episodes.Title: Behind Enemy Lines
Episodes.Description: Lily cannot hide her fear while Iris discusses her plan to use Tyrone and Jasmin's missing child. Only one person can help both Jasmin and Harry.

Episodes.Title: The Choice
Episodes.Description: Zandro has a difficult decision when Lavender asked him to work with Tyrone. Iris finally discovers who Tyrone and Lavender's missing child is.

Episodes.Title: Unbearable Bargain
Episodes.Description: Mira mourns Aster's death. Vittorio was arrested by the authorities. Lavender tries to get to Camilla first before Iris does.

Episodes.Title: Pivotal Partnerships
Episodes.Description: Jasmin was stopped by a checkpoint while travelling to her and Camilla's hideout. Zandro receives a big favor from Iris in exchange of a partnership.

Episodes.Title: Tug of Hearts
Episodes.Description: Tyrone arrives at Jasmin's hideout, spends time with them. Zandro gets reinstated, thanks to the Buenavidezes. Patrick learns of Lily's plan.

Episodes.Title: Friends No More
Episodes.Description: Patrick chooses between love and loyalty as he stops Ian from exposing Lily's plan. Jasmin feels bad that she doesn't know Camilla well enough.

Episodes.Title: Emergency
Episodes.Description: Jasmin panics over Camilla's allergic reactions. Lily arrives and brings them to the hospital. Tyrone locates where Vittorio produces illegal arms.

Episodes.Title: Changing Sides
Episodes.Description: Zandro sides with the Buenavidezes, Vittorio can easily escape the law. Tyrone slips into the production site of illegal arms to gather evidence.

Episodes.Title: Sinking Ship
Episodes.Description: Lily Learns the truth behind Lance's death. Vittorio's company starts to sink after Tyrone exposed his family's illegal activities.

Episodes.Title: One on One
Episodes.Description: Zandro's long-awaited one-on-one encounter with Tyrone has finally arrived. Meanwhile, Aster gets rid of all the research materials about the Buenavidezes that Jasmin had gathered in her home—at least, that is what she believes.

Episodes.Title: Make Peace
Episodes.Description: With Zandro being dismissed from his position, Lavender suggests that he make peace with Tyrone instead. Meanwhile, Vittorio and Iris get ahold of Jasmin’s hitlist journal, bringing the former's past with Marigold to light.

Episodes.Title: Mind Games
Episodes.Description: Tyrone expresses fondness for Camilla, oblivious to their true relationship. Later, he encounters Zandro again and openly criticizes Jasmin. Meanwhile, Iris and Vittorio enlist Lavender and Aster to organize BSM’s event.

Episodes.Title: Destined Reunion
Episodes.Description: Tyrone joins Harry on a mission to hunt down the attackers of Iris and Vittorio. Meanwhile, a destined reunion unfolds during BSM's anniversary celebration.

Episodes.Title: Pain of the Past
Episodes.Description: After her encounter with Tyrone, Lavender avoids any chance of crossing paths with him at the BSM’s anniversary event. Amid the luxurious arrangements and flowery speeches, a palpable tension fills the air at the mention of Marigold’s name.

Episodes.Title: Homebreaking
Episodes.Description: Vittorio’s men break into Aster’s house, harming Mira in the process. The repeated mention of Marigold triggers Heather’s memories of the past. Meanwhile, Tyrone sneaks onto Aster’s property and spots a familiar face.

Episodes.Title: An Unexpected Knight in Shining Armor
Episodes.Description: A car chase ensues as Harry and Tyrone pursue Zandro and Lavender. While Zandro fights fiercely against Harry, Lavender struggles to escape her pursuers until someone arrives to save her from certain death.

Episodes.Title: Ex-posed
Episodes.Description: Tyrone comes clean to Lavender when an intense confrontation erupts between them until the latter reveals her shocking secret. Meanwhile, Zandro continues his pursuit of Tyrone.

Episodes.Title: Secrets Within Secrets
Episodes.Description: An incident in the past haunts Vittorio. Tyrone gets to spend time with the most important person in his life. Meanwhile, tension rises between Zandro and Jasmin as the latter decides to accept Tyrone's help.

Episodes.Title: Cat in a Lion's Lair
Episodes.Description: Despite her loved ones' objections, Lavender turns to the Buenavidezes and offers to work with them against Aster. Later on, however, Harry catches Lavender and Tyrone together.

Episodes.Title: Sham Alliances
Episodes.Description: Tyrone and Lavender continue to play pretend, only for their enemies to see through their lies. Zandro stays with Lavender when an unsuspecting Aster pays Mira a surprise visit.

Episodes.Title: Loyalty Check
Episodes.Description: As Harry’s investigation progresses, Vittorio opts to see where Tyrone’s loyalty truly lies. Meanwhile, Lavender finds herself caught in the middle of Tyrone and Zandro’s growing conflict.

Episodes.Title: Naked Truth
Episodes.Description: Lavender takes Tyrone to Aster’s empty mansion to clean up after his altercation with Zandro. Little do they know, Iris knows exactly where to find them and is on her way to catch them red-handed.

Episodes.Title: Irreplaceable
Episodes.Description: After discovering a piece of evidence linking Lavender to Jasmin Flores, Iris finds a way to verify it, all the while feigning ignorance in front of Tyrone. Meanwhile, Zandro comes to terms with his feelings for Lavender.

Episodes.Title: Hard Pill to Swallow
Episodes.Description: Aster takes matters into her own hands to uncover the truth behind Marigold’s disappearance. Meanwhile, Lavender meticulously plans Iris and Tyrone’s anniversary celebration, unaware of the surprise her archenemy has in store for her.

Episodes.Title: Set the Record Straight
Episodes.Description: Tyrone sets the record straight about his true feelings both for Iris and Jasmin. Meanwhile, Lily stumbles upon a recorded message from her late husband.

Episodes.Title: The Setup
Episodes.Description: Iris shocks everyone with her speech at her and Tyrone’s anniversary party. Meanwhile, Vittorio’s men abduct Aster and Mira. In the face of death, Aster finally learns the truth about her daughter’s connection to Vittorio.

Episodes.Title: The Big Reveal
Episodes.Description: Iris reveals to everyone that Lavender is Jasmin Flores. Meanwhile, Mira manages to escape, only to come face-to-face with Harry once again after Myrtle finds her and brings her home.

Episodes.Title: Unforeseen Grief
Episodes.Description: While in hiding, Lavender learns of the tragedy that has struck Aster and Mira. Meanwhile, Camilla accidentally stumbles upon Lance’s confession video.

Episodes.Title: Behind Enemy Lines
Episodes.Description: Lily finds herself on edge as Iris eagerly discusses her plan to find Tyrone and Jasmin’s missing child. Meanwhile, Lavender and Harry, each facing their own dilemma, turn to the same person for help.

Episodes.Title: The Choice
Episodes.Description: Begged to work with the man he hates the most, Zandro makes a difficult choice. Meanwhile, Iris finally discovers who Tyrone and Jasmin’s missing child is.

Episodes.Title: Unbearable Bargain
Episodes.Description: vWhile Mira mourns Aster’s death, Vittorio is arrested by the authorities for murder. Meanwhile, Jasmin races against time to get Camilla before Iris beats her to it.

Episodes.Title: Pivotal Partnerships
Episodes.Description: Jasmin gets stopped at a police checkpoint as she makes her way to bring Camilla to their hideout. Meanwhile, Zandro receives a favorable return as he seals a partnership with Iris.

Episodes.Title: Tug of Hearts
Episodes.Description: Tyrone arrives at Jasmin’s hideout, where he gets to spend quality time with her and their child. Thanks to the Buenavidezes' influence, Zandro gets reinstated at his job. Meanwhile,  Patrick discovers Lily’s hidden agenda.

Episodes.Title: Friends No More
Episodes.Description: Patrick is forced to choose between love and his loyalty to the Buenavidezes when Ian dissuades him from reporting Lily’s escape plan to Iris. Meanwhile, Jasmin’s heart aches in silence as she realizes she does not know Camilla well enough.

Episodes.Title: Emergency
Episodes.Description: Camilla’s allergic reaction sends Jasmin into a panic. Fortunately, Lily arrives in time to give them a ride to the hospital, unaware that she is being followed. Meanwhile, Tyrone tracks down the relocated production site of Vittorio’s illegal arms.

Episodes.Title: Changing Sides
Episodes.Description: With Zandro switching sides, escaping the law becomes smoother for Vittorio. Meanwhile, Tyrone infiltrates the Buenavidezes' illegal weapons production site to gather evidence of their criminal operations.

Episodes.Title: Sinking Ship
Episodes.Description: Lily learns the whole truth behind Lance’s death. Meanwhile, Vittorio’s company begins to sink under the weight of scandal after Tyrone exposed his family’s illegal activities to the public.

Episodes.Title: A Tale of Two Mothers
Episodes.Description: Lily and Jasmin share parenting duties for Camilla while struggling with their emotionally painful situation. Mira’s cry for justice throws Heather into a frenzy. To make matters worse, another crime committed by her family is exposed to the public.

Episodes.Title: Family Day
Episodes.Description: Tyrone and Jasmin enjoy quality time with Camilla at an art museum, unaware that Zandro is reporting their whereabouts to Iris. As Vittorio and Heather prepare to leave the country, a truth-bearer follows the nagging voice of his conscience.

Episodes.Title: True Colors
Episodes.Description: Vittorio and Heather’s attempt to escape is put to a halt. Meanwhile, Jasmin and Iris come face-to-face once more at the art museum. What starts as a tense encounter escalates into a bloody confrontation when Iris guns down Jasmin.

Episodes.Title: Behind Bars
Episodes.Description: Iris is thrown behind bars after falling victim to Jasmin and Zandro’s trap. Meanwhile, Mira’s heart shatters once again as she confirms that the recovered remains are, indeed, her mother's.

Episodes.Title: A Tale of Two Fathers
Episodes.Description: Despite Tyrone’s cooperation, Zandro still finds it hard to believe that the former is truly innocent in the deaths of his wife and son. While Vittorio remains convinced that everything he has done is for his family, Iris has a plan in mind.

Episodes.Title: Good Girl
Episodes.Description: Iris tries to be a good girl behind bars in an effort to gain the public’s sympathy. Before turning himself in, Tyrone makes the most of his final moments with Camilla and finally confronts the truth he has long kept from Jasmin.

Episodes.Title: The Arrest
Episodes.Description: Zandro arrests Tyrone, but took him to another place instead of the police station. Someone is following them. Iris receives in unexpected news.

Episodes.Title: Painful Decisions
Episodes.Description: Harry confesses the whole truth to Zandro. Vittorio finds a way to get Iris out of jail. Lily and Patrick have a tough decision to make.

Episodes.Title: Unforgettable Celebration
Episodes.Description: Tyrone makes the most of his time with Jasmin and Camilla and celebrates his birthday with them. Meanwhile, Iris is preparing to visit them.

Episodes.Title: The Uninvited
Episodes.Description: Camilla remembers Lance while celebrating Tyrone's birthday. Iris then arrives to deliver a very special gift to Tyrone.

Episodes.Title: New Iris
Episodes.Description: Iris tries to convince everyone that she has changed for the better. With Iris being free, Tyrone finds it harder to say goodbye to Jasmin at Camilla.

Episodes.Title: A Day at the Park
Episodes.Description: Iris' friends surrender to authorities, affecting their children. Jasmin and Lily plans to tell the truth to Camilla, but Iris beats them.

Episodes.Title: The Godmother
Episodes.Description: Jasmin and Tyrone’s worst nightmare as parents comes to life when Camilla goes missing, and they suspect that Iris is keeping her. Adding to their growing list of concerns, Tyrone is about to be transferred to the same penitentiary as Vittorio.

Episodes.Title: Unstoppable
Episodes.Description: Despite Zandro’s objections, Jasmin remains unstoppable and infiltrates Iris' house, with Lily's help. Meanwhile, Heather finally regains consciousness.

Episodes.Title: A Mother's Dream
Episodes.Description: Jasmin's dream turns into reality when Lily tells the truth to Camilla. Iris finds a new reason to hate Jasmin. Tyrone is transferred to another jail.

Episodes.Title: Riot
Episodes.Description: Jasmin bids farewell to the people who helped her, including Lavender fields. Tyrone faces Vittorio and fights to stop Vittorio's evil plans.

Episodes.Title: The Breakout
Episodes.Description: Tyrone escapes jail to warn Jasmin that Vittorio also escaped prison. Zandro and Eric get into a deadly encounter while bringing Iris to jail.

Episodes.Title: Tricks and Treachery
Episodes.Description: Vittorio's men succeed in abducting Lily and Camilla. Jasmin and Tyrone took all their chances to rescue their daughter from Vittorio and Iris.

Episodes.Title: For the Love of a Child
Episodes.Description: Jasmin and Lily bravely face Iris. Iris retreats as her weakness emerged. Desperate to save Camilla from Vittorio, a life is put in danger.

Episodes.Title: A Child for a Child
Episodes.Description: Jasmin takes Heather hostage to force Vittorio to surrender Camilla. Vittorio and Iris arrive with the child, unaware of Jasmin and Heather's plans.

Episodes.Title: The Chase till the End
Episodes.Description: In the midst of chaos, Iris tries to escape with Camilla leading to a chase. Fighting until the end, Vittorio pays the price for his wrongdoings.

Episodes.Title: Lav-Ender
Episodes.Description: Vittorio ultimately pays for his wrongdoings. But before facing his punishment, he makes sure to get rid of his family's mortal enemy—Jasmin Flores.

Entries.Title: Lumuhod Ka Sa Lupa
Entries.Description: This is another action-drama film where the protagonist exacts payment of debts.

Episodes.Title: Sumabog sa Galit at Inggit si Miguel
Hinding-Hindi Pakakawalan ni Miguel si Mercy
S1.E51 ∙ Bagong yugto
Episodes.Description: As the new chapter begins, Miguel's evil plan against Abra also begins.

Episodes.Title: S1.E52 ∙ Mastermind
Episodes.Description: Miguel's plan to bring down Benito and Abra together continues. He orders Atoy and Nina to carry out the evil plan.

Episodes.Title: S1.E53 ∙ Annulment
Episodes.Description: When Miguel receives Mercy's petition for annulment, he also discovers a major truth about Fatima.

Episodes.Title: S1.E54 ∙ Tunay na ama
Episodes.Description: Mercy finally tells Abra that he's the father of Fatima. Miguel has become more determined than ever to reunite his family upon receiving the annulment papers.

Episodes.Title: S1.E55 ∙ Dehado
Episodes.Description: A surprise armed attack on the Balmores mansion led to an unexpected outcome. Meanwhile, Abra confronts Miguel at the law firm after getting ahold of Balmores' signed Durable Power Of Attorney.

Episodes.Title: S1.E56 ∙ Fake Hero
Episodes.Description: After Miguel's plan to get Abra arrested succeeds, he takes another step further by "rescuing" Fatima.

Episodes.Title: S1.E57 ∙ Manipula
Episodes.Description: Mercy confronts Miguel after visiting his mansion. Meanwhile, Abra is determined to get out of the provincial jail as quickly as possible, but danger lurks in every corner.

Episodes.Title: S1.E58 ∙ Kasunduan
Episodes.Description: Abra finally confronts Atoy about his motivation to set Abra up after being transferred to the same jail cell. Jane persuades Bea to cut ties with Tom.

Episodes.Title: S1.E59 ∙ Riot
Episodes.Description: After hearing the news from the jail warden that Abra is about to be released from the provincial jail, Miguel orders the jail warden to set a final trap against Abra.

Episodes.Title: S1.E60 ∙ Pangontra
Episodes.Description: After reuniting, Abra and Mercy talk about their next plan to rescue Fatima. Miguel enlists the help of Jane to ruin Abra's public image. Brando is beginning to question Abra's loyalty to Benito.

Episodes.Title: S1.E61 ∙ Bihag
Episodes.Description: Abra's promise to help Atoy rescue Fatima comes to fruition. With the help of his team, they set their plan in motion by going to Atoy's employer's house, Balat.

Episodes.Title: S1.E63 ∙ Salisi
Episodes.Description: A homesick Fatima attempts to escape from their house after being kept from her mother and grandfather by Miguel for so long. Bea gets the courage to ask Tom for an unusual favor.

Episodes.Title: S1.E64 ∙ Kampihan
Episodes.Description: Abra has become desperate to find help with an unlikely acquaintance after exhausting his options to find and rescue Fatima. Meanwhile, Miguel and Fatima's relationship worsens.

Episodes.Title: S1.E65 ∙ Utakan
Episodes.Description: As Abra and his team uncover Fatima's location, they prepare themselves in a race against time after Jane breaks the news about Miguel's plan.

Episodes.Title: S1.E66 ∙ Sagip
Episodes.Description: After failing to get to Miguel's house on time, Abra and his team work together to catch Miguel's car and rescue Fatima.

Episodes.Title: S1.E67 ∙ Damdamin
Episodes.Description: Abra successfully rescues Fatima, reuniting her with Mercy. Meanwhile, a desperate Miguel contacts Jane in the hopes of involving her in another one of his schemes.

Episodes.Title: S1.E68 ∙ Alinlangan
Episodes.Description: Jane's in deep water after Miguel sends her to gather information to use against Abra. Meanwhile, Brando suspects something out of Abra and Mercy's real relationship.

Episodes.Title: S1.E69 ∙ Kadugo
Episodes.Description: As Mercy learns about Elizabeth, her half-sister--- her dismay toward Judge Benito grows stronger. Norman and Obet escorts Atoy and Nina in leaving Rosario, with Miguel's men in hot pursuit.

Episodes.Title: S1.E70 ∙ Power
Episodes.Description: Already furious about Abra's involvement in the escape of Atoy, Miguel's wrath can be felt inside the Balmores Law firm as Mercy arrives together with Abra to assert her power as an Attorney-in-fact of Judge Benito.

Episodes.Title: S1.E71 ∙ Takeover
Episodes.Description: Miguel intends to kill Abra as he learns the latter confirms its attendance in the upcoming Alamid meeting, his father opposes the idea. Meanwhile, Mercy notices that Fatima develops a trauma after the kidnapping incident. Abra vows to do everything to stop Miguel from hurting them again.

Episodes.Title: S1.E72 ∙ Pag-amin
Episodes.Description: Abra gets carried away and confesses his love to Mercy. With Fatima's safety in jeopardy, Mercy decides to set aside her real feelings. Meanwhile, Jane can't stand seeing Abra, her one great love-- hurting over unrequited love. It pains her too.

Episodes.Title: S1.E73 ∙ Sawi
Episodes.Description: After an awkward drunken encounter with Abra, Jane begins to distance herself from Abra. Meanwhile, Elizabeth finally arrives at the Balmores mansion to live with her half-sister, Mercy.

Episodes.Title: S1.E74 ∙ Panggulo
Episodes.Description: Abra finally meets Elizabeth, Mercy's estranged half-sister. Miguel brews a new sinister plan after losing most of what he cherishes.

Episodes.Title: S1.E75 ∙ Buwelta
Episodes.Description: Miguel calls for a meeting with the Alamid members to complete his plan. Despite warnings from his friends and allies, Abra is still determined to attend the Alamid meeting.

Episodes.Title: S1.E76 ∙ Bagsik
Episodes.Description: As the meeting between Alamid members begins, an unexpected guest shows up that shakes up Miguel's plan.

Episodes.Title: S1.E77 ∙ Kastigo
Episodes.Description: The return of Benito Balmores from a coma turned Miguel's plan upside down. Miguel takes Abra hostage as he runs away with his father, Mario, to escape the newly awakened judge's wrath.

Episodes.Title: S1.E78 ∙ Pugante
Episodes.Description: In the aftermath of Miguel's escape, Abra was hospitalized due to his injuries while fighting Miguel. Benito tasked his subordinates to hunt down Miguel and brands him as a fugitive in Rosario.

Episodes.Title: S1.E79 ∙ Pangamba
Episodes.Description: With Benito Balmores' return to power, Abra and Mercy agree to protect their daughter, Fatima from her grandfather. Meanwhile, Atoy and Nina continue to live a peaceful life despite potential threats looming over them.

Episodes.Title: S1.E80 ∙ Kontrolado
Episodes.Description: Benito calls for a meeting with his subordinates to discuss their next move against Miguel. Atoy and Nina argue about their situation and involvement in helping Abra fight against Benito Balmores.

Episodes.Title: S1.E81 ∙ Tiwala
Episodes.Description: Abra tries to contact Atoy but to no avail. Corcerned about Nina and Atoy's safety, Abra and friends goes to their last known location-- only to discover that they were no longer staying there. Benito's suspicion rises and for Abra to regain the judge's trust again, he agrees to take a special mission with Elizabeth as his partner in crime.

Episodes.Title: S1.E82 ∙ Prinsipyo
Episodes.Description: While on a mission, Abra struggles to let go of his principles. Elizabeth senses it and uses Abra's moral dilemma to her advantage. Meanwhile, Mercy follows Brando. Abra's involvement in her father's dirty deed saddens the clueless Mercy.

Episodes.Title: S1.E83 ∙ Konsensya
Episodes.Description: Because of Abra's involvement, Mercy decides not to use the video footage against Judge Benito Balmores. Abra reassures Mercy; he finally confesses to her.

Episodes.Title: S1.E84 ∙ Alyansa
Episodes.Description: Due to constant involvement in violence, Atty. Abra struggles to believe that he is still a good man fighting an evil man. In the end, Mercy convinces the attorney to help her with her candidacy; their only hope to take the evil judge down.

Episodes.Title: S1.E85 ∙ Tindig
Episodes.Description: Mercy finally announces to the public that she will run as a governor of Rosario; promising to eradicate corruption first if elected; upon hearing Mercy's true agenda-- Judge Balmores withdraws his support for Mercy's candidacy.

Episodes.Title: S1.E86 ∙ Mothering
Episodes.Description: Mercy is finally breaking free from Benito's control. Meanwhile, Mother Eu is helping Miguel rise up to seek revenge against Benito and regain power in Rosario.

Episodes.Title: S1.E87 ∙ Sanib pwersa
Episodes.Description: Abra is about to introduce Mercy to his allies who will help her in her fight to win the election. However, Benito will quickly find a way to bring Mercy back under his control.

Episodes.Title: S1.E88 ∙ Sabotahe
Episodes.Description: Due to Benito's sabotage of potential financiers for Mercy's campaign, Abra and Jane will find a way to counter it. Meanwhile, Mother Eu and Miguel are planning how to attack Benito.

Episodes.Title: S1.E89 ∙ Pagkakataon
Episodes.Description: Because of Abra, Mr. Sampaga agrees to a meeting to hear Mercy's plans-but with one condition Abra must attend; otherwise, he won't talk to a Balmores. As the scheduled time for their meeting approaches, Benito summons Abra for a mission.

Episodes.Title: S1.E90 ∙ Paghimok
Episodes.Description: Besides the importance of convincing Mr. Sampaga for his support, it is even more crucial to gain the trust of the people. The battle for Mercy Balmores' candidacy is about to begin.

Episodes.Title: S1.E91 ∙ Paramdam
Episodes.Description: Miguel's presence resurfaces in Rosario, and the first thing he disrupts is Mercy's campaign. Meanwhile, Benito's violence is felt as he searches for those supporting Mercy's candidacy.

Episodes.Title: S1.E92 ∙ Lusob
Episodes.Description: Due to Elizabeth's surveillance, Mercy's financier is confirmed. Mr. Sampaga's life is in danger because of Judge Balmores' sinister plan.

Episodes.Title: S1.E93 ∙ Responde
Episodes.Description: Mother Eu and Miguel leave a message at the gate of the Balmores Mansion Manong's corpse.

Episodes.Title: S1.E94 ∙ Tatsulok
Episodes.Description: Although Mr. Sampaga was successfully rescued, Jane's happiness is incomplete due to the rekindled closeness between Mercy and Abra. Confessions are about to be made.

Episodes.Title: S1.E95 ∙ Blackmail
Episodes.Description: As the Alamid forces continue to grow, so does the intensification of plans to bring down Mercy's candidacy. Under pressure from Elizabeth, Abra is forced to confess to Benito.

Episodes.Title: S1.E96 ∙ Babala
Episodes.Description: Miguel warns Benito and Abra about his revenge. Jane also learns about Miguel's next plan to take back Mercy and Fatima.

Episodes.Title: S1.E97 ∙ Pagsangga
Episodes.Description: During Miguel's assault, Mercy and Fatima find themselves threatened, but Abra intervenes to protect them, putting himself in grave danger.

Episodes.Title: S1.E98 ∙ Lamat
Episodes.Description: Despite Mercy's improving position in the election, Benito begins to suspect Abra's true nature.

Episodes.Title: S1.E99 ∙ Troll Farm
Episodes.Description: As the relationship between Benito and Abra continues to deteriorate, Mother Eu and Miguel plan to take them down. Mother Eu suggests finding out any secret about Abra.

Episodes.Title: S1.E100 ∙ Hinala
Episodes.Description: The smear campaigns and character assassination against Mercy seem to be succeeding. Meanwhile, as Abra attacks the troll farm, a lurking danger awaits.

Episodes.Title: S1.E101 ∙ Pag-usig
Episodes.Description: Benito confronts Abra for the sabotage at the troll farm. Meanwhile, Miguel reappears to introduce Jane to Mother Eu.

Episodes.Title: S1.E102 ∙ Pandaraya
Episodes.Description: Benito offers a coalition to Gov. Uy to ensure victory in the election against Mercy. Jane worries about Abra's safety, especially since Benito now harbors significant suspicion about him.

Episodes.Title: S1.E103 ∙ Pananakot
Episodes.Description: Abra and Mercy face the task of vote-buying. However, Benito orders Brando to get ahead of Abra and Mercy.

Episodes.Title: S1.E104 ∙ Salba
Episodes.Description: Elizabeth offers to team up with Abra by providing an information. Masked Abra tries to save Kap Rodel from brando's men-- endangering his cover.

Episodes.Title: S1.E105 ∙ Pagtutuos
Episodes.Description: Overjoyed by their small victory, Mercy and Abra takes a little moment to appreciate each other. Fueled by anger and jealousy, Miguel tails Abra's car as danger awaits them both.

Episodes.Title: S1.E106 ∙ Kapit
Episodes.Description: Almost defeated in a fist fight by Abra, Miguel manages to get his hands near Jane and Mercy--using them for a chance to escape. Abra, literally holding both Mercy and Jane's life in the palm of his hand--who can he save?

Episodes.Title: S1.E107 ∙ Takot
Episodes.Description: Jane's finally in an stable condition. As the accident leaves no alarming physical damage, it brings big impact to Abra and Jane's relationship. Will Abra be able to win her trust again?

Episodes.Title: S1.E108 ∙ Asintado
Episodes.Description: Ready, aim, shoot. As the election day draws nearer, Elizabeth agrees to do a dangerous mission. Someone's going to get bloody, who would it be?

Episodes.Title: S1.E109 ∙ Hitman
Episodes.Description: As Leonardo learns who orchestrated the assassination attempt--a more shocking revelation unfolds.

Episodes.Title: S1.E110 ∙ Laglagan
Episodes.Description: Abra saves Elizabeth from Benito's corrupt policemen. Meanwhile, nightmares starts to haunt Jane in her sleep.

Episodes.Title: S1.E111 ∙ Prayoridad
Episodes.Description: Brando suspects Abra of hiding Elizabeth and pays a surprise visit to his home; As Abra visits Jane in the hospital, Brando and his men searches Abra's house leaving the lone Elizabeth in an exposed location.

Episodes.Title: S1.E112 ∙ Pagtanggap
Episodes.Description: Fearing that Benito's men will soon find Elizabeth, Abra brings her to the safehouse. Hesitant at first, but through Abra's convincing-- the group agrees to give Elizabeth another chance.

Episodes.Title: S1.E113 ∙ Hikayat
Episodes.Description: Furious at Abra for exposing the groups safehouse to an enemy, Jane angrily confronts both Elizabeth and Abra. To prove her sincerity, Elizabeth reveals Benito's plan to ambush Mercy's supporters on election day.

Episodes.Title: S1.E114 ∙ Mass Grave
Episodes.Description: In the middle of the rescue mission, Elizabeth sacrifices herself to be the target of Brando and his goons. Giving Jane and Abra the opportunity to pull Kap Ed and his people out of the mass grave.

Episodes.Title: S1.E115 ∙ Gahol
Episodes.Description: Abra, Jane, and the voters chase the cutoff for voting. Abra is very grateful to Elizabeth for helping stop Benito's evil plan. However, Jane still doubts Elizabeth's intentions. The true results of the election are about to be revealed.

Episodes.Title: S1.E116 ∙ Protesta
Episodes.Description: In the midst of Mercy's defeat in the election, she and Abra, with the help of the voters, are protesting the true results. Atoy, meanwhile, is resurfacing to fulfill his promise to Abra.

Episodes.Title: S1.E117 ∙ Protesta
Episodes.Description: Abra is filled with hope again because of the new plan with Atoy. But even before they meet, Elizabeth sabotages him.

Episodes.Title: S1.E118 ∙ Hinanakit
Episodes.Description: Brando tails Abra en route to Atoy's place. As he finds Nina, Brando kills her first. Abra and Atoys manages to escape successfully. Grieving Atoy regrets reconnecting with Abra and blames him for Nina's death.

Episodes.Title: S1.E119 ∙ Sabwatan
Episodes.Description: Jane reassures Miguel about there plan against Benito.
