Although defeated, Mercy continues her public service, gaining the support of an eye witness-- enough to file an electoral protest against Leonardo Uy. Meanwhile, through Elizabeth's help, Judge Benito is already aware about the name's of Abra's inner group.

Episodes.Title: S1.E120 ∙ Moralidad
Episodes.Description: Mercy brings a new witness to Abra against Gov. Uy's election fraud. However, Norman's fears for the witness's safety prevail. Meanwhile, Jane is gradually changing. Mother Eu and Miguel are putting together a big plan to finally bring down Benito.

Entries.Title: What's Wrong With Secretary Kim
Entries.Description: A competent secretary and a narcissistic boss fall in love while uncovering a traumatic past that causes them to question whether their feelings are real or the result of a shared trauma.

Episodes.Title: Beauty and the Boss
Episodes.Description: Amid a busy event, Kim Liwanag stands out as a reliable secretary who is in control of everything. When an unforeseen problem ensues, Kim wastes no time and springs into action before her narcissistic boss arrives. Later, Kim makes a tough decision.

Episodes.Title: The Boss's Proposal
Episodes.Description: Brandon presents various offers in an attempt to prevent Kim from leaving her post, but to no avail. Soon, however, he makes a shocking proposal as his secretary makes up a reason behind her resignation.

Episodes.Title: Someone Like Kim
Episodes.Description: The recruitment process for Kim’s replacement kicks off, yet Brandon remains puzzled by his secretary‘s unwavering determination to leave. Getting wind of an investor’s move to get Kim behind his back, Brandon starts to question her loyalty.

Episodes.Title: Are You Kara-OK?
Episodes.Description: Awkwardness hangs between Brandon and Kim as both of them expect an apology from each other following their heated exchange. Noticing that his secretary is avoiding him, Brandon joins Kim and his staff’s night out unannounced.

Episodes.Title: The Pursuit of Kim's Happiness
Episodes.Description: A weird survey from the HR Department sends the office into a frenzy. Later, Kim agrees to attend a blind date set up by her sister, but an emergency meeting foils her plan.

Episodes.Title: Can't Hardly Date
Episodes.Description: Confident that Kim will reconsider resigning after their blockbuster date, Brandon is shocked to learn that she is going out with someone else. Unbeknownst to him, Kim's date with Troy takes a disastrous turn.

Episodes.Title: The Games We Play
Episodes.Description: Kim Marie's unconscious mistake triggers Brandon's past trauma. Envious of a colleague forming a bond with Kim during the company sports fest, Brandon decides to participate in the games, much to the employees’ surprise.

Episodes.Title: The Pairing Trap
Episodes.Description: Kim starts to entertain her sister's theory about Brandon's traumatic childhood after tending to her boss' sprained ankle. The next day, a crisis about their company's event leads Brandon to challenge Kim and her team with an impossible task.

Episodes.Title: Hello Morpheus...
Episodes.Description: Prime Alpha's big event is just around the corner, and the staff have yet to find a keynote speaker. Thankfully, Kim finds the perfect match through her favorite author, the reclusive Morpheus. Brandon receives an unwelcome visitor at his office.

Episodes.Title: My Brother's Keeper
Episodes.Description: Felix becomes upset with Kim for investigating her past abduction without his knowledge. Kim manages to convince Brandon to have dinner with his family, but the supposedly happy reunion turns sour when Brandon and Cyrus end up in a fight.

Episodes.Title: Brandon M. Confused
Episodes.Description: After finding themselves in a compromising situation, Brandon makes an excuse to lighten things up. While this incident opens new and confusing feelings for Kim, Brandon indirectly consults Philip for his next moves.

Episodes.Title: First Date?
Episodes.Description: Acting on his mother’s advice, Cyrus sets up a meeting with Kim as Morpheus. However, Kim declines his invitation as she is scheduled to have dinner date with Brandon. While trying out different dresses, Kim accidentally calls her boss.

Episodes.Title: Morphing Time
Episodes.Description: After their disastrous encounter with Cyrus, both Brandon and Kim refuse to apologize and give each other the cold shoulder at work the next day. Kim Marie enlists Steph’s help to confirm her hunch about Roni.

Episodes.Title: Hard to Say I'm Sorry
Episodes.Description: Brandon's stubbornness prevents him from apologizing to his secretary. Cyrus, on the contrary, surprises Kim with an immediate apology. As Kim learns Cyrus’ past after an unexpected heart-to-heart talk, she also starts to understand Brandon better.

Episodes.Title: Push and Pull
Episodes.Description: Following a misunderstanding, Brandon tags along with Kim in hopes of making up with her. On the other hand, Kim Marie spots a familiar face while looking for an affordable flat to rent.

Episodes.Title: Finding Ninja Boy
Episodes.Description: Thanks to Troy’s journalistic skills, Kim discovers that Ninja Boy is one of the Castillo brothers. To verify her hunch, Kim probes into Brandon’s past. Aside from her, however, Troy is also eager to uncover the truth for personal reasons.

Episodes.Title: A Talk to Remember
Episodes.Description: Romantic tensions rise between Kim and Brandon as she is convinced that her boss and Ninja Boy are the same person. Unsure of how to make him remember, Kim calls out to Brandon as Ninja Boy, only to later find out that her hunch is wrong.

Episodes.Title: Torn Between Two Brothers
Episodes.Description: Brandon grows troubled when Kim informs him that she finally found Ninja Boy, and he is none other than Cyrus. To make matters worse, his concern heightens when he spots his secretary meeting up with his brother.

Episodes.Title: The Great Wall of BMC
Episodes.Description: Cyrus and Brandon agree to resolve their issue the same way they used to—through a game. If Brandon wins, Cyrus will leave him alone for good. The brothers later settle on a wall climbing race, leaving Kim extremely worried.

Episodes.Title: Check the Label
Episodes.Description: Cyrus starts to see Kim in a different light when they visit the crime scene of the kidnapping incident. Driven by jealousy and frustration, Brandon makes brazen moves to take his and Kim's relationship to the next level.

Episodes.Title: The Party Crashers
Episodes.Description: With Brandon in attendance, Kim's despedida party turns into a work-related open forum. During the team building activity, Brandon utilizes his negotiation skills to ensure that he is paired with Kim and gets some alone time with her.

Episodes.Title: The Other Half of Me
Episodes.Description: New romances blossom among the Prime Alpha employees. Elsewhere, while stuck in the rain, Brandon asks Kim about her trauma and advises her against dwelling on the past. Meanwhile, Cyrus gets to spend time with his parents.

Episodes.Title: This is Where I Kiss You
Episodes.Description: Both Kim and Brandon excitedly prepare for their dinner date at the latter’s place. However, Brandon's claim to perfection is swiftly debunked when he finds himself amidst a kitchen catastrophe. Cyrus confronts Troy to issue a warning.

Episodes.Title: One Fine Date
Episodes.Description: Brandon's jealousy intensifies upon learning from Carlota that his brother may be falling in love with Kim. Cyrus, on the other hand, decides to finally confess his feelings.

Episodes.Title: Idea Ex Marks the Spot
Episodes.Description: Brandon mulls revealing the truth about Ninja Boy to Kim. As the Castillos' most kept secret gets exposed during the company event where Cyrus is a speaker, Kim finds the courage to confess her true feelings to her boss.

Episodes.Title: Kiss You Later
Episodes.Description: Brandon and Kim's deep feelings for each other erupt in a passionate kiss, marking the beginning of their new relationship. Kim and the Castillos discover the person responsible for the malicious questions thrown at Cyrus during the event.

Episodes.Title: Secret Romance
Episodes.Description: As Brandon struggles to hide his love for his girlfriend, Kim sets boundaries to keep their relationship a secret from their colleagues. Carlota grows curious about Kim's boyfriend after learning the news from Cyrus.

Episodes.Title: It's Complicated
Episodes.Description: Despite Kim's efforts to keep her relationship status a secret, her sisters rush to her side to have some serious talk about Brandon. Meanwhile, Kim Marie finally moves into her new place, only to be ruined by Roni's mistake.

Episodes.Title: Ninja Boy-Friend
Episodes.Description: Kim’s suspicion that Brandon and Ninja Boy are one and the same strengthens upon seeing her boyfriend’s old photos. Brandon, on the other hand, realizes that he needs to win the Liwanag family over as he accompanies a heartbroken Philip.

Episodes.Title: Meet the Fam
Episodes.Description: Roni is forced to hide when Kim Marie’s coworkers arrive to surprise her. Kim brims with joy as Brandon bonds with her family. Her happiness, however, is cut short when images of her traumatic past resurface during the presentation for Mr. Park.

Episodes.Title: It's All Coming Back to Her Now
Episodes.Description: Brandon is forced to come clean with Kim as his secretary's memory from the past comes to haunt her. Unbeknownst to the Prime Alpha vice chairman, a much bigger challenge awaits.

Episodes.Title: Second Chances
Episodes.Description: Carlota tries to make Felix understand Brandon’s reason for lying to his daughter. Cyrus, on the other hand, talks about the traumatic story behind his essay as he bridges the gap between Kim and his brother.

Episodes.Title: Know You're Trouble, Trouble! Trouble!
Episodes.Description: Robert and Carlota learn that Cyrus is planning to go back to Berlin. Brandon calls for a meeting to solve a costly shipment issue before it reaches the Parks, unaware that Daniel is already aware of the fiasco.

Episodes.Title: Buttons Up! (or Down?)
Episodes.Description: Brandon gets heartbroken after overhearing Kim deny that they are in a relationship. While unwinding with Philip, the CEO begins to question his decision to stick to his principles as his company faces a crisis.

Episodes.Title: When Two Become One
Episodes.Description: While Brandon asks for Robert’s assistance in solving Prime Alpha’s problem, Kim learns about Cyrus’ plan to leave for Germany. Troy finds out Carlota’s secret while interviewing a family member of Brandon’s kidnapper.

Episodes.Title: Rumor Has It...
Episodes.Description: Chaos erupts at Prime Alpha when Kim gets accused of seducing Brandon for a promotion. Meanwhile, Brandon turns to Philip for guidance as his secretary continues to ignore his marriage proposal.

Episodes.Title: The One Ring to Woo Them All
Episodes.Description: Brandon goes ring shopping with Philip after getting the blessing of Kim's family. Amid a minor hitch in the vice president's plan, a perfect opportunity arises that would set the stage for a life-changing surprise for Kim.

Episodes.Title: The Past and the Furious
Episodes.Description: A promising career opportunity abroad knocks on Kim's door, leaving Brandon anxious. Recognizing her fiancé's struggle with his past trauma, Kim enlists Cyrus' help in encouraging Brandon to confront his demons.

Episodes.Title: A Kim-Possible Wedding
Episodes.Description: Kim agrees to marry Brandon before relocating to Korea, opting for an intimate wedding that can be organized easily considering the time constraint. However, problems begin to pop up when their families get involved in the planning process.

Episodes.Title: 30-Day Notice to Forever
Episodes.Description: An unfortunate incident pushes Kim over the edge, prompting her to reassess her readiness for marriage with her former boss. With Cyrus' help, Brandon orchestrates one final surprise to reaffirm his love and commitment to his bride-to-be.

Entries.Title: Saving Grace
Entries.Description: Anna, an elementary school teacher, discovers that her student Grace is a victim of abuse. Driven by maternal instinct, Anna abducts Grace to protect her and assumes the role of a mother. As they bond amid threats from the authorities and Grace's abusive mother, Anna confronts her painful past, realizing that she needs healing as much as Grace does.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Anna, an emotionally distant teacher, determinedly prepares for an opportunity abroad. However, an unexpected turn of events leads her to meet Grace, a young student suffering from abuse. As she grows closer to the young girl, Anna becomes torn between pursuing her dreams and saving Grace from her abusive parents.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Anna rescues Grace and accompanies her to Quezon, but they face numerous setbacks along the way. The news of Grace's disappearance reaches public affairs host Miranda Valdez, who then shows interest in the story to save her program. Meanwhile, Chito gets questioned by the authorities about the possible abuse of the missing child.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Anna and Grace find refuge in Lucia's abandoned orphanage. While Anna works to provide for their needs, her past catches up with her when Miranda, Detective Oscar and TV producer Julius investigate her involvement in the missing girl's case. As the pressure of investigation mounts and Lucia's vindictive son looms eviction, Anna faces a heart-wrenching decision for Grace.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Tension rises when the police locate Lucia's orphanage and Sarah catches sight of her daughter, Grace. Luckily, Grace manages to escape while Sarah is left bewildered by her action. Left with no other option, Anna takes Grace to Palawan and seeks help from her adoptive mother, Helena. However, family tensions rise, threatening to expose Anna's secret.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: To protect Grace, Anna is forced to pretend that the former is her child and divert the police investigation away from her. However, Julius relentlessly asks questions who the child's father is, while Helena starts to doubt her supposed granddaughter's identity. Soon, a heated confrontation compels Anna to reveal her long-buried secrets.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: After discovering that Anna is hiding Grace, Julius forces them to surrender. However, an accident strands them in a deserted house where Anna and Grace reveal to Julius the whole truth behind their actions. Tensions escalate at the Sarmientos' inn as Miranda, Oscar, Sarah, and Chito become more suspicious of Anna compelling her to choose between Grace and her family.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Helena urges Anna to return Grace to her mother, while Sarah's persistent harassment causes an accident at the Sarmiento's inn. Julius helps Anna and Grace hide, but Jessica soon finds their shelter and gets incriminating evidence against Anna. Meanwhile, a stolen bracelet leads Miranda to uncover a shocking truth about someone she has been searching for over the years.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: After discovering Anna's past, an unjust manipulation of their interview compels Miranda to choose between helping Anna and protecting her career. A heated confrontation between Miranda and Helena causes past pains to resurface. Grace's and Anna's safety are put at risk when Princess makes a reckless decision and Julius' father discovers his involvement in the missing girl's case.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Despite managing to escape Palawan with her help, Anna struggles to fully trust Miranda. Meanwhile, Miranda receives a startling news that makes her determined to set things right for Anna. While the television host works to clear Anna's name and exposes Sarah's true nature, Sarah finds someone's help to fight back Miranda, raising suspicions about who might be hiding Anna.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Helena is desperate to keep Anna away from Miranda, fearing that their growing bond will unravel her dark secrets. Anna, determined to flee with Grace, considers questionable means when their hideout gets discovered. Jessica's actions become more unpredictable, while Sarah's growing suspicions intensify the looming threat.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: As Oscar closes in on Grace and Anna, Erin's resurfacing memories reveal the root of Anna's painful past. Princess' betrayal prompts the Sarmientos to uncover a life-altering truth about Helena. In a selfless move, Miranda makes a sacrifice that will put her career and reputation in jeopardy.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Anna's world crumbles when she discovers a long-buried family secret. Miranda entrusts Grace with the key to her shared past with Anna and tries to protect her secret at all costs. However, a revenge-driven Sarah exposes a startling revelation that threatens to break Anna and Miranda's fragile bond.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: Despite Miranda's struggle with her worsening condition, Anna finds it difficult to forgive her biological mother. However, a sudden discovery leads to Anna's change of heart. As everyone continues to search for Grace, the accused teacher faces harassment and serious charges in court—until an unexpected arrival seemingly changes everything.

Episodes.Title: Episode 14
Episodes.Description: Grace does everything she can to help Anna, only to hear that she has to stay in a shelter for her safety and well-being. Meanwhile, Sarah's anger fuels her relentless drive to win Grace back, leading her to make a desperate attempt to reclaim her daughter. As tensions escalate, Anna makes a bold and unexpected move to save Grace.

Entries.Title: Sagrado
Entries.Description: The members of the Sagrado family live to prove they are the most powerful and influential, stopping at nothing to bury dirty secrets to keep their name faultless and sacred.

Episodes.Title: Brotherhood
Episodes.Description: Despite his father's opposition, Moises persists in attending Crestwood University. While seeking employment to fund his education, he meets Justin, a member of the influential Sagrado family, triggering a recollection of a dark secret.

Episodes.Title: Secret
Episodes.Description: While Justin and his Gamma Sigma Xi fraternity brothers work to conceal the death of their hazing victim, Moises stumbles upon crucial evidence that could shed light on the truth behind the victim's demise.

Episodes.Title: Newbie
Episodes.Description: Elias expresses his intention to run as president during Justin's birthday party. Tension rises among the Gamma Sigma Xi members amid the cover-up of Roland's tragic death.

Episodes.Title: Recruit
Episodes.Description: Moises joins Gamma Sigma Xi's recruitment only to be later prohibited by Estong during an unexpected visit to his dorm. While the school administration turns a blind eye to Roland's murder, a Sagrado member expresses empathy for the victim's family.

Episodes.Title: Initiation
Episodes.Description: As part of their initiation into Gamma Sigma Xi, Moises and his friends obey whatever the members command them, affecting their academic performance. The Sagrado family strategizes their campaign for the upcoming national elections.

Episodes.Title: Lookout
Episodes.Description: After meeting Justin's parents, Moises realizes how fortunate the young Sagrado is. Later, Gov. Rafael taps Moises for a secret task. Meanwhile, Moises becomes increasingly intrigued by Roland's death.

Episodes.Title: Favor
Episodes.Description: As a favor to Nadia, Moises begins asking around in hopes of uncovering the truth about Roland's death. Because of this, Justin grows increasingly wary of the newcomer's investigation.

Episodes.Title: Hell Night
Episodes.Description: The hell night has finally arrived for the potential new members of Gamma Sigma Xi as they reach the final stage of initiation. However, Justin ensures things will be much more difficult for Moises as the latter probes into Roland's death.

Episodes.Title: Member
Episodes.Description: The Gamma Sigma Xi members officially welcome Moises and his friends to their brotherhood. Estong discovers that Moises defied his orders and persisted in joining the fraternity.

Episodes.Title: Uncovered Secret
Episodes.Description: Moises continues to get into Rafael's good graces, especially after the governor appreciated his kindness in helping the Salvacions seek justice for Roland's death. However, Moises' goodwill also brings Rafael closer to uncovering Justin's secret.

Episodes.Title: Pressure
Episodes.Description: Moises and his friends resort to desperate measures in hopes of squeezing the truth out of Percy. Meanwhile, unaware of yet another trouble Moises has gotten himself into, Estong refuses to give up on finding his estranged daughter.

Episodes.Title: Fear
Episodes.Description: Justin gloats as Crestwood University's administrators impose expulsion on Moises, seeking to silence his quest for justice for Roland. Meanwhile, Mercedes reverts to an old habit amid familial stress.

Episodes.Title: Ally
Episodes.Description: Moises reaches out to his Gamma Sigma Xi brothers for help in overturning the expulsion decision against him and his friends. Rafael pays the Salvacions a visit.

Episodes.Title: Reputation
Episodes.Description: The news about Moises' expulsion comes as a blow to Estong. Amid the campaign season for the upcoming national elections, the Sagrados pull strings to ensure that Roland's case stays under their control.

Episodes.Title: Scandal
Episodes.Description: Mercedes' jealousy catapults Rafael into a scandal, threatening her husband's candidacy. Moises' faith is tested as Estong's hospital bills start to pile up.

Episodes.Title: Damage Control
Episodes.Description: Rafael uses his housing project for damage control to gain favor with the voting public amidst his current issue. Estong's plea surprises Grace and Moises.

Episodes.Title: Overdose
Episodes.Description: Fearing her bloody secret would be exposed, Mercedes' restlessness leads her into danger. Fortunately, an unexpected guest in the mansion comes to her aid just in time. Elias continues to vie with Rafael for their party's presidential nomination.

Episodes.Title: Support
Episodes.Description: Mercedes recalls her dark secret as a strong sense of despair hits her. With Moises' readmittance to Crestwood, Justin prohibits him from further investigating Roland's death. Meanwhile, Rafael and Elias file for their candidacies.

Episodes.Title: Campaign
Episodes.Description: Moises and Grace volunteer to be part of Sagrados' campaign team as a gesture of gratitude for Rafael's unwavering assistance. Meanwhile, Nadia's suspicions against Rafael deepen, planting a seed of doubt in Moises.

Episodes.Title: Letter
Episodes.Description: Moises revisits Roland's old letters to Nadia in hopes of finding a connection between Percy and the late Crestwood student. Following the Sagrados’ successful campaign rally, a mysterious girl shows up and makes a surprising claim.

Episodes.Title: Guilty
Episodes.Description: A young woman shows up, claiming that Elias is her biological father. Meanwhile, Moises’ latest discovery sparks another conflict between him and Justin.

Episodes.Title: Proof
Episodes.Description: Maxene decides to join Felicia's sorority. Nadia confronts Rafael over her discovery about Percy. Moises finds a way to prove that Roland indeed applied to Gamma Sigma Xi.

Episodes.Title: Heartbeat
Episodes.Description: Moises and Maxene form a deeper bond as they obtain the video that could implicate Justin in Roland's death. However, Moises finds himself in a dilemma as his family and friends remain loyal to the Sagrados.

Episodes.Title: Bribe
Episodes.Description: As Moises relentlessly pursues justice, Rafael attempts to threaten and bribe him. Meanwhile, Elias officially acknowledges Danica as his daughter and warmly welcomes her into his home.

Episodes.Title: Election
Episodes.Description: Election day has finally arrived. Meanwhile, the Sagrados use their connections to keep tabs on Moises as he continues assisting Nadia in finding concrete evidence to reopen Roland's case.

Episodes.Title: Clash
Episodes.Description: The Sagrado tandem of Elias and Rafael celebrate their election victory. Justin confronts Moises at the fraternity house, resulting in a bloody brawl.

Episodes.Title: Uncovered Secret
Episodes.Description: Justin's recklessness strains his relationship with his father, forcing him to come clean to Mercedes. At the hospital, Rafael tries to downplay the altercation between his son and Moises.

Episodes.Title: Arrested
Episodes.Description: Estong angrily confronts Rafael after learning about what happened to Moises. Much to the Malonzos' indignance, Rafael soon turns the tables on Moises regarding Roland's case.

Episodes.Title: Revenge
Episodes.Description: Moises and Justin face each other in the prosecutor's office, awaiting the decision on the former's murder case. While Moises receives unwavering support from his family, the Sagrados strengthen their bond in the face of adversity.

Episodes.Title: Courage
Episodes.Description: As his uphill battle against the Sagrado family continues, Moises draws strength from his family and friends. Meanwhile, Danica airs her deep-seated grudges toward Elias and the Sagrado clan.

Episodes.Title: Setup
Episodes.Description: Unable to implicate Moises in Roland's murder, Justin ensures his former friend will face rightful punishment for defying him. Now the country's president, Elias defies Jaime's orders, much to the latter's annoyance.

Episodes.Title: Loyalty
Episodes.Description: Forced to go on the run, Moises turns to a Gamma Sigma Xi member for assistance. While Eleazar plants a seed of doubt in Rafael, Jaime confronts his brother for defying him.

Episodes.Title: Fugitive
Episodes.Description: After failing to capture Moi, Justin blatantly lies to the media, tarnishing his frat brother's reputation. Mercedes is left speechless by Diego's revelation. Rafael starts to entertain the possibility that Moi might be telling the truth.

Episodes.Title: Hulicam
Episodes.Description: Moises takes matters into his own hands and forces a confession from Justin. While her dark past continues to haunt Mercedes, Estong accosts Rafael for ruining his adopted son's life.

Episodes.Title: Blackmail
Episodes.Description: Diego uses Mercedes' dark past to blackmail her and extort money. As Moises' sole evidence against Justin falls into the Sagrados' hands, Maxene tells her friend that someone else still believes in his innocence.

Episodes.Title: Traitor
Episodes.Description: The manhunt operation against Moises continues as an unlikely person betrays him. While the Malonzos fight for justice, Eleazar starts to have second thoughts about the whole situation.

Episodes.Title: Stain
Episodes.Description: Eleazar is compelled to take action as Moises' case begins to tarnish the reputation of his family and the Gamma Sigma Xi. Meanwhile, Moises manages to get help from a Sagrado.

Episodes.Title: Defiance
Episodes.Description: Following Rafael's advice, Jaime devises a plan to prevent Elias from revealing the truth about their brotherhood's dilemma. Danica asks her dad to give Moi a chance to explain his side.

Episodes.Title: Hope
Episodes.Description: Moises finds renewed hope in Eleazar, unaware that the Sagrados remain one step ahead. Jaime reveals a shocking secret to his family as he decides to take matters into his own hands.

Episodes.Title: Ingrate
Episodes.Description: Rafael is haunted by memories of a past romance as he tries to prove his love for Mercedes. Accused of ingratitude by Jaime, Eleazar soon faces the consequence of aiding Moises.

Episodes.Title: Dishonesty
Episodes.Description: Jaime fabricates more lies to cover up his crime. As Moises gets falsely implicated, Rafael starts to feel that his family's web of lies is spiraling out of control.

Episodes.Title: Confession
Episodes.Description: Diego tries to extort more money from Mercedes while revealing another shocking secret about the past. As Jaime grows determined to finish off Eleazar, Moises faces the media to confess.

Episodes.Title: Success
Episodes.Description: Jaime claims victory for the Sagrado family as Moises falsely confesses to all the crimes he is accused of. Meanwhile, Mercedes is haunted by a gruesome crime she committed in the past.

Episodes.Title: Threat
Episodes.Description: As Danica clings to hope for Eleazar's survival, Jaime urges Rafael to leverage his role as acting president for their family's benefit. Meanwhile, Moises faces the gravest threat to his life behind bars.

Episodes.Title: Conscience
Episodes.Description: With Moises' life in danger, Rafael and Divine's conscience pushes them to do the right thing. While trying to escape, Moises discovers the traitor in his midst.

Episodes.Title: Pit
Episodes.Description: With the discovery of human remains at the site of her housing project, Mercedes fears that her dark secret may soon be uncovered. Rafael tries to prove himself to Moises and earn his trust.

Episodes.Title: Secret
Episodes.Description: Moises urges Rafael to do the right thing and expose the truth. The Vice President, meanwhile, finds himself keeping a secret from his own family as Jaime learns about the disappearance of their scapegoat.

Episodes.Title: Pagmulat
Episodes.Description: Rafael finds himself torn between helping Moises and protecting his own family. Meanwhile, Diego continues to extort Mercedes in exchange for his silence.

Episodes.Title: War
Episodes.Description: Rafael continues to aid Moises as Eleazar prepares to wage war against their family. Jaime remains unperturbed by the turn of events, putting Divine between a rock and a hard place.

Episodes.Title: Abduction
Episodes.Description: Foiling Divine's plan to escape her daughter, Jaime exposes their dirty work to Felicia. An unforeseen incident threatens to ruin Moises' chance of proving his innocence. Meanwhile Eleazar talks with his brother.

Episodes.Title: Confrontation
Episodes.Description: Moises turns to a trusted ally for help after finding himself in danger at the hands of the police. As the Sagrado family grapples with Rafael's abduction, the Vice President comes face to face with his captor.

Episodes.Title: Answer
Episodes.Description: While Moises contacts his family, Rafael returns home following his abduction. Estong and Grace stumble upo the cop investigating the remains found at the site of Mercedes' housing project.

Episodes.Title: Anak
Episodes.Description: Rafael's mysterious abduction sparks questions and speculation from both the public and his family. Meanwhile, Mercedes decides to strike back against Diego.

Episodes.Title: Revelation
Episodes.Description: General Arevalo resorts to violence in hopes of uncovering the identity of Moises' protector. Estong and Grace's world comes crashing down upon learning about Cristine's fate.

Episodes.Title: Agreement
Episodes.Description: While Moises continues to place his trust in him, Rafael confides in Divine about his plan to save Justin. Eleazar finds himself embroiled in another controversy. Melanie returns home.

Episodes.Title: Decision
Episodes.Description: Estong and Grace feel a strong sense of regret as they mourn for Cristine's passing. Eleazar is forced to make a big decision, putting Moises' fate in jeopardy.

Episodes.Title: Finish
Episodes.Description: Moises feels betrayed by Eleazar's decision, while the Sagrado family celebrates Rafael's rise to power. Mercedes makes a deal with Diego to get rid of Moises once and for all.

Episodes.Title: Standoff
Episodes.Description: When Diego returns empty-handed, Mercedes takes matters into her own hands. Meanwhile, Eleazar demands the return of his daughter and threatens Jaime, who remains oblivious to the betrayal brewing among those closest to him.

Episodes.Title: Doubt
Episodes.Description: Unaware of Danica's situation, Moises reaches out to her for help. Meanwhile, Nadia and Melanie suffer the consequence of aiding the Sagrados' archenemy.

Episodes.Title: Curse
Episodes.Description: While Rafael takes his oath as the new president, the police rush to Crestwood University in hopes of capturing Moises. Unbeknownst to them, a new ally comes to the boy's rescue.

Episodes.Title: Force
Episodes.Description: Estong and Grace storm into Rafael's oath-taking ceremony to demand that he fulfill his promise to Moises, only to land in jail. Eleazar gatecrashes the Sagrados' celebration.

Episodes.Title: Deception
Episodes.Description: Eleazar causes a scene at the Sagrados' celebration to pressure Jaime into freeing Danica. As the Malonzos get released from jail, Rafael soon learns about what happened to Grace.

Episodes.Title: Frat War
Episodes.Description: While deep in thought about her family's dire situation, Grace receives a glimmer of hope. Justin and his brothers confront Prof. Elmer, suspecting that Omega Alpha Rho is harboring Moi.

Episodes.Title: Discovery
Episodes.Description: As Eleazar faces arrest on corruption charges, Jaime forms a new alliance to solidify his hold on power. Despite his friend's sacrifice, Moises falls into the hands of his enemies. Rafael visits the Malonzos to offer his help.

Episodes.Title: Sin
Episodes.Description: After meeting with the Malonzos to assure them of his help, Rafael finds himself haunted by memories of his sinful affair. General Arevalo pressures Moises into revealing the identity of his accomplice.

Episodes.Title: Trust
Episodes.Description: Rafael finally finds Danica, while Ernesto and Grace are forced to trust an old foe to flee from Jaime's men. Later, the president secretly digs deeper into Cristine's mysterious death.

Episodes.Title: Atonement
Episodes.Description: Burdened by guilt over Cristine's fate, Rafael feels compelled to atone for his mistakes by helping Moises. Much to his father's disgust, Justin makes an appalling suggestion involving the enemies of the Sagrados.

Episodes.Title: Mission
Episodes.Description: Rafael and his security team set out on a mission to rescue both Moises and Danica. The president's actions, however, start to raise suspicions in Jaime.

Episodes.Title: Betrayal
Episodes.Description: Justin grows furious at the thought of his father siding with Moises. To make matters worse for the Sagrados, Rafael's action empowers Eleazar to strike back and wage war against them.

Episodes.Title: Confrontation
Episodes.Description: Jaime confronts Eleazar after his brother exposed his evil acts. While Rafael informs Justin about his deal with the ex-president, Mercedes grows increasingly fearful of what her husband might do once he learns the truth.

Episodes.Title: Reckoning
Episodes.Description: While defending Moises' innocence, Rafael exposes his and Jaime's wrongdoings. As Jaime prepares for his next move, Mercedes finds herself between a rock and a hard place.

Episodes.Title: Pillar
Episodes.Description: Rafael learns that Cristine had given birth to a child before she died. Diego seeks Nadia and Melanie's forgiveness, hiding his true motive in coming back to their lives. Jaime warns Rafael about the consequences of betraying him.

Episodes.Title: Ambush
Episodes.Description: Eleazar warns Rafael about the full extent of Jaime's plans for revenge. As anticipated, Jaime has one final trick up his sleeve to locate Moises and Danica. Meanwhile, Rafael gets transferred to a new detention center.

Episodes.Title: Kapalit
Episodes.Description: Rafael escapes with the Malonzos, though his life remains in grave danger. An old threat to Moises' life reemerges as Mercedes learns about her husband's investigation into Cristine's murder.

Episodes.Title: Wanted
Episodes.Description: Rafael becomes a wanted fugitive following his escape, with Jaime showing no mercy toward his once-adopted son. Meanwhile, Justin's anger toward his father intensifies.

Episodes.Title: Pagtatagpo
Episodes.Description: Rafael arranges a meeting with Mercedes and Justin. However, danger looms as Justin, devastated by the truth about Moises, betrays his father and informs Jaime about the rendezvous.

Episodes.Title: The Choice
Episodes.Description: Following a shocking revelation, an emotional Justin forces Rafael to choose between him and Moises. Mercedes's world crumbles as her husband makes a heartbreaking choice after learning the truth about Cristine's death.

Episodes.Title: The Attack
Episodes.Description: Eleazar stands his ground when Jaime intimidates him into revealing Rafael's whereabouts. Meanwhile, Rafael returns to Moises, unaware that his adoptive father is on his way to them.

Episodes.Title: Preparation
Episodes.Description: Moises reunites with Maxene, who offers to help him and his family escape. While their enemies go into hiding, Jaime prepares Justin for the inevitable battle against Moises and Rafael.

Episodes.Title: Disguise
Episodes.Description: Rafael, Moises, Grace and Ernesto assume false identities as they seek refuge in Maxene's hometown. However, Moises's attempt to be of help puts their cover at risk of being exposed.

Episodes.Title: Riot
Episodes.Description: Divine's attempt to convince Felicia to stay away from Justin leads to a tragedy. Rafael seizes the chance to learn more about Moises through Grace. A riot erupts as Eleazar fights for his rightful claim to the presidency.

Episodes.Title: Inspiration
Episodes.Description: As Moises draws inspiration from Maxene to dream once more for his family, Justin strives to restore his family's reputation. Despite the bad news, Eleazar's action proves advantageous for him.

Episodes.Title: Love
Episodes.Description: Rafael savors the time spent with Moises while pretending to be father and son. At the same time, Moises finds the love and peace he has longed for in Maxene. Meanwhile, Eleazar remains steadfast in his fight for truth and injustice.

Episodes.Title: Sabotage
Episodes.Description: While Moises and Maxene enjoy a romantic rendezvous, Matias hides a secret of his own. Rafael confronts Justin about his attempts to tarnish his reputation and sway public opinion against him.

Episodes.Title: Trump Card
Episodes.Description: Rafael makes a tough decision to atone for his family's crimes. Matias and his group plan an uprising against their corrupt mayor, hinting at a hidden trump card against their enemy. Felicia receives heartbreaking news about her father.

Episodes.Title: Face-Off
Episodes.Description: Elias urges his frat brothers to support his claim to the presidency, prompting Jaime to kick him out of Gamma Sigma XI. As he is about to leave, Rafael gets caught off guard by Matias's revelations. Unknown to them, danger looms over their heads.

Episodes.Title: Surprise
Episodes.Description: Lorenzo informs Jaime about a surprise for his upcoming birthday celebration. As the mayor's forces close in, Rafael and his allies fiend themselves in imminent danger.

Episodes.Title: Attack
Episodes.Description: While Nadia and Diego head out to meet the former first lady, Mercedes plans a new demolition job against Rafael. Together with the wanted ex-president, Mattias and his group prepare to launch an attack against on Lorenzo's drug den.

Episodes.Title: Unbothered
Episodes.Description: Shaira receives a stern warning from Jaime. Soon, a news report exposes Rafael's past relationship with Cristine and alleges his involvement in her tragic death.

Episodes.Title: Raid
Episodes.Description: As an intense confrontation unfolds between Nadia and Mercedes, another life falls into the Sagrados' hands. While Rafael and Mattias launch an attack against Mayor Lorenzo, Moises secretly sets out to help them.

Episodes.Title: Rescue
Episodes.Description: Moises comes to Rafael's rescue, only to be caught by Mayor Lorenzo's men. Getting wind of the latest news, Estong confronts Rafael when he returns without Moises. Meanwhile, Kelvin finds himself in danger.

Episodes.Title: Captive
Episodes.Description: Moises risks his life to escape from his captors. Rafael denies the allegations of masterminding Cristine's death. While Grace believes in Rafael's innocence, Estrong grows increasingly suspicious of him.

Episodes.Title: Execution
Episodes.Description: Tragedy befalls Nadia amid her attempt to expose the truth. Rafael and Mattias sneak into Mayor Lorenzo's mansion to rescue Moises. Justin prepares to punish Kelvin for betraying Gamma Sigma Xi.

Episodes.Title: Defection
Episodes.Description: Unable to tolerate the brutal punishment inflicted on Kelvin, some frat members turn their backs on Justin and Gamma Sigma Xi. As controversies surround Jaime, cracks begin to form within his inner circle.

Episodes.Title: Gift
Episodes.Description: Divine and Felicia's chances of leaving the Sagrados dwindle after Justin learns about his girlfriend's pregnancy. An unexpected guest spoils Jaime's birthday celebration.

Episodes.Title: Blood Ties
Episodes.Description: As they finally come face-to-face with Moises, Jaime and Justin try to turn him against Rafael. Meanwhile, the former president seeks the help of a powerful ally in his mission to save his captured son.

Episodes.Title: Reunion
Episodes.Description: While Jaime anticipates a grand family reunion, bloody combat ensues between Justin and Moises in the latter's desperate attempt to escape. With his grandson in danger, Ernesto resolves to take matters into his own hands.

Episodes.Title: Territory
Episodes.Description: Rafael, Elias, and Grace storm into Lorenzo's territory in a daring attempt to rescue Moises. Meanwhile, Moises and Estong's heartfelt reunion is cut short as they soon face grave danger.

Episodes.Title: Sacrifice
Episodes.Description: Grief engulfs the Malonzos and their allies as Moises' freedom comes at a high price. Despite Justin's warning, Felicia and Divine make another attempt to escape from the Sagrados.

Episodes.Title: Revenge
Episodes.Description: Jaime remains deeply wounded by Rafael and Elias' betrayals. While Elias vows to help the Malonzos find justice for their sufferings, Maxene tries to stop Moises from taking the law into his own hands.

Episodes.Title: Reckoning
Episodes.Description: While Justin insists on marrying Felicia, Jaime confronts Divine for helping Rafael and Eleazar behind his back. Meanwhile, Moises reunites with his friends for refuge, unaware that Lorenzo's men have already tracked them down.

Episodes.Title: Trap
Episodes.Description: Mayor Lorenzo meets his downfall after his plans against Moises backfire on him. Rafael confronts Jaime about Moises' whereabouts and Cristine's death, unaware of a trap to capture him.

Episodes.Title: Father
Episodes.Description: Rafael spots Moises and attempts to bring him to safety, but Moises rejects him as his father and vows revenge on the Sagrados. Despite the growing public unrest, Justin pushes ahead with his plans to marry Felicia, unaware of the lurking threat.

Episodes.Title: Protest
Episodes.Description: With Grace and Melanie leading the charge, protesters claim victory as Jaime's allies fall one after another. While Eleazar reclaims his position, Jaime instructs Divine to plan their escape.

Episodes.Title: Deception
Episodes.Description: While tragedy befalls Felicia after Justin discovers her betrayal, Jaime uses all means to escape upon realizing he has fallen into a trap. Soon, tables turn as Moises, and the other members of Gamma Sigma Xi hold Justin captive.

Episodes.Title: Brothers
Episodes.Description: After exposing the Sagrados' true face to the public, Moises ruthlessly punishes an unrepentant Justin. Rafael races against time to stop his sons fighting each other to the death.

Episodes.Title: Truth
Episodes.Description: Rafael joins Eleazar in his preparation for his presidential re-inauguration. Mercedes confronts Moises, only for the boy to learn the truth about Cristine's death.

Episodes.Title: Family
Episodes.Description: Standing at the crossroads, Rafael grapples with a heavy choice in order to save Moises' life. After Eleazar's re-inauguration ceremony ends in tragedy, a triumphant Jaime spills more blood.

Episodes.Title: Justice
Episodes.Description: After losing his remaining ally, Jaime attempts to kill Moises, but an unexpected person arrives to save the young Sagrado. Soon, retribution comes for the vicious kingmaker.

Episodes.Title: Changes
Episodes.Description: Rafael and Justin face their punishment, but not before reconciling with Moises. As Roland finally gets the justice he deserves, Moises leads a major change in Gamma Sigma Xi.

Entries.Title: Pulang Araw
Entries.Description: Red Sun is a family drama that tells stories of courage, sacrifice, and hardships that every Filipino family has. These stories were inspired by the tales of the unsung heroes who defied the odds of World War II and the Japanese occupation of the Philippines.

Episodes.Title: The story of Eduardo and Adelina during the war period!
Episodes.Description: Amidst fighting in the war, Eduardo continues to write a letter for his sister, Adelina, making her remember their early childhood memories, especially when their mother is still alive.

Episodes.Title: Adelina discovers the truth
Episodes.Description: After Adelina and Eduardo separate, Adelina finally discovers the world of vaudeville and her father's true life.

Episodes.Title: The discrimination against Adelina!
Episodes.Description: Now that Julio's big secret is out, Adelina faces the wrath of her father's wife, Carmela, as she steps into their lives.

Episodes.Title: Father and Son
Episodes.Description: After understanding the situation of Adelina and Eduardo, will Teresita choose to forgive her half-sister and start to move on with their lives?

Episodes.Title: Home on the Range
Episodes.Description: After a fire razes his theater to the ground, Julio desperately seeks help to rebuild it. Later, Hiroshi gives the family a well-meaning gift.

Episodes.Title: Julio disappeared without a trace!
Episodes.Description: Carmela discovers that her husband disappeared without a trace, and Julio's two daughters feel abandoned for what he did.

Episodes.Title: The promised dream of Teresita and Adelina
Episodes.Description: After their father’s sudden disappearance, Teresita and Adelina vowed to each other that they would do everything in their power to achieve their dream of performing in vaudeville, in honor of their father.

Episodes.Title: Teresita and Adelina continues to pursue their dream!
Episodes.Description: Teresita and Adelina secretly plan their next steps to pursue their dream of performing at the vaudeville, while hiding it from Carmela.

Episodes.Title: Adelina and Teresita fulfilled their promise to reach their dream
Episodes.Description: Despite Carmela's persistent threats, Teresita and Adelina remain committed to achieving their dream of performing at the vaudeville. Will their next audition finally bring them success?

Episodes.Title: Carmela's bitterness reached new heights!
Episodes.Description: Carmela’s decision sparks another chaos in the Borromeo household, affecting Adelina and Teresita’s plans and putting Eduardo in a tight spot.

Episodes.Title: The price to pay for Eduardo's freedom
Episodes.Description: Adelina gives Carmela an ultimatum to drop the lawsuit she filed against her brother. Will Adelina be able to pay the price for her demand?

Episodes.Title: The childhood friend of Teresita and Adelina returns
Episodes.Description: As Teresita, Adelina, and Eduardo make amends, one of their childhood friends, who left for Japan years ago, will be coming back to the Philippines.

Episodes.Title: The much-awaited day of Adelina and Teresita!
Episodes.Description: The much-awaited day of Adelina's and Teresita's vaudeville performance has come, and they are unaware that it will also be the day their beloved father Julio returns.

Episodes.Title: Julio and Carmela face each other again!
Episodes.Description: With the return of her long-lost husband, Julio, Carmela's life is about to be disrupted again. How will his return affect her plans?

Episodes.Title: Hiroshi and Adelina meets again
Episodes.Description: After being separated from his friends for a long time, Hiroshi will finally have the chance to reconnect with Adelina. What will be their first step in rediscovering their friendship?

Episodes.Title: Eduardo confessed his secret desire for Teresita!
Episodes.Description: Eduardo tells Carmela about his real feelings for her daughter. Will he be able to confess his feelings to Teresita?

Episodes.Title: Eduardo and Teresita have feelings for each other!
Episodes.Description: Eduardo and Teresita's friendship deepens as they come to realize their true feelings for each other.

Episodes.Title: Teresita was arranged to be married with Hiroshi!
Episodes.Description: Teresita finds herself in a tough spot after finding out about the marriage arrangement planned by Chikara and Carmela.

Episodes.Title: The marriage that will separate Adelina and Teresita!
Episodes.Description: As Teresita and Hiroshi's arranged marriage is finalized, Teresita learns that Adelina secretly has feelings for her future husband. How will this impact their family's plans?

Episodes.Title: The friendship of Adelina, Tereista, Hiroshi, and Eduardo, is torn apart
Episodes.Description: The friendship between Adelina, Teresita, Hiroshi, and Eduardo will be torn apart as a result of Teresita's and Hiroshi's arranged marriage.

Episodes.Title: The impending war brings fear!
Episodes.Description: Teresita and Adelina's families are concerned about the impending threat of the war between the Americans and the Japanese.

Episodes.Title: Anger and hatred against the Japanese started to grow
Episodes.Description: As the fierce battle between the Japanese and American forces continues, Hiroshi and the other Japanese soldiers are now in imminent danger.

Episodes.Title: Adelina starts to search for her only love, Hiroshi
Episodes.Description: As chaos breaks out in their country and tensions rise between the Japanese and Filipinos, Adelina will search for Hiroshi.

Episodes.Title: Adelina and Hiroshi confessed their feelings for each other
Episodes.Description: Adelina's and Hiroshi's might have a chance to reconcile as Teresita discovers Hiroshi’s true feelings toward her sister.

Episodes.Title: The feared war has arrived in the Philippines!
Episodes.Description: How will the Borromeo family manage to help Hiroshi before the dreaded war finally arrives in the Philippines?

Episodes.Title: The crime that will end the family of Hiroshi!
Episodes.Description: Lauro is determined to get the riches from the Tanaka family, even if it costs them their lives.

Episodes.Title: Justice for the Tanaka family!
Episodes.Description: Will Eduardo and the Borromeo family be able to secure justice for the Tanaka family following Lauro's crime?

Episodes.Title: Hiroshi is engulfed by a deep sorrow and pain
Episodes.Description: Eduardo and Julio visit Hiroshi to deliver the devastating news about his beloved mother's death. How will Hiroshi accept this tragic revelation, knowing that Eduardo's relative is the one responsible for her demise?

Episodes.Title: Hiroshi attempts to flee from Filipino captors!
Episodes.Description: Hiroshi puts his life on the line after he decides to take a bold escape from Filipino's captivity. Will he be victorious in his attempt?

Episodes.Title: The life-changing decision in Hiroshi's hand
Episodes.Description: Hiroshi needs to make a crucial decision that could impact his future and that of Adelina Teresita and Eduardo.

Episodes.Title: The beautiful city of Manila became a battlefield!
Episodes.Description: The Japanese began invading and bombing Manila, leading to numerous Filipino casualties in the Japanese Imperial Army.

Episodes.Title: Carmela disapproves of her daughter's relationship!
Episodes.Description: Carmela is determined to prevent the growing relationship between Teresita and Eduardo and seems prepared to do whatever it takes to end it.

Episodes.Title: The Japanese invaders target the Borromeo family!
Episodes.Description: Will the Borromeo family find a way out of the danger they face after being targeted by the Japanese invaders?

Episodes.Title: The forbidden lovers' lives collide again!
Episodes.Description: Now that the Borromeos are residing with the Tanakas, Adelina's and Hiroshi’s paths cross again. Can their feelings for each other survive, with the lingering questions about the latter’s involvement in the Japanese invasion?

Episodes.Title: Teresita captivated the Japanese invader's heart!
Episodes.Description: Adelina and Teresita are forced to perform in front of the Japanese invaders, and it seems that Teresita's captivating beauty will win over an officer.

Episodes.Title: Eduardo and Teresita’s night of passionate love affair!
Episodes.Description: With the looming threat that the Japanese have brought into the country, Eduardo and Teresita spend time with each other before it’s too late.

Episodes.Title: A Filipina's ordeal at the hands of the invaders!
Episodes.Description: Amalia endures hardships at the hands of the abusive Japanese invaders. Meanwhile, Carmela still insists on Teresita and Hiroshi's marriage.

Episodes.Title: Yuta's growing feelings for Teresita!
Episodes.Description: Now that Teresita's and Hiroshi's arranged marriage is no longer on the table, Yuta is determined to pursue her. Will Eduardo (Alden Richards) be able to take action against the colonel's actions?

Episodes.Title: Eduardo plans to elope with Teresita!
Episodes.Description: Eduardo proposes to Teresita that they should run away from their current lives and distance themselves from Colonel Yuta Saitoh.

Episodes.Title: Eduardo will face the torment of the Japanese!
Episodes.Description: After Eduardo failed to show up at their meeting place, Teresita, Adelina, and Hiroshi desperately searched for him, unaware that Colonel Yuta Saito and his men were preparing to torture the former.

Episodes.Title: The harshness of the Japanese invaders!
Episodes.Description: The Japanese Imperial Army seeks to clean up anything the Americans have touched to free the country from them, and one method is to punish the Filipinos through torture.

Episodes.Title: Eduardo will take matters into his own hands!
Episodes.Description: After enduring torment and witnessing the suffering of his fellow Filipinos, Eduardo decides to take matters into his own hands and find a way to escape the Japanese invaders.

Episodes.Title: The prisoners' daring escape from Japanese forces!
Episodes.Description: Eduardo and the other Filipino prisoners are set for their bold escape from the colonizers. Will they be able to attain the freedom they desperately long for?

Episodes.Title: The aftermath of Eduardo's grand escape
Episodes.Description: Colonel Yuta immediately orders his men to search for Eduardo after he escapes. Will he and Mario run free, or will the Japanese invaders capture them again?

Episodes.Title: Eduardo's next bold move!
Episodes.Description: As Eduardo reunites with Adelina and Teresita, they uncover the struggles he has endured and the crucial choices he must make to attain freedom.

Episodes.Title: The beginning of Eduardo's resistance!
Episodes.Description: Eduardo has decided to stand up and fight the invaders who are attempting to take advantage of them. How far will he go for his country?

Episodes.Title: The desperate strategy of a power-hungry mother!
Episodes.Description: Carmela is unwavering in her determination to connect her family with Colonel Yuta for power and protection, even if it goes against her family's wishes.

Episodes.Title: Yuta aggressively pursues Teresita!
Episodes.Description: With Carmela’s support, Yuta continues to pursue Teresita, despite her commitment to someone else. How will Adelina support her sister? Meanwhile, Eduardo and Mario continue searching for the guerrilla hideout.

Entries.Title: Widows' War
Entries.Description: Best friends Sam and George treat each other as sisters, but later on, their friendship is ruined. Both of them eventually find love, but unbeknownst to the two, they are marrying two men who belong to the same family, the Palacios.

Episodes.Title: Pilot
Episodes.Description: As Sam and her family face a challenging situation after losing her father, George is there to help them. Unfortunately, the latter’s kind gesture paves the way for their friendship to end.

Episodes.Title: Friendship Over
Episodes.Description: Even though the years have passed, George's and Sam's hatred for each other still remains.

Episodes.Title: Future in Laws
Episodes.Description: Sam (Bea Alonzo) meets Aurora (Jean Garcia), the mother of her boyfriend, Paco (Rafael Rosell). Will their first meeting go well?

Episodes.Title: Divided Family
Episodes.Description: Due to their love for each other, Paco (Rafael Rosell) and Sam (Bea Alonzo) married immediately. But what challenges will they face after tying the knot?

Episodes.Title: War of the Wives
Episodes.Description: Paco Palacios (Rafael Rosell) can no longer disguise his true colors as time goes by.

Episodes.Title: Monster in Law
Episodes.Description: Sam and Paco bring her family to live at the Palacios Estate, only for them to encounter George's family which leads them to war.

Episodes.Title: Forgive or Not to Forgive
Episodes.Description: Sam (Bea Alonzo) is in disbelief after witnessing the wild side of her husband, Paco (Rafael Rosell).

Episodes.Title: Unraveling Secrets
Episodes.Description: George (Carla Abellana) cannot help but become emotional as she recalls the intricate memories she had before joining the Palacios clan.

Episodes.Title: You Killed My Father
Episodes.Description: Paco's (Rafael Rosell) uncontrollable wrath will lead him to attempt to blackmail Sam (Bea Alonzo) into ending his life.

Episodes.Title: Deadly Fall
Episodes.Description: A peaceful night turns into a tragedy when everyone sees Paco's (Rafael Rosell) lifeless body.

Episodes.Title: Surprise Witness
Episodes.Description: The investigation for Paco's (Rafael Rosell) death immediately rolls out while the whole family is still grieving. Everybody is considered suspects, especially Aurora (Jean Garcia), George (Carla Abellana), and Sam (Bea Alonzo), who happens to be present right after the death scene.

Episodes.Title: Who Killed Paco?
Episodes.Description: After the cremation of Paco's (Rafael Rosell) body, Aurora (Jean Garcia) plans a funeral to which her son's wife, Sam (Bea Alonzo), is not invited.

Episodes.Title: Rumble at the Memorial
Episodes.Description: Aurora (Jean Garcia) does not believe that Sam (Bea Alonzo) is innocent of her son Paco's (Rafael Rosell) death

Episodes.Title: Restless Soul
Episodes.Description: Sam (Bea Alonzo) did not reveal to the authorities that she was the reason why Paco (Rafael Rosell) fell off the cliff.

Episodes.Title: Blackmail
Episodes.Description: Basil (Benjamin Alves) takes advantage of Sam's (Bea Alonzo) weakness and orders her to end her best friend's life, George (Carla Abellana).

Episodes.Title: The Cellphone
Episodes.Description: Paco's memorial intensifies the secret tension between Sam and Basil about the latter's possession of the video evidence of the former's death.

Episodes.Title: Death Threat
Episodes.Description: Will Sam (Bea Alonzo) agree to Basil's (Benjamin Alves) plan to assassinate her former best friend, George (Carla Abellana)?

Episodes.Title: Murder by Proxy
Episodes.Description: Will Sam (Bea Alonzo) be able to carry out her plan to kill her former best friend, George (Carla Abellana)?

Episodes.Title: George in Danger
Episodes.Description: Rebecca (Rita Daniela) reveals to Aurora (Jean Garcia) what the cards represent of the women who live on the Palacios Estate.

Episodes.Title: Descent to Madness
Episodes.Description: Aurora (Jean Garcia) is slowly losing her sanity as she continues to grieve Paco's (Rafael Rosell), death.

Episodes.Title: Sam is Pregnant
Episodes.Description: Aurora (Jean Garcia) intends to kill Sam (Bea Alonzo) for everything she did to her son, but learning of her pregnancy causes her to reconsider her plans.

Episodes.Title: Royales in the Palace
Episodes.Description: Because Sam (Bea Alonzo) is carrying Paco's (Rafael Rosell) child, Aurora (Jean Garcia) appears to be kind with her daughter-in-law.

Episodes.Title: Party Like It's Your Last
Episodes.Description: What is supposed to be Basil's (Benjamin Alves) grandeur birthday celebration turns into an unfortunate event in his life.

Episodes.Title: RIP Basil
Episodes.Description: How will George (Carla Abellana) and Sam (Bea Alonzo) face the future without their powerful husbands?

Episodes.Title: Another Investigation
Episodes.Description: On the night of Basil's (Benjamin Alves) death, he and Aurora (Jean Garcia) have an intense confrontation.

Episodes.Title: Untold Secrets
Episodes.Description: As the investigation on Basil’s (Benjamin Alves) death is ongoing, Sam (Bea Alonzo) makes her own secret quest in finding the former’s missing phone.

Episodes.Title: Poisoned Truth
Episodes.Description: Due to her anger towards George (Carla Abellana), Sam (Bea Alonzo) managed to frame her former best friend. How will George face this new challenge?

Episodes.Title: Blame Game
Episodes.Description: George (Carla Abellana) is facing multiple accusations, including murder and cheating, following the revelation of her relationship with the investigator.

Episodes.Title: Incriminating Evidence
Episodes.Description: Francis (Jeric Gonzales) has no idea how his name has been involved in Basil's (Benjamin Alves) death. Will he be able to defend himself?

Episodes.Title: Suspect Arrested
Episodes.Description: Sam (Bea Alonzo) confesses to her mother about the crime she has been hiding for a long time.

Episodes.Title: Farewell Basil
Episodes.Description: During Basil’s (Benjamin Alves) entombment, George (Carla Abellana) promises that she will seek justice for him. However, she faces another revelation that has something to do with her husband’s infidelity.

Episodes.Title: Baby Mama
Episodes.Description: Is Beverly's (Bianca Manalo) claim true that she and Basil (Benjamin Alves) had an affair and that she is now pregnant with his child?

Episodes.Title: Babies in the Palace
Episodes.Description: George (Carla Abellana) has no choice but to live on the Palacios Estate with his husband's mistress, Beverly (Bianca Manalo).

Episodes.Title: Suspicions and Motives
Episodes.Description: To expel Beverly (Bianca Manalo) from the Palacios estate, George (Carla Abellana) made a request to the woman. What could it possibly be?

Episodes.Title: Warning
Episodes.Description: Before Basil (Benjamin Alves) died, he made a promise to his mistress, Beverly (Bianca Manalo). What could it possibly be?

Episodes.Title: Gender Reveal
Episodes.Description: What was supposed to be just a typical ‘gender reveal’ party for Bev (Bianca Manalo) turns into a ‘secret reveal’ for George (Carla Abellana)!

Episodes.Title: Poor George
Episodes.Description: George (Carla Abellana) couldn't do anything when Galvan (Tonton Gutierrez) decided to kick her out of the mansion and almost deny her as Basil's wife.

Episodes.Title: Another Murder
Episodes.Description: Beverly (Bianca Manalo) was almost unrecognizable when Galvan (Tonton Gutierrez) found her body in the bedroom.

Episodes.Title: Killer On The Loose
Episodes.Description: Following Beverly's (Bianca Manalo) death, the Palacios family will be in turmoil. Will they discover who killed Bev?

Episodes.Title: Prime Suspect
Episodes.Description: What will Sam (Bea Alonzo) discover after seeing Aurora (Jean Garcia) heading towards the basement with two glasses and alcohol?

Episodes.Title: Sam insists she is innocent of George’s disappearance
Sam persuades Galvan to believe her claims!
Basil had a secret crush with Inigo!

Entries.Title: High Street
Entries.Description: Five years after, Sky is reunited with her high school friends through Sanya and Kenjie's engagement. However, things head south when Z suddenly disappears, with Sky and her loved ones being targeted by a vengeful puppeteer.

Episodes.Title: Danger Lurks
Episodes.Description: Now a multimedia reporter, Sky is determined to forge her path despite being hunted by nightmares of William. Soon, she reunites with her friends from Northford, unaware of the danger lurking behind her.

Episodes.Title: A New Team
Episodes.Description: Following a job rejection, Tania helps a woman who encounters a minor bicycle accident. Sky visits Luna and Harry's resting place, where she catches a glimpse of her stalker whom she believes to be Z.

Episodes.Title: Father-Son Reunion
Episodes.Description: Gino reaches out to Archie in prison to confirm Z's whereabouts for Sky, while the rest of their friends speculate about a possible connivance. Later, Cecille finds a way to make Gino come face-to-face with his father.

Episodes.Title: Sabotaged
Episodes.Description: Sky gets in trouble after an anonymous person sabotages her by leaking the developing story that she is working on through her social media account. Tim tries to help his troubled friend, but his superior tells him not to interfere.

Episodes.Title: Facing the Devil
Episodes.Description: As more questions plague her mind, Sky grows increasingly determined to find Z and insists on seeing William to quell her suspicions. She sneaks into the hospital, only to be faced with her worst nightmare.

Episodes.Title: Sisters
Episodes.Description: Cecille catches Sky disguising as William's nurse, igniting her desire to retaliate against the young journalist. After receiving an anonymous tip about Z's whereabouts, Sky confronts her half-sister about the threats to her life.

Episodes.Title: Abducted
Episodes.Description: Tori takes Tania out to dinner and discreetly tries to pry on her private life. Sky offers to accompany Z to the airport, only to witness a shocking incident. Meanwhile, Kevin expresses his intention to court Roxy.

Episodes.Title: The Hackers
Episodes.Description: Sky seeks Tim and the police's help in finding Z, but their search for leads proves to be a struggle. Sky's phone hackers' identities get revealed just as she comes up with a plan to trap the. Later, Sky receives an alarming video footage.

Episodes.Title: Person of Interest
Episodes.Description: Sky becomes the suspect in her half-sister's abduction case. She then asks Gino's help in representing her, sparking the renewal of their friendship. Things worsen when another footage of Z's kidnapping surfaces and further implicates Sky.

Episodes.Title: Detained
Episodes.Description: Archie refuses to cooperate with Gino, leading to Sky's detention for being a major suspect in Z's abduction. Meanwhile, Tori continues to butter up Tania with a hidden motive.

Episodes.Title: Released
Episodes.Description: Cecille confronts Gino for helping Sky in her case. While Poch catches the attention of a director, Tim's hard work pays off as he manages to clear the name of their detained friend.

Episodes.Title: New Targets
Episodes.Description: With Sky's release, Nikki and Wesley set their sights on their new targets. Poch arrives at the police station to surprise Tim, prompting the latter to keep their relationship a secret.

Episodes.Title: New Development
Episodes.Description: Sky uncovers a significant development in her investigation into Melinda's case. Z's condition worsens at the hands of her captors. Despite Kevin's grand gestures to win her over, Roxy cannot help but wonder about Archie's situation.

Episodes.Title: Identified
Episodes.Description: Gino protects Sky from a thief. Wesley fails to accomplish his mission, leaving him bruised and earning him a scolding from Tori. Later, Sky gets her hands on a piece of key evidence that reveals the identity of Melinda's murderer.

Episodes.Title: Escape Attempt
Episodes.Description: Ricardo tells Sky, asking her to be present when he surrenders to the police. Gino grows suspicious of Cecille upon learning that the person who sabotaged Sky's investigation was a woman. Z escapes from her captors.

Episodes.Title: Hardheaded
Episodes.Description: Tori's alliance with William is revealed. Determined to find her missing half-sister, Sky revisits the area where Z was abducted despite Gino and Tim's advice. Kevin rushes to Roxy's side when Riley gets sick.

Episodes.Title: Almost There
Episodes.Description: Sky's investigation leads her closer to Z's whereabouts, unaware that Wesley and Nikki are one step ahead of her. To Roxy's delight, Kevin makes a thoughtful gesture for Riley.

Episodes.Title: Bomb Threat
Episodes.Description: Sky and Gino's request to visit William gets granted, until a bomb scare hits the hospital where the convicted criminal is admitted. Amid the chaos, William finds his way to escape.

Episodes.Title: The Grand Escape
Episodes.Description: William remains nowhere to be found, causing great distress to Cecille and Tania. Amid the ongoing police investigation, Sky attempts to find answers on her own.

Episodes.Title: Another Death
Episodes.Description: Sky reaches out to Gino to apologize for doubting his intentions and hands him an item she found that belongs to William. Gino then goes back to the hospital in search of more clues, only to witness another disturbing death.

Episodes.Title: Family Portrait
Episodes.Description: Z gets blackmailed as Tim and the police begin investigating the house where she is being held captive. While Sky learns about the suspicions surrounding Cecille, Gino returns to their family home.

Episodes.Title: Nightmare
Episodes.Description: A terrifying nightmare haunts Gino. Poch is thrown into a panic upon learning about William's escape. Meanwhile, Sky attempts to verify Cecille's alibi on the day of the bomb scare.

Episodes.Title: The Clan
Episodes.Description: Roxy grows conflicted about a possible case of sexual harassment in her workplace. Gino learns of a disturbing family secret. Sky catches Brandon with another woman.

Episodes.Title: The Money Trap
Episodes.Description: Brandon tries convincing Sky to keep Tania in the dark about his messy situation with his ex-wife. However, he finds himself in a tight spot when Tania discovers that he has been lying to her. Archie attempts to reach out to Roxy.

Episodes.Title: The Secret Room
Episodes.Description: While Sky tries to find answers in the convent, Wesley digs up dirt on one of her friends. Gino continues to investigate his family's dark past. Later, William's whereabouts are revealed.

Episodes.Title: Mislead
Episodes.Description: Gino confronts his mother about the dark secrets he uncovered regarding William's clan. Soon, he and Sky become convinced that Cecille had a hand in the convicted criminal's escape, only to receive a misleading news.

Episodes.Title: Out of the Country
Episodes.Description: News about William fleeing the country shocks his victims, prompting Sky to finally confront Cecille over her false alibi. Meanwhile, Sanya feels pressured to meet the demands of Kenjie's parents.

Episodes.Title: Hostage
Episodes.Description: Nikki and Wesley begin to notice that Sky is now cautious around them. Witnessing the incident, Sky gets assigned to report the hostage drama that happened to Kenjie.

Episodes.Title: Rebels
Episodes.Description: Wesley helps Sky in her quest to locate William, only to find himself in a tight spot. Inspired by his friend's report, Kenjie takes a stand against his parents. Gino comes home to a horrifying scene.

Episodes.Title: Runaway Groom
Episodes.Description: Dante commends Sky for writing a moving article about the controversy surrounding the Juan Canning Corporation. While heading to the wedding venue, Kenjie is forced to make a heartbreaking decision upon receiving a damaging video file.

Episodes.Title: Blackmail
Episodes.Description: Devastated after her groom called off their wedding, Sanya finds solace in Sky's family. Tania flares up upon learning about Brandon and Sky's secret. Kenjie meets up with his blackmailer, only to fall prey to the latter's ploy.

Episodes.Title: Two-Faced
Episodes.Description: Desperate to settle his debt, an oblivious Brandon turns to Tori for help. Kenjie gets into trouble, prompting him to finally seek Gino and Tim's assistance in dealing with his problem.

Episodes.Title: Exposed
Episodes.Description: While Tania patches things up with her family, Sky learns about Cecille's dark and troubled past. To his friend's shock, Kenjie's dirty little secret gets revealed.

Episodes.Title: Out of Wedlock
Episodes.Description: A situation concerning Tania leads Sky to meet Tori for the first time. Poch's first film faces a setback, while Archie's parole finally gets granted. Later, Sky makes another surprising discovery about the Acostas.

Episodes.Title: Bittersweet Truth
Episodes.Description: While Sky contemplates whether to tell Gino the bittersweet truth or not, Cecille panics and stokes her son's curiosity instead. While rummaging through his old stuff, Archie receives a video that shocks him to his core.

Episodes.Title: Little Sister
Episodes.Description: Cheska continues to blackmail Brandon. Cecille tries to get information about William's whereabouts from Tori, revealing the connection between the latter and the ex-governor. Gino undergoes a DNA test to determine his real parentage.

Episodes.Title: Trauma
Episodes.Description: Brandon is left with no choice but to seek Tori's financial assistance again. Unaware of what happened to Poch, Tim chides his boyfriend for giving him the cold shoulder.

Episodes.Title: Administrative Leave
Episodes.Description: Archie reaches out to Sky and warns her against searching for Z. Tim finds himself in hot water for letting Poch escape during a drug raid. Tania seethes with anger upon learning of Brandon's latest blunder.

Episodes.Title: Rescued
Episodes.Description: Sky and Tim's investigation into a certain Corazon Garcia leads them closer to Z's whereabouts. Roxy decides to give Kevin a chance, unaware that Archie has finally returned.

Episodes.Title: Out of Danger
Episodes.Description: Sky feels relieved knowing that Z is finally out of danger. Despite risking her life to save her half-sister, Sky finds herself blamed by Archie. Meanwhile, Tania makes a firm decision.

Episodes.Title: Reunited
Episodes.Description: Tim gets suspended after Emil learned about his relationship with Poch. Sky tries to catch Nikki and Wesley in a lie. Amid his emotional reunion with Z, Archie sees Roxy at the hospital.

Episodes.Title: New Owner
Episodes.Description: Sky and Tim look into Wesley's and Nikki's backgrounds, while Tori reveals her true motive in seeking vengeance against the young reporter. Gino makes a shocking discovery about his identity. A new owner takes over On Quest.

Episodes.Title: A Product of Sin
Episodes.Description: Tori starts implementing changes at On Quest as soon as she takes over, leading Sky and Tania to begin suspecting her. With Gino questioning the identity of his real father, Cecille finds herself haunted by her dark past.

Episodes.Title: The Secret Door
Episodes.Description: Unaware that someone has been tailing her, Cecille's long-awaited reunion with William turns awry. Ria finds herself in a difficult situation, leading to Riley and Archie's unexpected meeting.

Episodes.Title: Enemy of the Enemy
Episodes.Description: Riley grows fond of Archie, prompting Roxy to convince her son to just forget about him. As Tori betrays her brother, Sky finally comes face-to-face with William.

Episodes.Title: He's Dead
Episodes.Description: Cecille's mental state continues to spiral down following William's death. Sky finds it hard to believe everything is finally over, unaware that someone else is out for her blood.

Episodes.Title: Start Anew
Episodes.Description: Archie and Z dream of starting anew now that William is dead. Just when she receives an inheritance from her late fugitive husband, Cecille gets implicated in his escape. However, a new name surfaces as the police dig deeper into the case.

Episodes.Title: Implicated Wife
Episodes.Description: After being implicated by Cecile, Tori is invited to the precinct for questioning. Meanwhile, Ria appears before the board regarding her complaints against Dr. Landicho.

Episodes.Title: Baby Sister
Episodes.Description: Sky and Dante come up with a plan to dig deeper into Tori's identity. Tania gets into big trouble at work, causing her to give birth unexpectedly. Worried about Tim's future, Edith talks to Poch.

Episodes.Title: The Breakup
Episodes.Description: Tim gets heartbroken when Poch suddenly breaks up with him. While Sky learns about the accusations against Tania, Tori continues to take the reins of OnQ. Archie plans to win Roxy and Riley back.

Episodes.Title: Among Us
Episodes.Description: Sky warns Dante about the imposters in their midst. Gino continues to gather information about Corazon, putting his life at risk. Roxy finally agrees to let Archie meet Riley.

Episodes.Title: A Favor
Episodes.Description: Wesley zeroes in on a new target. Following the attempt on his life, Gino continues his investigation into Corazon Garcia with his friends. Little do they know; Tori finds a way to cover her tracks.

Episodes.Title: The Instigator
Episodes.Description: Roxy finally introduces Archie to Riley as his biological father. Meanwhile, Damien comes clean to Poch about his connivance with Nikki to ruin him and Poch.

Episodes.Title: Obsessed
Episodes.Description: Tori unjustly fires Sky, pushing Dante to quit his job in protest and establish a startup online news company. Nikki confronts Wesley about his obsession with Sky.

Episodes.Title: Meet the Parents
Episodes.Description: Roxy's first meeting with Kevin's parents goes awry. After Wesley confessed his feelings for her, Sky receives an important clue about Corazon's real identity.

Episodes.Title: The Exposé
Episodes.Description: Tim tries to reconnect with Poch, but to no avail. Wesley bears the brunt of Tori's anger when Sky sabotages OnQ's relaunch and exposes the businesswoman's real identity.

Episodes.Title: Entrapment
Episodes.Description: Roxy, Ria and Yana devise a plan to gather evidence against Dr. Landicho. Archie seeks Roxy's permission to take Riley out on his birthday, but he receives a cold disapproving response.

Episodes.Title: Back to the Force
Episodes.Description: Tori receives a visit from the police after getting exposed. Poch opens up about his breakup with Tim to their friends, while the latter returns to the police force. Tania finds herself in another tight spot as she gets sued by Tori

Episodes.Title: Cyber Libel
Episodes.Description: Tania confronts Tori over her malicious accusations, leading to an altercation. Cecille tells Gino her suspicions about the medication given to her at the facility. Dante and Sky get summoned for cyber libel.

Episodes.Title: Busted
Episodes.Description: Dante, Sky, and their team celebrate after successfully defending themselves against the libel case. As she helps a drunk Wesley get home, Sky unexpectedly finds a familiar face in his place.

Episodes.Title: Surprised
