Episodes.Description: Wesley and Nikki find themselves in a tight spot as they try to quell Sky's suspicion. Archie, Z, and their friends prepare a birthday surprise for Riley, provoking Kevin to jealousy.

Episodes.Title: The Reason
Episodes.Description: Archie finally reveals to Roxy the real reason behind his disappearance, leaving her heartbroken for keeping it from her. Tori and Nikki brew another sinister plan. Gino catches a nurse drugging Cecille.

Episodes.Title: Murder Attempt
Episodes.Description: Tori's wicked plans start to go downhill as Nikki's hired accomplices get caught red-handed and questioned by the police. Sky's meeting with her former school principal leads her to another shocking truth about Tori's identity.

Episodes.Title: Set Up
Episodes.Description: Wesley tries to open his mother's eyes to the truth, but to no avail. The police team up with Sky to pin Tori down. Little do they know; the cunning businesswoman has a devious plan up her sleeve.

Episodes.Title: False Statement
Episodes.Description: Sky flees as she gets accused of assaulting Tori, finding refuge in Gino's place. Oblivious to Capt. Concha's cooperation with Sky, Tori gives her version of events and further incriminates the young journalist.

Episodes.Title: Arrest Warrant
Episodes.Description: Upon discovering that Capt. Concha is working with Sky, Tori instructs her spy to thwart their plans by any means necessary. The conflict between Roxy and Kevin worsens as the latter's jealousy spirals out of control.

Episodes.Title: Surrender
Episodes.Description: As Tim, Gino, Capt. Concha, and Atty. Jeff help her prove her innocence, Sky turns herself in to the police. However, tension escalates when Tori suddenly shows up at the precinct with alleged witnesses.

Episodes.Title: Dismissed
Episodes.Description: Things work out in Sky's favor as Tori's complaint against her gets dismissed. Roxy finally ends things with Kevin after another emotional confrontation. Later, Sky's family and friends gather to celebrate her win.

Episodes.Title: Guilty
Episodes.Description: Tim's heart shatters into pieces after Poch rejects his attempt to reconcile. A heated confrontation ensues between Sky and tori as Tania faces jail time because of the businesswoman's accusations.

Episodes.Title: Failed Mother
Episodes.Description: Tim confronts his mother after learning the true reason for his breakup with Poch. Soon, love reigns supreme as the old lovers finally reconcile. Sky digs deeper into Tori's past.

Episodes.Title: Family of Foes
Episodes.Description: Gino and Cecille discover the real cause of William's death. Roxy turns down Archie's request to be granted legal rights over Riley. Sky and her friends slowly unravel Tori's dark past and heinous crimes.

Episodes.Title: Scapegoat
Episodes.Description: Sky apologizes to her friends for dragging them into Tori's vengeful wrath. Nikki takes the fall for her mother's crimes, while Tori and Wesley go into hiding.

Episodes.Title: Hard Drive
Episodes.Description: Tim retrieves the files from Wesley's hard drive and makes another discovery about Tori and her children's malicious deeds. The police finally catch Tori's accomplice among them. Cheska comes clean to Sky, Tania, and Brandon.

Episodes.Title: The Accomplices
Episodes.Description: As the police interrogate all of Tori's accomplices, Wesley tries to convince his mother to leave the country. Still not receiving any help from her family, Nikki finds herself at wits' end. Edith seeks Poch's forgiveness.

Episodes.Title: Meet Up
Episodes.Description: Tori confronts Yana, but the truth about her husband's atrocities finally convinces her to let go of her revenge. Wesley resorts to a desperate move to be with Sky as his obsession with her drives him to madness.

Episodes.Title: Grieving Mother
Episodes.Description: Devastating news about Wesley reignites Tori's desire for vengeance. With a job opportunity waiting for her abroad, Roxy decides to make amends with Archie. Cecille seeks Sky's forgiveness.

Episodes.Title: Unreciprocated
Episodes.Description: Roxy gives Archie another chance. Sky lays bare her true feelings to Gino, while Tim reconciles with Edith. Soon, danger befalls Sky's family as Tori turns her grief into an ultimate revenge.

Episodes.Title: Twisted Justice
Episodes.Description: In her quest for twisted justice for herself and her family, Tori takes Tania and Star hostage. Racing against the clock, Sky is compelled to act when Tori coerces her into making a choice between her mother and her baby sister.

Episodes.Title: The Bomb
Episodes.Description: Sky's friends receive a message from Tori regarding Tania and Star's whereabouts, unknowingly falling into a death trap. Soon, Sky and Gino race against time to rescue their trapped loved ones.

Episodes.Title: Finale
Episodes.Description: To everyone's shock, Tori pulls one last trick up her sleeve just when she loses the upper hand. With a new shot at life given to them, Sky's family and friends try to forgive, move on, and forge new relationships.

Entries.Title: Chasing in the Wild
Entries.Description: Sevi is a basketball captain from a humble family. Elyse is a spoiled cheerleader. Though opposites, the two fall for each other. But can their young love survive the harsh realities that may come their way?

Episodes.Title: The Team Captain and the Cheerleader
Episodes.Description: It’s a contentious first meeting for Sevi and Elyse at the latter’s debut party. However, a mishap at the party signals the start of the two’s constant interaction, often to Elyse’s annoyance and Sevi’s amusement.

Episodes.Title: Nothings Into Somethings?
Episodes.Description: Elyse loses a bet with Sevi. Even though it might just go against her values as a cheerleader, Elyse goes through with the consequence of losing the bet, leading to confused feelings for Sevi.

Episodes.Title: The Case of Forgotten Things
Episodes.Description: Elyse and Sevi continue to hang out. But Elyse somehow starts feeling jealous of Luna.

Episodes.Title: Whatever You Call It
Episodes.Description: Elyse and Sevi get into a fight and keep their distance from each other. They end up meeting again at a party. But it’s awkward. Can the two make up and get back to how they were before?

Episodes.Title: Your Biggest Fan
Episodes.Description: Sevi admits his feelings for Elyse. But Elyse doesn’t really know how to respond to that. At the same time, they’re also both busy with their respective competitions.

Episodes.Title: Winner Takes All
Episodes.Description: Elyse shows her support for Sevi during his game, leading to a great game for him. But Elyse has prepared an even bigger surprise for Sevi.

Episodes.Title: Life and Love and Seasons
Episodes.Description: Elyse and Sevi continue to date but it seems it won’t be easy, especially having to hide their relationship from Alfred.

Episodes.Title: Milestones
Episodes.Description: Elyse and Sevi look back on their relationship as they now finally move in together.

Episodes.Title: Unit 1432
Episodes.Description: As Elyse and Sevi live in together, family problems trouble Sevi and keep him busy, leaving Elyse lonely.

Episodes.Title: The Mourning After
Episodes.Description: Elyse and Sevi take a break from their relationship. Will they find their way back together again?

Episodes.Title: I Love You, But
Episodes.Description: Elyse is still reeling from losing her mom. Could Sevi and Elyse’s relationship survive this tragedy?

Episodes.Title: The CEO and The Head Engineer
Episodes.Description: Years after their break up, Elyse and Sevi find themselves having to work together on a project.

Episodes.Title: Breaking Ground
Episodes.Description: Elyse finds herself in trouble. Despite the awkwardness, Sevi helps Elyse. But now, Sevi and Elyse are confused by all the mixed signals

Episodes.Title: Unit 1432, Part II
Episodes.Description: Elyse ends up staying in the condo with Sevi, but only as housemates and co-owners of the condo. But it’s hard when the past always seems to creep back up.

Episodes.Title: Nostalgia Is A Dangerous Thing
Episodes.Description: Elyse and Sevi start to see how living together with an ex is difficult. Aside from having to keep it a secret from others, feelings from the past get harder to deny.

Episodes.Title: Five Years of Remembering
Episodes.Description: Afraid of the past repeating itself, Elyse decides to move out of their condo once again.

Episodes.Title: What are we?
Episodes.Description: Elyse learns that Sevi was planning on gifting Elyse a ring. But Elyse doesn’t know what kind of ring it was, and more importantly, she doesn’t even know what the status of their relationship is.

Episodes.Title: Almost Happy Ending
Episodes.Description: An accident has occurred at the Batangas site. Even worse, Sevi is being implicated in the incident.

Entries.Title: Zoomers
Entries.Description: A youth-oriented series that revolves around the lives of senior high school students Jiggs, Hope, Kokoy, Tania, and Atom, who have forged a special bond of friendship during the pandemic. As they find their footing in this post-pandemic reality, witness how their friendship will be tested; as they will be challenged by their own pains, struggles, and dreams.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: On the first day of face-to-face classes, Jiggs brims with excitement as he looks forward to meeting the members of a chat group called "Zoomers." However, his excitement turns to surprise when he finally sees his online friends in person.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Jiggs receives discouraging news about his film festival application. Despite his friends' words of warning, he applies for an apprenticeship with a millennial filmmaker known for his accomplishments but also for his risky pastime.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Jiggs draws inspiration for his new film project from his friends, developing a special connection with Hope along the way. However, Hope's complicated situation puts their blossoming friendship to the test.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Jiggs continues to give Hope the cold shoulder. Mika brings Kokoy to a bar to help the young man forget his problems. Tania accidentally witnesses something shocking in her condo building’s lobby.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: After landing an opportunity to do a collab video with famous beauty influencer Faye, Tania finds something more than friendship blooming between the two of them. The Zoomers, meanwhile, unite and find a way to support Tania's passion.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Tania's coming-out video garners a hostile reaction from an unexpected person. Jiggs takes the first step to patch things up with Hope. Later, Tania confides in Dino about a private matter concerning their friends.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Tania confides a secret in Dino, only to be betrayed by him when he drops the bombshell to the group during a game and causes a rift. Soon, Atom discovers the real reason behind Dino's motive for befriending them.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Atom faces expulsion as Dino's accusations against him spread around the school. Worried about their friend's well-being, the Zoomers look for evidence to clear Atom's name.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Atom falls into despair as his schoolmates bash him online and ostracize him. Dino, on the other hand, brims with satisfaction as everyone on campus believes him, unaware of the trap he is stepping into.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Grateful for his friends' help in clearing his name, Atom promises to be a better person. While Mika and Kokoy receive his blessing, Jiggs stirs emotions with his latest work.

Episodes.Title: Anniverslay
Episodes.Description: As Jiggs receives an invitation to a short film competition promoting a beach resort, the Zoomers tag along to celebrate their friendship's first anniversary. Amid their summer getaway, however, a shadow from the past leaves Atom on edge.

Episodes.Title: F.O.M.O.
Episodes.Description: Jiggs faces a stumbling block as he crosses paths anew with an old foe, who happens to be one of the competition's organizers. Dino's presence at the resort alarms the Zoomers, especially when they struggle to find Hope.

Episodes.Title: A Sticky Situation
Episodes.Description: Mika reunites with a childhood friend, arousing Kokoy's jealousy. Tania finds herself in an awkward encounter with Faye at the resort. Hope receives devastating news about her scholarship application.

Episodes.Title: Hits Different
Episodes.Description: Mika's closeness with Enzo makes things difficult for Kokoy. Jiggs discovers a potential solution to Hope's financial problems. Atom continues his efforts to reconnect with Dino and help him recover from their past.

Episodes.Title: Vibe Check
Episodes.Description: Jiggs remains wary of Dino. Hiding his jealousy over Mika and Enzo's closeness, a drunk Kokoy confronts his rival in love. Tania tries to patch things up with Faye, unaware of a person getting in the way of their reconciliation.

Episodes.Title: Cancelled
Episodes.Description: The Zoomers welcome Dino to Jiggs' film production. Just when Tania resolves not to hold on to her feelings for Faye, the latter makes a confession that surprises her. Hope's trust in Jiggs is tested when she receives an enticing job offer.

Episodes.Title: Forda Fam
Episodes.Description: Tania helps Faye get through her dilemma. A message from Lone Wolf threatens to put the Zoomers in danger. Soon, secrets and hidden feelings come to light as tension rises among the group amid a power outage.

Episodes.Title: That's Sus
Episodes.Description: Beth helps Atom calm down while Mika tries to talk some sense into Jiggs after altercations break out amid the power outage. Just as the dust slowly settles, everyone gets shocked when the police arrive to arrest Jiggs.

Episodes.Title: Unhinged
Episodes.Description: Mika finds comfort in Kokoy following Jiggs' sudden arrest, leading the two into a situation they soon regret. With Dino's help, the Zoomers prove Jiggs' innocence and confront the person who framed him.

Episodes.Title: Finally
Episodes.Description: Tania makes a heartbreaking discovery about her best friend. As the bond between the Zoomers becomes even more unbreakable following their ordeal, the mysterious Lone Wolf lies in wait for them.

Entries.Title: How to Spot a Red Flag
Entries.Description: A spunky barista is torn between two gorgeous looking men - a confident bad boy and a charming good boy who are both involved in catfishing her. Despite noticing the red flags in the two men, is it still possible for her to find real love?

Episodes.Title: Talking Stage
Episodes.Description: Cha, a spunky coffee shop owner, finds solace in her online friend Matt whom she has yet to meet in person. However, everything changes when she finally comes face-to-face with the guy she's currently in the talking stage with.

Episodes.Title: Cheater
Episodes.Description: Cha crosses paths with Matt while uncovering the secret behind a trending coffee mix. Matt, on the other hand, discovers that someone close to him is the catfish who got him canceled online.

Episodes.Title: Code Red
Episodes.Description: Matt apologizes to Cha. However, reminded of how he owes JR his life, a guilt-ridden Matt hesitates to tell Cha the truth and instead makes a deal with his friend.

Episodes.Title: Beach Please
Episodes.Description: JR comes to Matt's rescue after Cha asked the latter out on a surf date. However, the barista considers ditching the plan when Ime disapproves of her action.

Episodes.Title: MattCha
Episodes.Description: Matt ends up enjoying his surf date with Cha. An untoward incident brings them closer, but those around them seem unhappy about it. Later, Cha makes a realization.

Episodes.Title: Sus
Episodes.Description: Cha's suspicions about Matt grow stronger as they become text mates while recovering from their sprains. To confirm her hunch, the barista pays her friend a surprise visit, only to lead to more confusion.

Episodes.Title: Yellow There Mysteryoso
Episodes.Description: Cha finally confirms that the person standing before her is not the same Matt she met online. After a heartfelt talk with Marian, Matt goes out of his way to find Cha and confess.

Episodes.Title: Breadcrumbing
Episodes.Description: Matt finds it difficult to come clean to Cha as they spend more time together at the coffee farm. However, a sudden request will bring them back to square one.

Episodes.Title: Confused Hearts
Episodes.Description: Refusing to ruin the happy moment he shares with Cha, Matt once again decides to postpone his confession and instead tries to boost JR's image with her. However, to Matt's surprise and confusion, Cha agrees to meet JR and go on a date with him.

Episodes.Title: Busted
Episodes.Description: Matt is forced to do the right thing when JR fails to come clean to Cha, only to hurt the barista's feelings unintentionally. Meanwhile, Marian discovers an anomaly under JR's watch and reports it to Leandro.

Episodes.Title: Catching Feelings
Episodes.Description: Cha struggles to accept that she is catching feelings for the real Matt, despite the deceit. Despite doing the right thing, guilt weighs on Matt for hurting two of the most important people in his life.

Episodes.Title: Manifesting
Episodes.Description: JR apologizes to Cha and learns that Ayat Blends is about to close down. While JR plans to take advantage of Cha's dilemma to win her over, Matt finds a thoughtful way to help her and the displaced workers.

Episodes.Title: Trabahohol
Episodes.Description: Despite her initial rejection, Cha decides to accept the job offer at Legacy Cafe for the sake of her team. Matt tries to be professional with Cha on her first day, while Marian reunites with Vivian after receiving a task from Leandro.

Episodes.Title: Special Treatment
Episodes.Description: Despite Matt's effort to clear the air between them, Cha remains reluctant as she becomes determined to fight her growing feelings for him. Meanwhile, JR seizes an opportunity to get closer to Cha, causing Matt to seethe with jealousy.

Episodes.Title: One Shot
Episodes.Description: JR finds a new opportunity to spend time alone with Cha. This time, Matt refuses to let them be, even going so far as to see JR flirting with the girl he likes.

Episodes.Title: Best Man
Episodes.Description: With her parents’ support, Cha grows determined to revive Ayat Blends Café. Matt confesses his true feelings for Cha to JR and finally decides to pursue her. Unwilling to back down, JR steps up his game—both at work and in winning Cha’s heart.

Episodes.Title: Lost and Found
Episodes.Description: When Cha loses her precious necklace, Matt and JR both rush to help her find it, each with their own approach to winning her favor. While JR spends more time with Cha at work, Matt focuses on making amends with Cha’s parents.

Episodes.Title: Perfectly Imperfect
Episodes.Description: Seeing JR feeling down after a tense confrontation with his father, Cha steps in as a friend. Upon learning of JR's dilemma, Matt, without hesitation, rushes to his aid, which leads Cha to a new lead in the scam that started it all.

Episodes.Title: Sigma Wars
Episodes.Description: JR takes Cha to the beach to keep her from going to the precinct. A surfing match breaks out when Ime spots Cha and JR together and orders Matt to separate them.

Episodes.Title: And the Winner Is
Episodes.Description: The rivalry between Matt and JR intensifies as they ramp up their efforts to win Cha's favor. Despite the new developments in the scam case, Cha finds little cause for celebration, caught between two good friends now at odds because of her.

Episodes.Title: Passenger Princess
Episodes.Description: Not wanting to put too much pressure on Cha, Matt and JR set aside their differences and reach a compromise. JR is frozen in place upon hearing the news of Jackie Bartolome’s arrest.

Episodes.Title: Red Alert
Episodes.Description: Cha and Matt's trip to the precinct proves futile when the authorities refuse to let her speak with Jackie Bartolome. As the case begins to take its toll on Cha, JR and Matt decide to call a truce.

Episodes.Title: White Flag
Episodes.Description: After Cha's alarming panic attack, Matt makes a thoughtful gesture to help her feel better. Later, Matt overhears JR’s phone conversation and finally discovers his friend’s true colors.

Episodes.Title: The Truth Will Set You Free
Episodes.Description: Setting aside his feelings, Matt tries to make Cha understand where JR is coming from. Leandro promises to stand by his son upon learning of his situation.

Episodes.Title: Night 2 Remember
Episodes.Description: Matt and JR face off once again, this time in a coffee-making contest during Legacy’s anniversary night. As this year’s best barista, Cha gets the final say in selecting the winning brew—and ultimately, the man who will win her heart.

Entries.Title: Sky Valley
Entries.Description: In the first tale, Junjun, a horseman working at the resort, finds himself irresistibly drawn to Fourth, a mysterious guest whose arrival stirs up deep emotions. The second story follows Paris, a vlogger from Manila, who falls for Taylor, the daughter of the resort's owner, sparking a passionate romance amidst the stunning backdrop of Sky Valley Park.

Entries.Title: My Guardian Alien
Entries.Description: An alien disguised as a human woman must protect Earth from an intergalactic threat while hiding her identity from her husband.

Episodes.Title: The alien is now Doy's friend!
Will Dr. Ceph meet the alien?
The alien is now fully charged!
The face-off of Venus and the alien

Entries.Title: Marahuyo Project
Entries.Description: Join King as he journeys through the highly traditional town of Marahuyo, meeting new friends and finding love along the way as he lobbies to create the first LGBTQIA+ org in their campus.

Episodes.Title: Amihan
Episodes.Description: King is exiled to Marahuyo after a conflict with the college dean. Reuniting with his mother and grandmother, he attends Mariano Soliman University (MarSU) where he befriends Venice, a transgender student. Witnessing Venice's struggles, he starts an LGBTQ+ student organization at MarSU.

Episodes.Title: Dios Buhawi
Episodes.Description: King meets the annoying, rule-abiding student council president Ino who rejects his application to start his student org due to the low number of LGBTQ+ students. Out to prove Ino wrong, King and Venice attend a house party to search and recruit their fellow community members.

Episodes.Title: Sidapa At Bulan
Episodes.Description: After successfully recruiting Venice and Lorie, King returns to Ino to have their org application approved. Meanwhile, Lorie contemplates whether joining the org is a good idea or not.

Episodes.Title: Santelmo
Episodes.Description: King, Venice, and Lorie are suspended and assigned to do community service. Ino attempts to get closer to King. Elsewhere, Venice seeks to reconnect with Archie as their past catches up to them.

Episodes.Title: Hunyango
Episodes.Description: King, Venice, and Lorie, together with Ino, do research on the rich history of Marahuyo for their school board pitch. Meanwhile, Archie ponders on how he wants to live his life and Lorie discovers the truth about Lili.

Episodes.Title: Sirena
Episodes.Description: King, Venice, Lorie and Ino pay an elderly resident a visit for an interview about the town’s past. As they find out the forgotten past of the town, Ino learns about the painful secret about his family.

Episodes.Title: Aswang
Episodes.Description: King, Venice, and Lorie search for Lili who disappeared after her sexuality is revealed. Elsewhere, Ino’s newfound courage is tested as he prepares for the annual Balagtasan.

Episodes.Title: Babaylan
Episodes.Description: Now reunited with Ino after his grand public revelation and impeachment as student council president, King, Venice and Lorie defend their org’s purpose and existence in front of the school board.

Entries.Title: Oh My Boo
Entries.Description: Have you ever experienced falling in love, getting hurt, and being GHOSTED? Watch out for true love that is "till death do us part".

Entries.Title: Baka Pwede Pa?
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Haunted Hearts
Entries.Description: After a car accident leaves him with amnesia, Jack is determined to rediscover himself using a bucket list. His latest adventure leads him to a Halloween party at a mysterious mansion, where he meets Magic, the charismatic yet elusive owner. But as Jack falls for Magic, he uncovers a shocking secret—Magic is a ghost tied to a dark past that is more connected to Jack than he could have ever imagined.

Episodes.Title: Spirits and Spells: The Battle for Magic’s House

Entries.Title: Is a Family Like This Worth Keeping?
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: A Sign of Affection
Entries.Description: Yuki Itose is just a typical student dealing with the pressures of college. She is struggling one day on the train when an upperclassman named Itsuomi Nagi helps her out. As he gradually opens a new world to her, Yuki develops feelings for Itsuomi. A pure love story begins to grow.

Episodes.Title: Yuki's World
Episodes.Description: Yuki, who was born in a world where sounds don't sound like anything, runs into the enigmatic Itsuomi and immediately takes an interest in him.

Episodes.Title: To Affection
Episodes.Description: Yuki tries to come to terms with her newfound feelings for Itsuomi, while Oushi offers a glimpse into what he's been trying to come to terms with for a long time.

Episodes.Title: Someone Is Thinking of Someone
Episodes.Description: Having come to terms with her feelings for Itsuomi, Yuki prepares to make her move, but she encounters a sight that throws her into confusion and doubt.

Episodes.Title: What Kind of Voice?
Episodes.Description: Having made plans with Kyouya to go shopping, Rin invites Yuki and Itsuomi to join them.

Episodes.Title: The Answer
Episodes.Description: Itsuomi and Yuki have a chat at his place, and several lingering questions are answered.

Episodes.Title: I Thought I Wanted to Keep Watching Her Forever
Episodes.Description: Yuki and Kyouya each urge Itsuomi to make himself clear on where he stands in his relationship with Yuki, and he surprises them with his answer.

Episodes.Title: Let Me Introduce You to My Girlfriend
Episodes.Description: Itsuomi is away on his trip, and Yuki is left trying to come to grips with their new reality.

Episodes.Title: One Small Step
Episodes.Description: Being introduced to Yuki gets Shin reminiscing about his high school days with Itsuomi and Emma.

Episodes.Title: I Don't Want to Leave
Episodes.Description: The gang heads up the mountains for a very eventful boot camp.

Episodes.Title: Oushi's World
Episodes.Description: Itsuomi knows that a confrontation with Oushi is inevitable and decides to take matters into his own hands.

Episodes.Title: Promise
Episodes.Description: Yuki faces her nerves before an interview for her part-time job, and Shin has to battle his to finally break the news to Emma.

Episodes.Title: Our World
Episodes.Description: Yuki and Itsuomi have their first date as a couple, and it leads to them learning more about each other.

Entries.Title: 7th Time Loop: The Villainess Enjoys a Carefree Life Married to Her Worst Enemy!
Entries.Description: Rishe, the duke’s daughter, is no stranger to reincarnation—it’s her seventh life, after all. Each life restarts at her broken engagement. Having been a merchant, a maid, and a knight, she now desires leisure. But her world changes when a prince, who killed her in a past life, proposes! To prevent war and live to a ripe old age, she begins her seventh life as the bride of an enemy nation’s prince.

Episodes.Title: The Fiancé Who Killed Me
Episodes.Description: Riesche Irmgard Wertzner, daughter of a duke, has a secret—she dies at age twenty and loops back to a moment five years prior. As her seventh loop begins, she swears to live a long, relaxed life. Then, the man who killed her in her sixth life appears!

Episodes.Title: The Golden Imperial Capital
Episodes.Description: Arnold proposes marriage to Rishe. She replies with certain conditions which must be met. Arnold gives his promise, and he and Rishe head to Galkhein. Rishe is excited to visit a country she's never been to, but wonders—what is Arnold truly after?

Episodes.Title: A Thinly Veiled Sword Dance (Rondo)
Episodes.Description: Rishe's new life in Galkhein begins with cleaning the villa that's her new home. She attends a party where she's presented as the prince's fiancée. Dancing with Arnold brings up memories of her past life, spurring her to test him just a little.

Episodes.Title: Turning the Knave into a Secret Spice
Episodes.Description: Kaine Tully has arrived to meet with Rishe. When she tells him that she wants his company to procure her wedding goods, he does something unexpected. Rishe knows that his trade routes could help stop the war. Will she succeed in making him an ally?

Episodes.Title: Another Kind of Trade
Episodes.Description: Rishe arrives at the chapel to find Theodore waiting for her with a warning. Arnold appears and his icy treatment of his brother leaves Rishe with more questions. But she doesn't have time for that. She still has to convince Tully to become an ally!

Episodes.Title: The Only One in the World
Episodes.Description: Rishe has been imprisoned. Her captor sits down with Arnold and tells him the conditions for her safe return. Arnold's seemingly nonchalant manner confounds Rishe's captor. What are the kidnapper's true motives? And what will Rishe do about the situation?

Episodes.Title: A Lullaby Like the Beat of a Heart
Episodes.Description: Rishe suggests to Arnold that he should live with her in the imperial villa. Arnold admires the work that Rishe and her maids have done. Rishe asks Arnold for a sparring match so that she can experience the special training given to the imperial knights!

Episodes.Title: The Color of the Sea Beyond the Horizon
Episodes.Description: Rishe's secret plan advances perfectly. Then, she receives an invitation from Arnold to join him on an incognito trip into town. Certain it must be for official business, Rishe goes along only to end up at a jeweler's where Arnold has a plan of his own!

Episodes.Title: Visitor from the North
Episodes.Description: As Rishe picks herbs for Kyle from her garden, Michel, a scholar she apprenticed under in her third life, appears before her. Later, at the party, Rishe spots Arnold and Kyle quietly slip away. She follows them and overhears Kyle make a bold request.

Episodes.Title: A Sweetly Fragrant Cigarette Is Lit
Episodes.Description: Rishe has kept a certain activity of hers secret from Arnold, but when he appears right in front of her, there's no escaping his notice. Later she learns that Michel believes Arnold fulfills every condition necessary to conduct a particular experiment.

Episodes.Title: The Determination of a Snow Flower
Episodes.Description: Rishe and Prince Kyle work to prevent Coyolle's future downfall. After making preparations, they gain the opportunity to negotiate with Arnold again, but things don't quite go to plan. Then, a message from Theodore arrives, interrupting their discussion.

Episodes.Title: The Most Beautiful Thing
Episodes.Description: Michel has decided who he'll give his black powder to, but Rishe plans to stop him using experience from her past lives and relationships built in this life. Will she be able to convince Michel? What will Arnold do when he sees the results of her plot?

Entries.Title: Omusubi
Entries.Description: A Heisei youth graffiti drama, in which the heroine Yoneda Yui (Hashimoto Kanna), born in the first year of the Heisei era, connects people's hearts to the future as a nutritionist. Always cherishing her individuality, she sometimes struggles, but powerfully and joyfully pushes through the turbulent Heisei and Reiwa eras.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: In 2004, Yui Yoneda (Kanna Hashimoto), who lives with her father Masato (Yukiya Kitamura), a farmer in Itoshima, Fukuoka Prefecture, her mother Aiko (Kumiko Aso), her grandfather Eikichi (Ken Matsudaira), and her grandmother Kayo (Yoshiko Miyazaki), enters high school. She talks about club activities with her childhood friend Yota (Araki Sugou) and her classmate Emi (Shuri Nakamura). Yota decides to join the baseball club, and Emi the calligraphy club, but Yui can’t think of any particular club she wants to join. One day after school, Yui encounters an unexpected situation at the fishing port she often visits to see the sea.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: After school, the heroine Yui (Kanna Hashimoto) is suddenly surrounded by a group of gyaru girls, and just when it seems like she might get beaten up, they invite her to join a gyaru group called the Hakata Gyaru Alliance (Hagyalen). It turns out that Yui's older sister Ayumi (Riisa Naka) was the first leader of Hagyalen and was a charismatic figure among the gyaru. When Yui returns home and talks about the gyaru group during dinner with her family, an argument unexpectedly breaks out between her father Masato (Yukiya Kitamura) and her grandfather Eikichi (Ken Matsudaira).

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Yui (Kanna Hashimoto), who joined the calligraphy club, starts to feel drawn to her senior Kazami (Matsumoto Leo) and feels like she's enjoying her youth. However, even when her classmate and fellow calligraphy club member Emi (Shuri Nakamura) hands her the official club application form, Yui hesitates to join. Yet, when she hears that her senior will be attending a calligraphy exhibition held in Tenjin, Fukuoka, she immediately decides to go. At the Yoneda household, Yui’s mother Aiko (Kumiko Aso) listens to her story and worries about Yui's hesitation to join the calligraphy club.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Yui (Kanna Hashimoto) runs into the gyaru girls near a game center in Tenjin, where they persistently push her to join the Hakata Gyaru Alliance, leaving her in a tough spot. Just then, the police arrive. It seems that a salaryman who saw Yui and the gyaru girls mistook the situation for extortion. The gyaru girls protest, insisting they haven't done anything wrong, but the man judges them by their appearance and calls them scum of society.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: On Sunday, Yui (Kanna Hashimoto) arrives at Fukuhaku Bridge, the meeting spot, to go to the exhibition with her admired senior from the calligraphy club, Kazami (Matsumoto Leo). Yui's heart flutters at the sight of Kazami in his casual clothes. As they head towards the exhibition together, Yui spots Suzurin (Natsumi Okamoto), a gyaru from the Hagyalen group, handing out tissues. To avoid being seen, Yui walks while hiding behind Kazami. In the midst of this, Suzurin suddenly starts to wobble and collapses to the ground.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Unable to ignore someone in need, Yui (Kanna Hashimoto) helps the gyaru, driven by the kindhearted nature of the Yoneda family. This leads to Yui secretly starting to interact with the gyaru from the Hakata Gyaru Alliance (Hagyalen), which her sister Ayumi (Riisa Naka) had formed long ago, without her family knowing. On weekdays, she participates in the calligraphy club with her admired senior Kazami (Matsumoto Leo), while on weekends, she spends time with the gyaru, living a double life. Meanwhile, Yui's father Masato (Yukiya Kitamura) reflects on the words from Eikichi (Ken Matsudaira) regarding his approach to farming.

Entries.Title: Orb: On the Movements of the Earth
Entries.Description: After learning heretical teachings about the Earth and the Sun, a child prodigy searches for his master's hidden research while evading the Inquisition.

Episodes.Title: Heliocentrism. How About That?
Episodes.Description: A gifted young student plans to study theology at university, but his true passion is astronomy. One day, he meets a mysterious scholar named Hubert.

Episodes.Title: And Now... I'm Going to Move the Earth
Episodes.Description: Rafał is intrigued by Hubert’s heliocentric theory. Later, Hubert is arrested by an inquisitor but he gives Rafał a pendant before being whisked away.

Episodes.Title: I... Believe in Heliocentrism
Episodes.Description: Nowak convinces Potocki to admit to Rafał's heresy. Once arrested, Rafał is given a choice: recant his belief in heliocentrism or submit to torture.

Episodes.Title: The Fact That This World Is Far More Beautiful Than Heaven
Episodes.Description: The duelist Oczy wishes for death so he can escape his hopeless world and go to heaven. His colleague finds meaning in life by observing the stars.

Episodes.Title: Even If I Die... This World Will Continue
Episodes.Description: Gras aborts the mission, placing himself and Oczy in mortal danger from Nowak. They both flee for the mountains, where they find a stone chest.

Episodes.Title: Move... The World
Episodes.Description: Oczy seeks the help of Badeni, the demoted monk who incurred the Church's wrath by turning his curiosity to the riddles of the sky.

Episodes.Title: Matters of the Truth
Episodes.Description: Gifted scholar Jolenta suffers discrimination as the only girl at an astronomy institute. Badeni seeks resources to prove the heliocentric theory.

Episodes.Title: We Must Become Icarus
Episodes.Description: Badeni offers Jolenta a chance to pursue the truth of the skies, but she is overcome with fear. Afterward, she overhears bold words from Count Piast.

Episodes.Title: This Is What It Means... To Learn Something, I Think
Episodes.Description: A middle-aged Piast vows to prove his professor's geocentric model. In the present, he agrees to let Badeni use his records — on one condition.

Episodes.Title: Truth
Episodes.Description: Oczy tells Badeni that he is learning to read and write. Later, Badeni's claim that knowledge should be held by a select few bothers a fellow monk.

Episodes.Title: Terror
Episodes.Description: Nowak gives two rookie inquisitors a terrifying first taste of their new roles. Badeni meets with Jolenta and tells her he has completed his theory.

Episodes.Title: Heliocentrism Is My Faith
Episodes.Description: Nowak asks Badeni to show him his research. He inspects Badeni's premises but doesn't find anything incriminating — until he spots a certain item.

Episodes.Title: Freedom
Episodes.Description: In a medical area within the inquisition chamber, a wounded Oczy awakes to see Nowak, who has kept him alive in hopes of extracting information.

Episodes.Title: Tonight's Sky...
Episodes.Description: Badeni must choose between revealing the location of the heretical documents on heliocentric theory or prolonging Oczy's torture at Nowak's hands.

Episodes.Title: Is It... My Turn?
Episodes.Description: Nowak believes his beloved daughter has been executed as a heretic. Father Grabowski comes across a letter from Badeni containing an unusual request.

Episodes.Title: It's Time to Begin the Operation
Episodes.Description: Twenty-five years later, Captain Schmidt of the extremist Heretic Liberation Front infiltrates a church and steals an important item.

Episodes.Title: I Could Make a Lot of Money with This Book… Maybe
Episodes.Description: A young nomad woman haunted by poverty devotes her life to obtaining wealth. One night, she discovers the book that Frei hid in the abandoned village.

Episodes.Title: To Liberate Information
Episodes.Description: Bishop Antoni orders Draka to hand over the book, but Schmidt’s men suddenly intervene. Determined to change her fate, she takes a bold action.

Episodes.Title: Wandering Is How You Find What's Right
Episodes.Description: Hoping to track down the people who stole the book, an inquisitor seeks advice from Nowak, who now spends his days drowning his sorrows.

Episodes.Title: I Love Heliocentrism
Episodes.Description: As the Heretic Liberation Front prepares to depart, Jolenta entrusts Draka with a letter. Soon after, Nowak and the inquisitors approach the barn.

Episodes.Title: The Times Are Changing
Episodes.Description: Schmidt and the others regroup with their Liberation Front comrades and begin printing the book. However, a traitor brings their operation to a halt.

Episodes.Title: Neither of You Will Be Known to History
Episodes.Description: As Nowak's group attacks the Liberation Front, Draka and Schmidt begin their escape. Upon reaching town, Draka makes a proposition to Bishop Antoni.

Episodes.Title: Comrades
Episodes.Description: A deluded Nowak turns against Antoni and attempts to burn down the church. Draka fights back and escapes but incurs a terrible wound.

Episodes.Title: Thaumazein
Episodes.Description: Albert goes to deliver an order of bread to a church. While there, he encounters a mysterious priest who encourages him to confess his sins.
Albert leaves the academic gathering and returns home to an awful sight. In the present, the priest gives Albert advice and makes his own confession.

Entries.Title: Rising Impact
Entries.Description: When a third-grader's natural gift for golf is accidentally discovered by a pro player, the boy embarks on a journey to be the world's best golfer.

Episodes.Title: Encountering a Dream
Episodes.Description: Pro golfer Kiria crosses paths with the mischievous Gawain — who possesses an astonishing talent for golf even though he's never played the sport.

Episodes.Title: The Importance of Each Stroke
Episodes.Description: Lost in Tokyo, Gawain has a fateful meeting with a sullen young golfer, who shows him the way to Kiria's home — and a new aspect of golf.

Episodes.Title: Twin Peaks of Talent
Episodes.Description: Gawain learns that making the ball fly isn't enough to become the world's best golfer. He asks Kiria to give him a crash course on putting and iron shots.

Episodes.Title: First Tournament
Episodes.Description: With his new skills, Gawain breezes through the first half of his inaugural tournament. But how will he fare when faced with bad weather conditions?

Episodes.Title: Camelot Academy
Episodes.Description: At Camelot Academy, Gawain meets his new classmates, gifted junior golfers from around the world. Riser, unimpressed by Gawain's size, challenges him.

Episodes.Title: Uncrowned Prince
Episodes.Description: To debut on the golf course, Gawain must win a game against Liebel on the D-level training course. But Liebel behaves strangely during the match play.

Episodes.Title: An Explosive Situation
Episodes.Description: With the Camelot Cup coming up, tensions rise with only seven spots open. Some older schoolmates take aggressive measures to cut the competition.

Episodes.Title: The Tryouts Begin
Episodes.Description: On the day of the tryouts, Gawain is up against Li and Todoin in a spiral course where his usual straight drive won't help. Can he master the slice?

Episodes.Title: Stubbornness and Pride
Episodes.Description: Yumiko struggles with a bunker shot, while Kuromine's gift for seeing snake-like putting lines gets her ahead. Lancelot's unexpected visit causes a stir.

Episodes.Title: Playoffs
Episodes.Description: The final playoff will decide who takes the last spot. But first, Riser and Gawain need to conquer a challenging course — and Kanazono's dirty tricks.

Episodes.Title: A Venerable Visitor
Episodes.Description: Gawain stumbles upon an unassuming salaryman wandering around the school grounds who turns out to be their new coach: Hitomi Katase, a former pro golfer.

Episodes.Title: To the Battlefield!
Episodes.Description: Kuromine challenges transfer student Lancelot, staking her pride as a putter and a spot on the team. The Japan team heads to England for the Camelot Cup.

Episodes.Title: Worthy New Opponents
Episodes.Description: Gawain's encounter with Quester from the U.S. team leaves him in shock. Lancelot joins some of his American counterparts for a training session.

Episodes.Title: The Door to One's Soul
Episodes.Description: Still rattled from his previous match with Quester, Gawain keeps duffing his shots. While he deals with his mental block, Platalissa confides in him.

Episodes.Title: Camelot Cup Competition!
Episodes.Description: A surprise change to the U.K. team's order of play disrupts Ms. Aria's strategy for the Japan team, but Gawain and Lancelot rise to the challenge.

Episodes.Title: An Awakened Power
Episodes.Description: As the pairs take on increasingly tricky courses, Gawain struggles with his control and strength — until he begins to see the sparks of a new power.

Episodes.Title: The Brits Go Into Overdrive
Episodes.Description: Quester begins to lose confidence after witnessing Gawain's incredible growth. After coasting in the first half, Sfida and Ice turn the heat up.

Episodes.Title: The Way to Victory
Episodes.Description: Faced with the final two holes, the U.K. and U.S. teams go all out. Will Gawain and Lancelot be able to clinch victory for the Japan team?

Episodes.Title: The Dark Nobleman
Episodes.Description: While Liebel and Todoin brood over their poor performance against Tristan, the other players gear up for the Camelot Cup's main event: individual matches.

Episodes.Title: Monsters
Episodes.Description: The Brits display their monstrous talent: Percival's impressive backswing and Tristan's incredible power and precision fire up Gawain and Lancelot.

Episodes.Title: An Approaching Destiny
Episodes.Description: As the competition grows more heated and the young golfers battle it out on the fairways, Gawain's Gift attracts a mysterious man's attention.

Episodes.Title: Heart of Glass
Episodes.Description: Wanglian's mastery over turbulent winds stuns everyone. Meanwhile, Lancelot's confidence starts to shatter as he loses control of his strokes.

Episodes.Title: Awaken!
Episodes.Description: Gawain enters an injury-induced trance after being hit by Percival's ball, and a profound power emerges from him. Lancelot continues to falter.

Episodes.Title: A Contest of Gift
Episodes.Description: Thanks to Gawain's words, Lancelot gets back his confidence — and his Gift. Gawain's uncanny performance continues and catches Tristan's attention.

Episodes.Title: To the Top
Episodes.Description: Finding himself shaken by Lancelot and Gawain's skills, Tristan reevaluates his motivations. Gawain refuses to back down despite his worsening injury.

Episodes.Title: See You Again!
Episodes.Description: The Camelot Cup draws to a close, and the young golfers reflect on their results. At the hospital, Gawain gets an intriguing invite from Arthur.

Entries.Title: Makeine: Too Many Losing Heroines!
Entries.Description: Meet the girls on the losing side of romance! First is Anna Yanami, the girl-next-door type who can’t say no to delicious food. Then there’s Lemon Yakishio, a beautiful and spirited athlete. Last but not least is Chika Komari, the cute yet shy heroine with gentle charm. Together, they navigate awkward setbacks hoping to finally find love!

Episodes.Title: Professional Childhood Friend Yanami Anna's Style of Losing
Episodes.Description: Nukumizu Kazuhiko, a loner with a love for light novels, accidentally sees popular Yanami Anna being rejected by her childhood friend. This leads to unexpected interactions with other seemingly defeated girls like Yakishio Lemon from the track team and Komari Chika from the literature club.

Episodes.Title: The Promised Failure for You
Episodes.Description: Lemon goes to the gym storage room to talk to Nukumizu. They get locked in but are rescued just before they pass out from the heat. Lemon's crush Mitsuki shows up at the nurse's office with a get well gift. Later, the two visit the lit club together...

Episodes.Title: Losing the Battle Before It Is Ever Fought
Episodes.Description: Lemon and Yanami join the literature club. Pressured by the student council to demonstrate their club activities, Tamaki and Koto decide that everyone should write and submit web novels. The members head to the beach together for a weekend training camp.

Episodes.Title: When You Stare Into a Losing Heroine, the Losing Heroine Stares Back Into You
Episodes.Description: Komari confesses to Tamaki and then runs away. Tensions between Tamaki and Koto also flare up. Koto packs her things and leaves the campground.

Episodes.Title: Asagumo Chihaya Is Led Astray
Episodes.Description: Nukumizu endures a chaotic few days of being constantly distracted by his sister Kaju and Yanami. One afternoon, Yanami invites Nukumizu to a café and the two spot Lemon and Ayano hanging out together.

Episodes.Title: Let Any One of You Who Has Never Been Dumped Be the First to Throw a Stone at the Losing Heroine
Episodes.Description: Nukumizu gets grilled by Ayano after being caught together with Chihaya. Nukumizu clears things up, but then for whatever reason Nukumizu, Ayano, Chihaya, Lemon, and Yanami end up hanging out together.

Episodes.Title: The Other Side of a Happy Ending
Episodes.Description: Lemon opens up to Nukumizu about her complex feelings for Ayano. She decides to clear things up with Ayano and Chihaya. She asks Nukumizu to escort her to her former elementary school at night to secretly meet Ayano and finally tell him the honest truth.

Episodes.Title: If You Are in Trouble, Feel Free to Consult
Episodes.Description: Nukumizu, Yanami, and Komari go to town to research a theme for their Tsuwabuki Festival exhibit. They successfully find a new club advisor and preparations seem to be going smoothly...

Episodes.Title: Consider Your Teacher a Stain on the Ceiling or Something, and Please Continue
Episodes.Description: Having settled on "Edible Readings" for the literature club exhibit, Nukumizu and Komari continue preparing for the Tsuwabuki Festival. When the two stop by the local library to return some reference books, they notice Tamaki and Koto on a date together.

Episodes.Title: I Suppose It's a Bit Too Early for Goodbye
Episodes.Description: Nukumizu and friends manage to complete the literature club exhibit in time. Once the festival begins, the exhibit draws a constant stream of visitors. Yanami steps in to give Nukumizu and Komari a break to go explore the other events on campus together.

Episodes.Title: Let's Have a Talk About Responsibility
Episodes.Description: Komari practices her presentation for the club presidents' meeting, but still has trouble talking due to her intense fear of public speaking. Nukumizu tries to throw her a lifeline, but it turns into an argument and she runs away from him in frustration.

Episodes.Title: Am I Actually Just Some Unseasoned Rando Who Drops In for the Last Episode with the Losing Heroine?
Episodes.Description: Yanami asks Nukumizu to arrange an adult date. As Yanami's old friends are gradually realizing that she doesn't actually have a steady boyfriend, she wants to maintain her charade with a fake date.

Entries.Title: The Tiger and Her Wings
Entries.Description: In the early Showa era, Japan’s first women’s law school opens, and the protagonist, Inotsume Tomoko (Ito Sairi), gains nationwide attention as one of the first female lawyers in the country. However, after facing wartime Japan’s harsh realities and losing everything, she becomes a judge with her legal knowledge and dedicates herself to establishing the family court. She stands passionately for the hardships that politics and economics cannot solve.

Entries.Title: Blue Box
Entries.Description: Taiki Inomata loves badminton, but he has a long way to go before he can reach nationals. When Taiki sees upperclassman Chinatsu Kano practicing her heart out on the girls’ basketball team, he falls for her hard. After an unexpected turn of events brings the two closer together, sports might not be the first thing on their minds anymore!

Episodes.Title: Chinatsu Senpai
Episodes.Description: Despite a few heart-fluttering encounters, Taiki doubts his crush Chinatsu even knows his name. Later, shocking news forces him to make a bold move.

Episodes.Title: You Have to Go to Nationals
Episodes.Description: Taiki's new housemate quickly makes herself at home. As they grow closer, his attempts to keep the situation a secret cause a misunderstanding.

Episodes.Title: Chii
Episodes.Description: Taiki overhears Haryu calling Chinatsu by a special nickname and gets flustered. Will it affect his upcoming match against the upperclassman?

Episodes.Title: If He Wins
Episodes.Description: A gym uniform mix-up leads to a heart-pounding exchange. Later, Haryu raises the stakes for Taiki’s match, while Kyo makes a secret request to Chinatsu.

Episodes.Title: Aquarium
Episodes.Description: With both players going neck and neck on the court, will Taiki win his match against Kishi — and will Chinatsu invite him to the aquarium?

Episodes.Title: Wish Me Luck
Episodes.Description: On her way to return Chinatsu's mobile phone, Hina makes a shocking discovery. The gymnast faces mounting pressure while struggling with her new feelings.

Episodes.Title: Can I Have One?
Episodes.Description: Chinatsu overhears rival players speak poorly about her recent game. Later, Hina playfully steals a bite from Taiki — and Chinatsu notices from afar.

Episodes.Title: Score!
Episodes.Description: As Taiki strives to make it to the nationals, Chinatsu gives him a word of encouragement. Later, Haryu and Taiki face top players in the doubles match.

Episodes.Title: I'll Be Rooting for You
Episodes.Description: Frustrated with his loss to Sajikawa High, Taiki overworks himself studying for midterms and falls ill, when Chinatsu suddenly appears in his room.

Episodes.Title: It's Not a Good Thing
Episodes.Description: After a sleepless night, Taiki asks Haryu for relationship advice. Later, Chinatsu realizes her recent behavior might hinder her dream and trouble others.

Episodes.Title: Uncool!
Episodes.Description: With the annual fireworks festival approaching, Hina musters the courage to invite Taiki, who's been avoiding Chinatsu since their awkward conversation.

Episodes.Title: Girls...
Episodes.Description: Taiki attends the fireworks festival with Hina and is surprised by her new look and shyness. Later, he unexpectedly bumps into Chinatsu with a lost child.

Episodes.Title: I Want a Back-and-Forth Rally
Episodes.Description: Taiki worries about a potential misunderstanding after Chinatsu departs. At the badminton nationals, he learns more about Karen and Haryu's relationship.

Episodes.Title: What's the Connection?
Episodes.Description: While Chinatsu faces immense pressure at the nationals, Hina cheers up a worried Taiki with a game where the loser shares an embarrassing secret.

Episodes.Title: August 26
Episodes.Description: Despite it being her birthday, Chinatsu still seems a little down. Taiki takes her somewhere special — but the weather might have other plans.

Episodes.Title: Unfair Woman
Episodes.Description: As a new school term begins, the school buzzes with preparations for the upcoming festival. Chinatsu reflects on her restless feelings towards Taiki.

Episodes.Title: Of Course I Want to See It
Episodes.Description: Upon learning of an upcoming practice match with Sajikawa High, Taiki worries about facing Yusa gain. Chinatsu and Hina promise their support.

Episodes.Title: I Know
Episodes.Description: Sajikawa High arrives for the much-anticipated practice match. As Chinatsu watches from the sidelines, she thinks about how far Taiki has come.

Episodes.Title: I've Got Plans
Episodes.Description: Just before the school festival starts, Taiki goes for his usual morning jog and finds Chinatsu practicing nearby. She extends a surprising invitation.

Episodes.Title: As One of Her Closest Friends
Episodes.Description: After a blissful time with Chinatsu, Nishida's ominous fortune comes true! His classmate playing the prince can't perform, so Taiki must take on the role.

Episodes.Title: A Chance to Blossom
Episodes.Description: While rumors swirl around Taiki and Hina, Chinatsu seems unfazed. However, while spending the night at Karen's, the basketballer shares her true thoughts.

Episodes.Title: Inota!
Episodes.Description: After learning about Hina's unrequited feelings for Taiki, Ayame decides to help — and the perfect chance arises at the upcoming autumn training camp!

Episodes.Title: Spinning
Episodes.Description: An exciting card game with friends leaves Taiki's head spinning. He mulls over his feelings for Chinatsu and Hina as the training camp continues.

Episodes.Title: A Roller Coaster
Episodes.Description: Hina experiences a roller coaster of emotions over her affection for Taiki and, thanks to Ayame, gets a chance to be alone with him on the last night.

Episodes.Title: Even So
Episodes.Description: Ayame faces the consequences of her meddling and tries all sorts of ways to console Hina. Meanwhile, Taiki strengthens his resolve and asks Chinatsu out.

Entries.Title: Chaser Game W: My Evil Boss is My Ex-Girlfriend
Entries.Description: The story of a game development company employee and her boss, who happens to be her ex-girlfriend.

Episodes.Title: The Beginning of Revenge
Episodes.Description: The team goes out for drinks to celebrate Itsuki's birthday and Fuyu's arrival, but an unexpected incident occurs between the two.

Episodes.Title: Betrayal and Obsession
Episodes.Description: In order to complete Fuyu's requests, Itsuki asks Wataru for help in following leads.

Episodes.Title: Unable to Erase Regrets
Episodes.Description: Fuyu struggles to deal with work and her family responsibilities, while Wataru coincidentally sees Fuyu leaving her house with her daughter.

Episodes.Title: Intersecting Body Temperatures
Episodes.Description: After Fuyu's husband leaves, Itsuki plays the role of housewife and takes care of both Fuyu and her daughter.

Episodes.Title: The Devil Is Coming.
Episodes.Description: Fuyu and her boss Ro Asami run into conflict, which puts Fuyu in a difficult position; Itsuki lends a helping hand as a result.

Episodes.Title: Chain of Mistakes
Episodes.Description: A shocking report suddenly appears out of the blue, which leads to suspicions about who the mole in the company is.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Itsuki confronts Wataru which leads to a shocking revelation; Fuyu reveals her true feelings after getting confronted by her husband.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Faced with threats from Ro in the workplace and her husband's staunch attitude at home, what kind of decisions will Fuyu finally make?

Entries.Title: Until I Destroy My Husband's Family
Entries.Description: Kisaragi Minori, who thought she had a happy family with her pure love since they were students and was married to her husband Yudai, was blessed with children, but the story begins when she finds out that her husband Yudai has been cheating on her for 15 years. Minori, who has vowed to take revenge on Yudai, who has another family, and on his lover, Riko Miyake, plots her revenge using Riko's son, Wataru.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: "My husband has another family!?" Kisaragi Minori (Matsumoto Marika) and Kisaragi Yudai (Takezai Terunosuke) got married out of pure love. They are blessed with children and should be a happy family to anyone who sees them. Feeling something is off about Yudai’s recent behavior, Minori follows him. What catches her eye is the sight of Yudai walking happily with his lover Miyake Riko (Nonami Maho) and her son Miyake Wataru (Nomura Kota). Divorce alone is not enough. The thrilling revenge of a cheated wife begins now!

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Minori (Matsumoto Marika) begins working at the cram school attended by Miyake Wataru (Nomura Kota), the son of her affair partner. While concealing her true identity, she closes the gap in order to investigate Wataru's father. Is Wataru's father her husband, Yudai (Takezai Terunosuke)? Wataru slowly opens up to Minori, who kindly gives him advice, and tells him stories of his childhood. As his suspicions deepen, he receives news that his mother, Riko (Nonami Maho), has collapsed. Minori secretly follows Wataru as he heads to the hospital. Yudai arrives late to join Riko and Wataru in their hospital room.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Riko (Nonami Maho), the woman her husband had an affair with, was pregnant with Yudai's (Takezai Terunosuke) child. Wataru (Nomura Kota), who knows nothing about it, tells Minori (Matsumoto Marika) about his mother, Riko. Living with Yudai, who keeps telling her lies, slowly eats away at Minori, but as she consults with her best friend Sara (Ota Rina), the flames of revenge begin to quietly burn. Minori heads to the beauty salon run by Riko. The betrayed wife and her lover finally come face to face. An explosive conversation unfolds...!

Entries.Title: Girls Band Cry
Entries.Description: Nina Iseri drops out of high school and moves to Tokyo by herself. In front of the station in the suburbs of Tokyo, Nina sees Momo Kawaragi singing alone and is touched by the power of music. Nina decides to form a band with Momo, Subaru Awasu, a girl who hides her true feelings, Tomo Ebutsuka, who was abandoned by her parents, and Rupa, a lonely girl without any family...

Episodes.Title: Tokyo Heave-Ho
Episodes.Description: In March, at the age of 17, Nina drops out of high school and moves to Tokyo on her own. She's completely lost in the big city. She was encouraged to come here after hearing a certain song she found online. The day she arrives, Nina meets the street musician who plays that song.

Episodes.Title: Three Nocturnal Creatures
Episodes.Description: Nina starts to cram for school. She promised her parents she would try to get into college. However, she's having a hard time adjusting to her new cram school life, finding it difficult to get into her studies. As she's struggling, she receives a text from Momoka. When Nina visits Momoka's house, she is introduced to a girl her age.

Episodes.Title: Misaligned Questions and Answers
Episodes.Description: As always, Nina's having a hard time focusing on her studies, but she finds herself having to go to Subaru's school to deliver Subaru's phone. After having a heart to heart, they start opening up to each other. Soon after, the trio set out to put on their first live show as a band.

Episodes.Title: Appreciation (Surprise)
Episodes.Description: Subaru's grandmother drops by Tokyo out of the blue. Subaru doesn't want to pursue acting. She wants to be in a band and play music. Now that she's come this far, she needs to say it clearly. But when the moment comes, she finds herself putting on a fake smile and playing the good granddaughter.

Episodes.Title: Rising Vocals
Episodes.Description: A live house that Momoka used to play at asked the girls if they wanted to play a show, and they agree to have their first battle of the bands. As they struggle to meet the ticket sale quota, Momoka gets tickets to a show for her former band.

Episodes.Title: Hymn of the Stray
Episodes.Description: The three girls practice to level up as a band. Nina is obsessed with beating Diamond Dust, and researches ways to increase their popularity, but she fails to find anything good. That's when Tomo and Rupa approach Nina after having been to see the three girls perform the other day.

Episodes.Title: I'll Give It a Name
Episodes.Description: Tomo and Rupa join Nina, Subaru, and Momoka, making a five-member band. Momoka informs the rest of an upcoming show they could play, but the five members have such different personalities that it doesn't look like they'd ever come together. Nina and Momoka have different feelings about the band, and they begin the show while their relationship remains strained.

Episodes.Title: If You Were to Cry
Episodes.Description: After the live show, Nina and Momoka's fight continues to heat up as they express how they feel. Nina abandons all her escape routes to seriously pursue music professionally. Tomo says she'll quit if Nina and Momoka's rocky relationship continues. Then as Nina starts her first day of her part-time job, Momoka shows up.

Episodes.Title: The Waning Moon Was Out
Episodes.Description: Tomo is scared to say how she feels due to traumatizing past experiences and is unable to truthfully express herself to the other band members. Nina is currently learning the guitar and asks Tomo for her assessment, and Tomo gives her harsh feedback. However, when Tomo sees that Nina isn't giving up, it gives her the confidence to change.

Episodes.Title: Wandervogel
Episodes.Description: Nina's parents come to visit her from her hometown as she continues to dedicate herself to the band. Nina runs away, but she reluctantly returns to her home after everyone convinces her. She tries to talk to her father, but as always, he doesn't see things from her perspective. The next day, her father takes her to her old high school.

Episodes.Title: The Center of the World
Episodes.Description: Nina and the others arrive at an outdoor music festival. It's a huge venue, and the large stage gets them pumped. Diamond Dust takes the stage and they've gotten better since their last show. Nina and the band absolutely cannot lose. They're going to leave their mark. It's the start of their performance of a lifetime.

Episodes.Title: The Sky Darkens Again
Episodes.Description: Nina and the others officially sign with a talent agency. The five of them start writing their new song when Diamond Dust challenges them to a battle of the bands. Diamond Dust has doubled their follower count from before. Should they accept the challenge or not? The members find themselves split on this decision.

Episodes.Title: Rock 'n' Roll Will Never Stop
Episodes.Description: In the battle of the bands against Diamond Dust, Nina's band's ticket sales have not even reached half of their sales projection. Meanwhile, Diamond Dust sold out their tickets. The harsh reality comes crashing down. Even then, Nina and the band stay true themselves and begin to play their song.

Entries.Title: Spice and Wolf: MERCHANT MEETS THE WISE WOLF
Entries.Description: Lawrence is a traveling merchant selling various goods from a horse-drawn cart. One day, he arrives at a village and meets a beautiful girl with the ears and tail of an animal! Her name is Holo the Wisewolf and she brings bountiful harvests. She wishes to return to her homeland, and Lawrence offers to take her. Now, the once-lonely merchant and the once-lonely wisewolf begin their journey north.

Episodes.Title: The Harvest Festival and the Crowded Driver's Box
Episodes.Description: An old tale from long ago, that began in a village far, far away. There, a wolf brought bountiful harvests of wheat for an exceedingly long time, until memories of the wolf became antiquated stories. What then, was left for the wolf to do?

Episodes.Title: Mischievous Wolf and No Laughing Matter
Episodes.Description: Lawrence and Holo stay overnight in the town where they sell the furs. As Lawrence learns more about Holo, Holo learns about the current state of the Church and shares her own wisdom.

Episodes.Title: Port Town and Sweet Temptation
Episodes.Description: After arriving in the great merchant city of Pazzio, Lawrence teaches Holo more about the many kinds of currency in use. Then the Wise Wolf earns her keep - and her title - by demonstrating her bargaining skills.

Episodes.Title: Romantic Merchant and Moonlit Farewell
Episodes.Description: Lawrence has figured out the truth behind the silver scheme, and how to profit from it, but in doing so he has made some dangerous enemies.  Meanwhile, Holo and Lawrence discuss his grand plans for the future.

Episodes.Title: Wolf Incarnate and Obedient Lamb
Episodes.Description: Lawrence reveals Holo's secret to the manager of Milone Trading Company to gain their help in securing Holo's escape. For merchants, money comes first, so why has Medio Trading captured Holo at all? Lawrence must outthink politics to save Holo.

Episodes.Title: Merchant and Unreasonable God
Episodes.Description: Holo and Lawrence are trapped in the tunnels below the city, with hunters searching for them in all directions.  When danger comes, how far will they go to protect each other?

Episodes.Title: Scale of God and Sorcerer of the Grasslands
Episodes.Description: Lawrence and Holo continue on to the next city to sell the pepper and pick up their next goods on the long journey north. Holo puts her nose to good use, once again.

Episodes.Title: Fellow Traveler and Foreboding News
Episodes.Description: Our travelers encounter a shepherd along the road.  Can the Wise Wolf hold back against an enemy of wolves long enough for Lawrence to build more contacts?

Episodes.Title: Sweet Honey and Bitter Armor
Episodes.Description: Lawrence is ready to sell the armor for a great profit and Holo wants her peaches. But when things don't go to plan, will either get what they want?

Episodes.Title: Wisdom of a Wolf and Smooth Talk of a Merchant
Episodes.Description: Desperate for money, the wise Wolf proposes a dangerous new plan. But even more dangerous are Holo's emotions, when Lawrence is being rather dense...

Episodes.Title: Forest of Wolves and Frigid Rain
Episodes.Description: Nora leads the way into the dangerous woods, and so their risky plan commences. What dangers truly lurk in the woods? Are a brave shepherd and a Wise Wolf strong enough to overcome what lies ahead?

Episodes.Title: Price of Betrayal and Price of Gold
Episodes.Description: Betrayed and left for dead, Lawrence waits for Holo's return. Holo is no weak wolf to run off with her tail between her legs, and Lawrence the merchant won't lose his profit either. But will a wolf be willing to save a shepherd?

Episodes.Title: Supper of Three and Afternoon of Two
Episodes.Description: Holo, Lawrence, and Nora sit down for a much deserved meal, but Holo's not her usual self. Holo remembers the past and contemplates the future...

Episodes.Title: New Town and Nostalgic Feeling
Episodes.Description: Lawrence and Holo continue their long journey north, reaching the town of Kumerson, where they see the first northern pagans of their journey.

Episodes.Title: Bird Feather and Mysterious Ore
Episodes.Description: With no real information on how to get to Yoitsu, Lawrence uses all his resources to find more information. Will pagan stories of the North yield any clues?

Episodes.Title: Night of the Festival and Misaligned Gear
Episodes.Description: Amati learns about Holo's debt to Lawrence and announces that he will take on the debt and ask Holo to marry him.

Episodes.Title: Traveling Merchant's Shallow Thinking and Town Merchant's Signboard
Episodes.Description: Lawrence tries to persuade Amati into a special deal. This could determine the outcome of their agreement...

Episodes.Title: Goods of Intent and Negotiation of Resolve
Episodes.Description: Lawrence seeks help from Mr. Batos to acquire pyrite from the alchemists. When he speaks with Diana, she makes him an offer...

Episodes.Title: God's Unseen Hand and Wolf's Unseen Heart
Episodes.Description: The price of pyrite keeps rising, but when Diana's representative appears and informs him of the failed deal, Lawrence's plan collapses. Has he lost the bet against Amati and, consequently, Holo?

Episodes.Title: Church Girl and Miller Boy
Episodes.Description: With a load of flour, Holo and Lawrence head deeper into the north, arriving at the town of Tereo, searching for an abbey with information on Holo's home.

Episodes.Title: Pagan Village and Priest's Contract
Episodes.Description: A friendly evening of drinking at the tavern reveals the true beliefs of the villagers, but how are they able to live so comfortably with the church bearing down on them? Lawrence investigates further, and Holo identifies a miracle she'd like to perform.

Episodes.Title: Church Teachings and Memories of Father
Episodes.Description: Meeting with Elsa in the church, Lawrence and Holo are able to learn the truth about Father Franz's studies as Elsa reveals a hidden secret of the church, and the true location of the Abbey.

Episodes.Title: Orchestrated Catastrophe and Appropriate Retribution
Episodes.Description: Lawrence and Holo are being used as scapegoats because a person in Enberch died from poisoned wheat from the village of Tereo. How can the two get themselves out of this trap?

Episodes.Title: Path of the Snake God and Answer of the Wise Wolf
Episodes.Description: Lawrence, Evan, and Elsa manage to escape from the village on Holo's back. As they take a rest, they observe men from Enberch heading towards Tereo...

Episodes.Title: Miracle's Path and Journey's Continuation
Episodes.Description: Elsa's plan succeeds. After Bishop Mendez and the men from Enberch witness the miracle, they leave the village of Tereo alone. Shortly thereafter, Lawrence and Holo plan to continue their journey...

Entries.Title: I Will Rob Your Lover
Entries.Description: Minami Hinako is the company president of Office CAT, a mysterious detective agency that accepts requests from women who wish to have help with their relationship issues. The company’s objective is not just to facilitate a breakup for the client, but to “abduct” the targeted individual. Otherwise known as “Thief Cat” Minami Hinako has a 100% robbery success rate. She skilfully manipulates her appearance and personality to make the target fall for her, thus tearing apart relationships between men and women. One day, the company receives a request from a woman named Hayakawa Risa, asking for help in stealing away her abusive boyfriend.

Entries.Title: Unnamed Memory
Entries.Description: Climbing a deadly tower, Oscar seeks the power of its master, the Witch of the Azure Moon. He hopes her incredible magic can break a curse that will kill any woman he takes for a wife. However, when the prince sees how beautiful Tinasha is, he has a better idea—since she's surely strong enough to survive his curse, she should just marry him instead! Tinasha isn't keen on the idea but agrees to live with Oscar in the royal castle for a year while researching the spell placed on the prince. The witch's pretty face hides several lifetimes of dark secrets, however—secrets that begin resurfacing.

Episodes.Title: Cursed Words and the Azure Tower
Episodes.Description: Prince Oscar, heir to the throne of Farsas, was cursed in his childhood - a curse that prevents him from producing an heir. His last chance is the help of the Witch of the Azure Moon, but she lives in a gigantic azure tower that harbors many dangers...

Episodes.Title: The Past Recalled Once Again
Episodes.Description: Tinasha has just arrived at Farsas Castle, when she finds that she must set off for the border. There, she confronts her past memories, as well as a foe who has been biding time for seventy years.

Episodes.Title: What the Forest Dreams Of
Episodes.Description: Oscar and Lazar venture into a forest to investigate a series of mysterious deaths, out of Tinasha's watchful gaze. Unbeknownst to them, the Witch of the Forbidden Forest awaits within.

Episodes.Title: A Breath of Life into Image
Episodes.Description: A foreign envoy shows up at Farsas Castle, demanding an audience with Tinasha. As Oscar is about to send him away, the mysterious envoy utters a name that changes his mind.

Episodes.Title: Unnamed Emotion
Episodes.Description: The king reveals a new potential bride for Oscar: Miralys, a palace maid. A disgruntled Oscar notices that Tinasha has taken this opportunity to keep her distance from him.

Episodes.Title: As the Abyss is Born
Episodes.Description: Tinasha finally succeeds in breaking the curse, thus fulfilling her contract with Oscar. In the middle of the king's birthday celebration, she comes to Oscar with a shocking revelation.

Episodes.Title: The End of the Dream
Episodes.Description: Tinasha leaves Farsas to defect to Cuscull at Lanak's side. Something about her actions, however, don't quite add up, which does not escape the notice of Cuscull's chief mage.

Episodes.Title: Green Vines
Episodes.Description: During a visit to a fortress on the border of Farsas, Oscar runs into a band of marauding nomads. Their leader challenges Oscar to a duel, on sacred grounds that hide a dark secret.

Episodes.Title: The Things Unknown
Episodes.Description: The kingdom of Farsas enjoys some much-needed peace as the end of the year approaches. Beneath the tranquility, however, a plot is brewing with Farsas Castle as its target.

Episodes.Title: Blank Slate Children
Episodes.Description: Tinasha finds out that her tower has some unexpected visitors. Oscar reluctantly prepares to attend a public function in the neighboring nation of Gandona.

Episodes.Title: Castle of Sand
Episodes.Description: Oscar and Tinasha venture out to Yarda to find its missing princess, and to put an end to the escalating civil conflict orchestrated by the Witch Who Cannot Be Summoned.

Episodes.Title: Two Joined Memories
Episodes.Description: One day, as Oscar is helping Tinasha clean up around the tower, he finds himself mysteriously drawn in by a familiar-looking orb.

Episodes.Title: From a Blank Page Anew
Episodes.Description: Prince Oscar, heir to the throne of Farsas, was cursed in his childhood - a curse that prevents him from producing an heir. He travels to Tuldarr, a nation of mages, to seek help from their king.

Episodes.Title: Emerging from a Glass Cocoon
Episodes.Description: A band of thieves kidnaps Tinasha while Oscar is away. Now, he must negotiate for her safe return, but they demand that Oscar relinquish a Farsas royal treasure: his trusty sword, Akashia.

Episodes.Title: Unanswered Prayer
Episodes.Description: Tinasha and Prince Legis of Tuldarr are met with assassination attempts. A mysterious woman visits Farsas Castle and offers to bear Oscar's child.

Episodes.Title: Unseen Visage
Episodes.Description: Oscar agrees to let Princess Nephelli of Yarda take refuge from strife in her homeland. However, they find an assassin has followed her into Farsas.

Episodes.Title: Returning the Promise
Episodes.Description: Tinasha takes the throne once more as Tuldarr's queen. Oscar makes up his mind after Tinasha shocks all present at the coronation ceremony.

Episodes.Title: Bloodless Scars
Episodes.Description: Tinasha visits a school in Tuldarr when disaster strikes. The nation of Cezar launches an invasion on Farsas.

Episodes.Title: Joyful Sorrow
Episodes.Description: Oscar receives an unexpected guest, whose voice he recognizes. The secret of the witch's curse comes to light.

Episodes.Title: Half of Eternity
Episodes.Description: Tinasha helps Travis deal with a pesky demon. Oscar finds a baby in the palace that is supposedly his child.

Episodes.Title: Pride of the Past
Episodes.Description: Tinasha travels to Magdalsia to diagnose a magical malady, but comes across an enigmatic intruder instead.

Episodes.Title: Once upon a Time with You
Episodes.Description: Valt, the newly-appointed chief mage of Farsas, investigates a series of mysterious deaths and suicides.

Episodes.Title: At Memory's End
Episodes.Description: Magdalsia's aggression forces Tuldarr into war, but Oscar learns the shocking truth behind the instigator.

Episodes.Title: Death of the Nameless Nation
Episodes.Description: With Tuldarr in grave danger, Tinasha must decide whether to do as Valt demands and destroy Eleterria.

Entries.Title: The Witch and the Beast
