She is shocked to realize that her fate wasn't passed on to Su-min. Meanwhile, Su-min and Min-hwan, spending their newlywed days discontentedly, acquire information about Ji-hyuk that enrages them.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: After an accident that was intended to harm Ji-won, Ji-hyuk gets injured instead and falls into a coma. Ji-won is scared that Ji-hyuk may never wake up. With everyone involved in the accident busy covering their tracks, Ji-won learns the truth behind the accident and seeks out Su-min to confront her memories from a distant past.

Episodes.Title: Episode 14
Episodes.Description: Ji-hyuk regains consciousness and quietly trails the person involved in the accident that Yu-ra is trying to conceal. Meanwhile, Ji-won realizes that, in order to pass on her fate to Su-min, she must get Min-hwan to have an affair. Ji-won decides to become Min-hwan's secret lover, pretends to break up with Ji-hyuk, and approaches Min-hwan once more.

Episodes.Title: Episode 15
Episodes.Description: Su-min meets Yu-ra and presents compelling evidence, prompting Yu-ra to start finding a way to resolve the situation once and for all. Ji-won and Ji-hyuk initiate their final operations toward Min-hwan and Su-min, finally bringing about the night of destiny!

Episodes.Title: Episode 16
Episodes.Description: With Su-min's disappearance after Min-hwan's death, the fate intertwined with Ji-won finally dissolves. Ji-won receives a formal invitation to Chairman Yu Han-il's home and starts planning her future with Ji-hyuk. Just as they are about to attain their happiness, Su-min reappears to conclude the long-forged tragic fate.

Entries.Title: Perfect 10 Liners
Entries.Description: Engineering students navigate chaos as Arm manages the Engineer Cute Boy page, causing chaos by posting Arc's photo, while Gun and Yotha bond as roommates, and Faifa steps in to Support Wine.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: As Arm enters university, he is introduced to his peer mentor group, the Perfect 10 Liners.  He unintentionally gets off on the wrong foot with his senior, Arc, after posting his photo on the Engineer Cute Boy page.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Arc makes an attempt to spend more time with Arm, but his teasing attitude leaves Arm unsure of his intentions.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Arc shows a different side of himself after the car accident.  As Arm's pinning ceremony approaches, Arc encourages Arm to make more of an effort to get to know him more.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Arc and Arm take turns caring for each other as Arc gets injured playing soccer and Arm finds himself in the middle of a bar fight.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Arc and Arm take a trip together to get his bracelet from one of the founding member of his mentorship group.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Arc confesses his feelings but Arm asks for more time to reflect on how he feels.  However, Arm starts to feel possessive when Arc's buddy Brink makes an appearance.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Arc finds himself competing with Arm's new "buddy", Tongfah, who appears to be endlessly charming and talented.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Arc and Arm say goodbye to their buddies.  Arc gifts Arm his engineering jacket, but Arm loses it after wearing it for just one day.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: As the new school year starts, the Perfect 10 Liners meet their newest mentee, Yotha. Yotha's brother Faifa makes fast friends with fellow freshmen, Gun.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Gun and Yotha become roommates after Gun's sleeping habits make his previous roommate totally sleep deprived.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: Gun learns the reason Yotha spends many late nights at the bar as the two get to know each other more

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Yotha and Gun select their buddies from among their peers. Gun's friends begin to question the relationship between him and Yotha.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: Even though Yotha and Gun have gotten closer, there are still parts of Yotha that Gun doesn't truly know or understand. After witnessing a fight Yotha is in and an earlier incident between Wa and Yotha, Gun chooses chooses to move in with Fai.

Episodes.Title: Episode 14
Episodes.Description: Yotha and Gun return from their trip after receiving Yotha's bracelet from Tawan.  Yotha asks Gun for more time to determine his feelings.

Episodes.Title: Episode 15
Episodes.Description: Gun and Yotha learn to face their fears together.

Episodes.Title: Episode 16
Episodes.Description: Yotha and Gun announce their relationship to their friends. Yotha has an opportunity to reconnect with his mother.

Episodes.Title: Episode 17
Episodes.Description: The Perfect 10 gang welcome their newest member, Wine.  But with Yotha distracted from his mentorship duties, Faifa steps in and begins to get to know Wine better.

Episodes.Title: Episode 18
Episodes.Description: Wine has been wrestling with a secret and the heartache following his breakup with Toey. However, after a night out with the Perfect 10 gang, emotions and the secret Wine has been holding in begins to overflow.

Episodes.Title: Episode 19
Episodes.Description: Wine is relieved when he learns that Toey still wants to be friends after their breakup, but Faifa seems concerned when he learns that Wine's crush Tor is also interested in men.

Episodes.Title: Episode 20
Episodes.Description: Wine and Fai have been spending time together, with Fai "teaching" Wine about love and checking items off in their notebook. This was meant for Wine to use to gain P'Tor's affection. But, little by little, Fai start to understand what "special" means, and that for him, it might be Wine. Arc, Arm, Yotha and Gun are worried about Fai. They know about his inability to say no, his kindness and the way he treats everyone the same. They don't know if Fai really knows how to love.

Episodes.Title: Episode 21
Episodes.Description: Wine tries to figure out if he truly is special in Faifah's eyes. Jay and Ben have noticed that Wine is happier with Faifah's presence in Wine's life and that Faifah goes out of his way to spend time with Wine. Finally, Wine admits to them that he has feelings for Faifah and that they've kissed. Yotha, Gun, Arc and Arm are not confident that Faifah will not mess this up, so they try and figure out how they can help his budding relationship along.

Episodes.Title: Episode 22
Episodes.Description: Tor and Wine are reunited at the festival event on campus, but Wine's feelings have shifted since they last met.

Episodes.Title: Episode 23
Episodes.Description: Wine and Faifa are officially dating.

Episodes.Title: Episode 24
Episodes.Description: The Perfect 10 Liners gang goes on a camping trip as a friend prepares for a special proposal.

Entries.Title: Kiseki Miracle Season
Entries.Description: When four boys meet on a Tokyo trip, their lives quietly intertwine—leading to love, growth, and a winter that might bring them back together.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: After much begging from Beboy, P finally agrees to let the twins Pan and Plai stay in his house.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: The gang spend the night drinking together, with Pan and Plai playing songs they had written.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: The four of them get closer as they play a card game, and the connections between them become stronger.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: In order to deepen their cultural understanding, P takes the group to see the Tokyo Tower and to experience an onsen.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: As the Tokyo trip comes to an end, everyone feels reluctant to leave, while Beboy seems to have something he wants to say to Plai.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Before heading off to the airport, P takes the boys on another tour of the city, taking the chance to share what they've been thinking about.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: P reunites with Pan in Japan—but one touch from a stranger sparks a storm of jealousy.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: P hides his jealousy as Pan grows close to a young artist—until one quiet moment shifts everything.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: After a romantic day, P kisses Pan—unaware their moment is secretly caught on camera.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Leaked photos and misunderstandings drive Pan away—leaving P to search and make things right.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: P and Pan reconcile on the beach—and in one room, share a question about their future.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Pan wakes in P’s arms, but doubts linger as P’s love remains unspoken—and challenged.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: P confesses at the mirror pond—and Pan says yes. A birthday surprise changes everything.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Love is sealed in laughter and Thai costumes—P and Pan declare every season theirs.

Entries.Title: The Heart Killers
Entries.Description: A mission to expose two assassin brothers spirals when Kant’s feelings for one of them threaten to blow his cover—and maybe more.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Captain Christ gives Kant his order to observe and collect intel on two hitman brothers, Bison and Fadel.  While Kant finds an inroad through Bison, Fadel proves more difficult.  Kant enlists the help of his best friend, Style, to try to win over Fadel's heart.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: In an effort to get closer, Style begins following Fadel everywhere he goes. While Fadel maintains his tough exterior, Style has something of a breakthrough at the gym.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Lilly provides Fadel and Bison with their next target, but Bison's commitment to his hitman career is wavering.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Kant and Style both make major progress on their goal to start dating Fadel and Bison. Style learns he might be getting more than he bargained for.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Kant and Style find themselves actually falling for their hitman boyfriends. The two couples come together for a double date where Kant plans to take the next step in his investigative mission.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Fadel and Bison make their move against Ruerat, but when the police are already on the scene their suspicions are raised about a snitch.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Fadel and Bison plan their revenge on Style and Kant for their deception.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Bison is furious with Kant for lying to him; Style and Fadel meet a gay couple in the countryside.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Fadel and Style reunite with Kant and Bison at Bison's childhood home, but not before an unknown shooter makes an attempt on their lives.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Fadel and Bison finally confront Ruerat, but what they learn in their encounter ensures their work isn't over yet.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: Fadel and Bison question Lilly face-to-face at gunpoint; Kant chooses to negotiate a deal with the captain for the sake of Fadel and Bison.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Fadel and Bison must serve their five years in prison following their arrest, however, Kant and Style find ways for them to stay connected.

Entries.Title: Jack & Joker: U Steal My Heart!
Entries.Description: Jack wants to build something good. Joker’s just trying to fake it till he makes it. Together, they dive headfirst into the perfect crime.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Jack and Joker meet at a bar, both feeling disappointed in their lives. Jack just fell short of making the national taekwondo team. Joker is wrestling with a lie he told his parents about passing the medical school exam.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Joker spends five years in jail thinking of ways to make amends with Jack. While Jack seems unwilling to reconcile, Joker meets Hoy and Tattoo, two debtors who have a plan to get Jack out of Boss's clutches.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: With Tattoo and Hoy by his side, Joke plans a heist at a high end fashion show.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Joke builds a relationship with Jack's grandmother in his effort to apologize for his past wrongs.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Jack, Joke, and Aran find a cause they can align in: to steal Aran's mother's necklace so that it doesn't fall into the hands of a woman he hates.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Joke helps Jack take a step forward in achieving his dream of opening a school.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: With Jack's grandma's health in critical condition, Boss makes Jack an offer he can't refuse.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Jack gets involved in a dangerous game as he tries to help Rose out of her engagement. Joke approaches his father for help.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Joke organizes another heist, this time to steal a valuable ring from Rosé's house. Rosé offers Jack an opportunity for wealth and power by her side.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Boss moves quickly with his newly acquired power.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: Jack and Save return to play the Four Horsemen's game in their attempt to fight back against Alice.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Jack plays a dangerous game of Hangman against Boss Alice in an attempt to rescue Joke, Rosé, and Save.

Entries.Title: Dhevaprom
Entries.Description: Dhevaprom is a Thai lakorn based on the novel of the same name and written by the same writers as its preceding story ... The Five Brothers series, that aired in 2013. Dhevaprom consists of Laorchan, Kwanruetai, Jaiphisut, Dujapsorn and Porncheewan.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: After an unsettling dream leads her back to Thailand, the enigmatic Laorchan applies for a job as secretary — but she has a hidden agenda.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Laorchan has a hidden agenda when she volunteers for a special project of Phuthaneth's. An ancient secret may come to light.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: A very special invitation allows Laorchan to get closer to uncovering the truth she's been seeking.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Phuthaneth finally makes a move. Meanwhile, an invisible danger targets Laorchan.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Laorchan gets closer to her ultimate target — but she becomes the subject of gossip in the process. Things with Veera get complicated.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: A relationship becomes official. As an anniversary approaches, mysterious occurrences may be an ill omen.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: The stakes couldn't be higher for Laorchan, as she attempts to execute the daring plan she devised with Sun.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Phuthaneth is upset that Laorchan manipulated him. Laorchan must take up a new demanding challenge.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Things go according to plan at first, but Laorchan's new mission proves very dangerous — and someone disappears mysteriously.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Things may finally come full circle for the necklace gems. A clue is found — could it lead the group to the mysterious site they are looking for?

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: The team runs into many obstacles and surprises as they attempt to make their way to the shrine.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Laorchan ventures into a mysterious forest filled with danger. She and Phuthaneth are brought closer together.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: Laorchan leads the team to a hidden city from which no one has ever escaped. The team confronts a mighty power that puts their lives in jeopardy.

Episodes.Title: Episode 14
Episodes.Description: Laorchan uncovers secrets about her ancestors. This information may come in handy as she faces her next challenge.

Episodes.Title: Episode 15
Episodes.Description: When the Dhevaprom family refuses to accept Laorchan, Phuthaneth demands her inclusion.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: After relocating for a new job, Chat meets an unconventional young woman whom he finds both frustrating and intriguing.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Chat's sister is the object of some secret scheming, and things get even more complicated with Chat's first surgery in his new position.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: While Kwanruetai grieves, Chat and his team help Pranporn. Chat tries to spend time with Kwanruetai — and learns more about her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Porn turns out to be the only remaining witness. Kwanruetai enters a pageant, stunning Chat when she appears onstage.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: An unexpected arrival makes things complicated at the pageant, leading Kwanruetai to seek refuge somewhere private.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Kwanruetai gets grounded. After being threatened, Phokkej obtains some welcome help. Chat shares a disquieting suspicion with his great-grandmother.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Kwanruetai finds out the cause of Mae Manee’s resentment, and later receives an extraordinary gift. Kongphop takes on a dangerous organization.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: A sick Mae Manee is rushed to the hospital. Chat and Kwanruetai grow closer — but Chat feels trapped.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Chat takes care of an ill Kwanruetai. Together, they try to find ways to take down Songpol, but are thwarted by his extensive network.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Kwanruetai experiences a great loss and a revelation. She tries to pull away from Chat, who strives to prove himself nonetheless.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: Kongphop is offered some help when he runs into serious legal trouble. Kwanruetai learns a shocking secret about her family.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Kwanruetai seeks the truth. Chat and Kongphop get more than they bargained for when they set off on a risky enterprise in the forest.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: Kwanruetai feels guilty. When she makes a decision regarding her future, Chat remains committed to her — and determined to win over her mother.

Episodes.Title: Episode 14
Episodes.Description: With Kwanruetai in Bangkok, Maratee visits her own father. Chat's perseverance finally pays off.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: In Chiang Rai, Noopook's attempt to help someone close to her backfires when she becomes the target of some serious accusations.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Ronnachak enrolls Somchit in a school. There, he encounters Noopook, who is still aching from past events.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Somchit’s behavior brings Noopook face to face with Ronnachak again. As the tension builds, Ronnachak must find a way to address the situation.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: A car accident creates great confusion. Ronnachak finds himself at the center of a matchmaking scheme.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Ronnachak tries to avoid a misunderstanding with Annie and to improve his relationship with Noopook — but the road is paved with obstacles.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Annie won't call it quits. Friends play Cupid to bring Noopook and Ronnachak together. Annie and Jack team up.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Some valuable items are stolen. Noopook is unsettled by a stream of messages. Jack and Annie scheme in the hope of hindering a relationship.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: As Noopook’s feelings for Ronnachak develop, a love triangle emerges.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Phiangkhwan and Ronnaphee return home. Annie continues to pursue Ronnachak, who decides to be straightforward about his feelings.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: A rumor upsets the relationship between Noopook and Ronnachak. Some friends step in to help Ronnachak feel better.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: Ronnachak and Noopook make up — but when other people start meddling, Noopook's feelings get hurt.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Noopook sets out on a mission to recover her mother’s brooch. Ronnachak, on a mission of his own, comes to her rescue.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: Seriously ill, Annie stays at Jack’s. Orn asks to see Wilairampha, who is the subject of Ronnaphee’s speculations.

Episodes.Title: Episode 14
Episodes.Description: Rotsukhont's violence erupts. A meeting brings Noopook closer to the truth.

Episodes.Title: Episode 15
Episodes.Description: Ronnajak seeks to find out the truth about his family, but his plan is thwarted.

Episodes.Title: Episode 16
Episodes.Description: Sia Jiew targets Noopook, prompting Ronnajak to take action.

Episodes.Title: Episode 17
Episodes.Description: Ronnajak struggles with an injury and worries about his relationship with Noopook. To help, his parents attempt to resolve an old dispute.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: At the request of her sick mother, Dujupsorn applies for a job at the Jutatheps' company, where she crosses paths with an acquaintance.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: After receiving an urgent call, Dujupsorn rushes out of the office. Taratorn and Ronnapee share some news with Asira.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Dujupsorn tries to avoid Asira after discovering some unsettling information. Her mother’s worsening illness leads her to set their plan into motion.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Asira seeks forgiveness. Dujupsorn finds herself under greater pressure from her mother, whom Asira resolves to learn more about.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: As her mother demands, Dujupsorn tries to get close to Ronnapoom. Asira makes an important discovery.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Ronnapoom takes Dujapsorn to a temple, leaving behind a doleful Asira.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Wilairampha urges Dujupsorn to move forward with her plan after learning that Dujupsorn met with Laorchan at the Jutathep residence.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Asira and Dujupsorn head to Chiangmai on business. Wilairampha returns to the Dhevaprom residence to take care of her own affairs.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Asira tries to find evidence of malfeasance among the employees in Chiangmai. Dujupsorn worries about a rumor.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Dujupsorn takes drastic measures to address the rumors. In search for the truth about her mother, she heads to the Dhevaprom residence.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: Chawit and Wilairampha meet up. Saruch invites Chalisa on a trip.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Anittha is hurt by the betrayal of someone she loves. With nefarious intentions, Sarat preys on Chalisa.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: Anittha is suspicious about Chawit. Asira and Chawit use Chalisa in the hope of dealing with Sarat once and for all.

Episodes.Title: Episode 14
Episodes.Description: Asira learns of Dujupsorn's intention to take revenge on his family, and is targeted by a vindictive Sarat.

Episodes.Title: Episode 15
Episodes.Description: Wilairampha lashes out at Asira, whom she blames for what happened to Dujupsorn. Old agreements force Orn and Wilairampha to meet again.

Entries.Title: We Are
Entries.Description: A group of university friends navigate academics, friendships, and romance as they deal with the ups and downs of campus life.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Tensions rise between Phum and Pheem after Phum accidentally causes damage to Pheem's painting, moments before he turned in his finished work.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Phum offers Peem a choice: either pay his "medical bills" or become his slave.  Tan asks Phum for his help in flirting with Phum's brother, Fang.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Phum's latest teasing unintendedly hurts Peem's feelings. Q seems to be overprotective of his mentee.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Phum is extra kind to Peem to earn his forgiveness. Tan vows to give up his playboy ways.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: The guys celebrate Loy Krathong together by attending a local festival.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: As school break approaches, the guys gather a Peem's house for a celebration where they learn that Toey secretly has feelings for Q.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: The gang hatches a plan to arouse Q's jealousy over Toey so he will finally act on his feelings.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Pun is organizing the faculty service trip and recruits the entire gang to join in.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: While on their service trip. Kluen's attachment to Peem makes Phum jealous and upset.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Q confronts Chain about his intentions with Toey.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: As Phum and Peem take the next step in their relationship, Kluen also makes his intentions known with Peem.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Phum's father returns home from traveling and immediately arguments resume between the two.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: Phum must step up his romance with Peem after his misses an important appointment with him.

Episodes.Title: Episode 14
Episodes.Description: After the art show, Peem takes the guys to stay at his parents house.

Episodes.Title: Episode 15
Episodes.Description: After returning home, Peem helps Phum to celebrate his birthday.  Phum introduces Peem to his mother.

Episodes.Title: Episode 16
Episodes.Description: The guys visit Krabi together to celebrate their upcoming graduation.

Entries.Title: Master of the House
Entries.Description: A family enters a power struggle following the death of their patriarch, who leaves behind his diamond empire — and the housekeeper he recently married.

Episodes.Title: The Last Supper
Episodes.Description: The president of Theva Gems is found dead. Shortly before his passing, a startling announcement is made during his birthday dinner.

Episodes.Title: The Offer
Episodes.Description: Kaimook has doubts about the circumstances surrounding her husband's death. Phupat makes the first move to assert his dominance at the family company.

Episodes.Title: Achilles Heel
Episodes.Description: Kita prepares to unveil her upcoming fashion collection. Later, the family gathers as their lawyer reads out Mr. Roongroj's will.

Episodes.Title: Death End
Episodes.Description: An unexpected incident leads to conflict within the family. New evidence suggests a suspect's involvement in Mr. Roongroj's death.

Episodes.Title: Retribution
Episodes.Description: The power struggle between Phupat and Mavin intensifies. Padcha reluctantly makes an offer that could save Shutter.

Episodes.Title: Rebellion
Episodes.Description: Phupat and Mavin experience a life-threatening incident. Meanwhile, a tightly kept secret shapes the future of the family company.

Episodes.Title: Master of the House
Episodes.Description: In this flashback episode, Kaimook starts her tenure serving the Thevasatitpaisarn family — and meets Mr. Roongroj for the first time.

Entries.Title: Doctor Climax
Entries.Description: In 1970s Thailand, a dermatologist unexpectedly starts a mass sexual awakening after becoming Doctor Climax, a taboo-defying newspaper columnist.

Episodes.Title: Masturbation
Episodes.Description: Desperate to rekindle its popularity, a newspaper considers running a raunchy new sex column and brings in a reserved dermatologist to write it.

Episodes.Title: Ejaculation
Episodes.Description: Sales swell as Doctor Climax's column launches, but the team is hounded by their boss — and the government. Nat finds himself drawn to a fiery co-worker.

Episodes.Title: Fetish
Episodes.Description: After the paper publishes a scandalous image, Dr. Pornchai steps up his mission to unmask the popular columnist, who is busy exploring his own sexuality.

Episodes.Title: Adulterer
Episodes.Description: Nat struggles to keep his emotions in check as he throws the cops off his trail. In a fit of self-doubt, Tukta tries to spice things up in the bedroom.

Episodes.Title: Impotence
Episodes.Description: Nat wrestles with his dueling personas as Linda goes soul-searching and Tukta breaks out of her shell. Meanwhile, Thong Tien has performance anxiety.

Episodes.Title: Perversion
Episodes.Description: The steamy questions keep coming as Nat's column draws in more readers. Later, he comes to realize the brutal real-life consequences of his advice.

Episodes.Title: Sadism Masochism
Episodes.Description: Nat comes to terms with his upbringing after a visit with his estranged dad. Plern pushes Thong Tien to test his limits at the sex club.

Episodes.Title: Abortion
Episodes.Description: Nat finds renewed purpose and makes a bold decision, but his advice comes back to haunt him. The team scrambles to evade the cops as they close in.

Entries.Title: My Stand-In
Entries.Description: Joe, a stuntman reincarnated into another's body after an accident, reconnects with Ming, who seeks answers about Joe's mysterious second chance at life.

Episodes.Title: Love at First Sight
Episodes.Description: Ming and Joe meet on a filming set and quickly begin to form a connection.

Episodes.Title: Ambiguous
Episodes.Description: Ming experiences some jealousy over Joe when his friend Sol returns from Korea.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Tong's reliance on his stand-in provides Joe with an unexpected opportunity to showcase his acting talents.

Episodes.Title: If Miracle Doesn't Come
Episodes.Description: Ming takes a severe action to help Tong not be replaced in his upcoming film.

Episodes.Title: Second Chance
Episodes.Description: Joe's mother's debt pushes him back into the world of stunt performance.

Episodes.Title: The Most Familiar Stranger
Episodes.Description: Sol and Ming both offer Joe a way out of his financial problems.

Episodes.Title: Hug
Episodes.Description: Joe begins his new arrangement with Ming, but jealousy quickly flairs during Sol's music video production.  As filming begins for Joe and Tong's next project, Ming makes a discovery about Joe and Tong's past.

Episodes.Title: When False is Taken for True, True Becomes False
Episodes.Description: As too many coincidences emerge, those close to Joe become suspicious about his real identity.

Episodes.Title: Among Thousands of People You Meet Those You’ve Met
Episodes.Description: Joe, Wut, Sol, and Ming investigate the discovery of Joe's remains.

Episodes.Title: Had I not seen the sun, I could have borne the shade
Episodes.Description: Tong is in desperate need of money but Ming is no longer willing to support him.

Episodes.Title: Love is Merely a Madness
Episodes.Description: Ming's father offers him an ultimatum regarding his relationship with Joe.

Episodes.Title: Love is composed of a single soul inhabiting two bodies.
Episodes.Description: Joe is faced with a final choice to return or start over.

Entries.Title: Petrichor
Entries.Description: Tul's first field visit after just moving to work was not smooth. To make matters worse, he had to work with Cherran, the forensic doctor in charge of the case. Both of them have very different personalities and attitudes, which made them not get along very well. Not to mention the social pressures they had to face when all the cases were in the public eye, which all affected the cases. However, when there were opportunities for them to work together more often, their relationship started to improve. However, the story was more complicated than expected when one day a murder occurred that was similar to the one that a serial killer had committed 18 years ago. Was this the work of the "Raindrop Killer" or was it a copycat of another killer?

Episodes.Title: Rusty Rain, The Murderer and Their First Encounter.
What They Knew, What They Missed, and What They Will Discover.
Episodes.Description: Lieutenant Tul and Dr. Cherran investigate a murder case similar to an unsolved one from 18 years ago. During their search, they find a body in a suitcase floating in a river, further complicating the mystery.

Episodes.Title: The Truth, The Hope and The Kiss
In the Name of Lust, Greed and Pride
Into Each Life, Some Rain Must Fall
Come In Out of The Rain

Entries.Title: High School Frenemy
Entries.Description: When two rival school campuses merge, former best friends Saint and Shin's lingering feud ignites a classroom war, forcing teachers to reconcile the stubborn pair and end the fighting.

Episodes.Title: Enemies
Episodes.Description: Saint and Shin, who were once good friends, are reunited when their troublesome classes are combined at school.

Episodes.Title: Class 2
Episodes.Description: Something in the past makes Shin refuse to accept Saint back as his friend. While in school management, Sung joins Jan as a dual homeroom teacher for the most problematic class; Class 2.

Episodes.Title: A Big War
Episodes.Description: Thep Burapha and Udon Phithak get into a big fight. Saint, who has just been elected as class president, must take responsibility for the chaos in order to avoid even bigger chaos between them.

Episodes.Title: Tsunami
Episodes.Description: Ken, Knot, and Nate team up with Jeng, the leader of Dragon Fang, to ambush Shin as revenge for the death of his brother, Jom. As they mistake Shin for Tsunami, the real Tsunami comes to the rescue.

Episodes.Title: Past Events
Episodes.Description: Saint the 'Tsunami' managed to save Shin, but Jeng would not stop until he destroyed Shin's life. Chadjen asks Saint to protect him, while Sung threatens Jeng to stop approaching his students.

Episodes.Title: Delinquent
Episodes.Description: Things in Siamwit School get worse when rumors that Shin killed someone and was dealing with a mafia gang reached the parents' association, putting him at risk of being expelled from school.

Episodes.Title: The Important Friend
Episodes.Description: Shin was almost expelled from school if Saint didn't help fix the misunderstanding, but it seemed not enough. Saint has to give up the most important thing in his life to bring Shin back to school.

Episodes.Title: Resignation
Episodes.Description: Saint decided to give up the most important thing for him which is a chance to make up with Shin by quitting school. Jan and Sung plan something to take Saint back to school and to make them reconcile.

Episodes.Title: Exam
Episodes.Description: A new bully unites the students of Class 2 against a shared problem.

Episodes.Title: For His Sake
Episodes.Description: After escaping yet another dangerous encounter, Shin finally starts to see Saint as his friend again.

Episodes.Title: Punishment
Episodes.Description: Trapped on the roof together, Saint and Shin are forced to confront their past and truly open up about what happened.

Episodes.Title: Just One Hug
Episodes.Description: The school's academic competitions put added stress on the students and changes the dynamics of several relationships, including Cable and his mother.

Episodes.Title: Cry together
Episodes.Description: Saint and Shin intervene with Ken before he causes more harm.

Episodes.Title: In the end, we are friends

Entries.Title: Your Sky
Entries.Description: Due to an unforeseen situation, a naive freshman and the campus’s popular senior agree to pretend to be a couple — but their fake deal begins to affect their real feelings.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Muenfah saves Teerak from an aggressive encounter with Oh at his birthday party.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Muenfah and Teerak agree to pretend to date each other in an attempt to deter Oh.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Teerak attend's Fah's soccer game to cheer him on.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Teerak and Muenfah joined the outdoor dinner with friends. Muenfah, unable to express his emotions, practiced cheesy lines to show his flirting skills but the outcome was hilarious. Meanwhile, Oh's plan to take back Teerak is in the works.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Joy and Type wanted to know if Teerak had been intimate or had done anything with Muenfah. Therefore, Teerak suggested to Muenfah that they should be comfortable with their physical contact. Will this be the start of their intimacy?

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: At an out-of-town trip to the beach with the gang, Muenfah and Teerak share their very first kiss. Meanwhile, something flirtatious is going on between Real and Hia. Will love blossom in this paradise?

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Since kissing Moonfa, Teerak feels uncertain about how to act around him. Meanwhile, chaos erupts at Moonfa’s shop, where he diffuses a customer brawl—only for Oh’s arrival to escalate tensions into an unexpected showdown.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Fah and Lee return from Hong Kong, giving Fah and Teerak a chance to clear their misunderstanding. Hia continues to give Real mixed messages and Real finally acts, shocking Hia. Lee and Klaijai meet at the river cafe and Klaijai seems open to Lee's flirtations.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Nerves strike as Teerak prepares to meet Muenfah's family.  Real and Hia both reach out to Muenfah for support when their relationship gets strained after their kiss.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Lee and Rak spend quality shopping time with Lee's Mom while Fah and their Dad are at a business meeting. Lee gets help from Glaijai on his art project and has an excuse to take him out for a meal as a thank you. Hia and Real continue their fight and Hia finally takes a step to apologize.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: Teerak nervously introduces Moonfa to his strict father, who reacts with fury when they reveal their relationship at his grandfather’s birthday party—throwing Moonfa out and demanding Teerak end things.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Teerak’s grandfather collapses, but Moonfa’s swift action saves him. After his recovery, Moonfa is invited to a family dinner, where Teerak’s father finally gives his blessing. To celebrate, Moonfa plans a special surprise.

Episodes.Title: Your Sky of Us 1
Episodes.Description: Moonfa and Teerak's relationship has been seamless. As Teerak’s birthday nears, Moonfa, determined to surprise him, secretly seeks his friends’ help. While Joy and the others grow suspicious, he carefully gathers clues without revealing his plan.

Episodes.Title: Your Sky of Us 2
Episodes.Description: While dining out, Moonfa and Teerak run into Teerak’s friends, In and No, and join them. Moonfa quickly picks up on In’s affection for Teerak, growing competitive. Tensions peak when In openly confesses his feelings.

Episodes.Title: Your Sky of Us 3
Episodes.Description: As graduation nears, Moonfa travels between Hong Kong and Thailand to assist his father. Meanwhile, Teerak secretly prepares a handmade gift to celebrate Moonfa’s achievement, while Moonfa plans an extravagant surprise for their anniversary.

Entries.Title: Bad Guy My Boss
Entries.Description: Pat secretly loves his strict boss, Elyes, but as their bond grows amid business battles, Elyes must change his ways to protect their evolving relationship.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: After five years of working for Elyes, Pat has gradually become comfortable with his job and taking charge of Elyes' personal schedule.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Pat is upset that Elyes is singling out Teeranai, and the two have a big fight about it.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Pat is feeling unwell due to his busy schedule, and Elyes is there to provide warmth and care.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Elyes has a reccuring dream; Pat interviews a new assistant and Elyes is not impressed.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Fei Long learns of Pat's resignation and tries to poach him, which angers Elyes.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Pat's ex-girlfriend suddenly appears, while Fei Long starts trying to control Run.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Run meets Kim in a bar; Paeng continues to court Pat and she doesn't give up easily.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Elyes secretly follows Paeng and Pat; Paeng tells Pat a story about Teeranai.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Elyes and Pat collect evidence of Thiti's betrayal.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Pat has an accident at a construction site, and Elyes takes care of him while investigating the accident.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: Teeranai goes all out for the sake of revenge, and Fei Long saves Run in the nick of time.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: As Elyes tries to get his company back on track, another misunderstanding arises when Pat sees Elyes with Kim.

Entries.Title: Don't Come Home
Entries.Description: A mother and her young daughter flee to their family's abandoned mansion but soon find themselves haunted by paranormal incidents that lead to the little girl's mysterious disappearance.

Episodes.Title: Varee
Episodes.Description: Fleeing from the city, Varee moves back into her childhood home with her 5-year-old daughter Min — only to encounter a foreboding presence there.

Episodes.Title: Fah
Episodes.Description: Capt. Fah investigates Min's sudden disappearance and uncovers strange details as she scours the town for clues.

Episodes.Title: The Girl Who Disappeared
Episodes.Description: The police conduct a thorough search for Min, while Varee and Capt. Fah discover an unusual room beneath the mansion.

Episodes.Title: Panida
Episodes.Description: Decades earlier, Varee's mother confronts a devastating tragedy. But her solution to her grief may bring unintended consequences.
Varee lands in trouble after vanishing mysteriously. Capt. Fah digs up a case from the past that might connect to the strange events at the mansion.

Episodes.Title: Don't Come Home
Episodes.Description: As Capt. Fah comes closer to cracking her case, Varee heads into a fateful family reunion that exposes a difficult truth.

Entries.Title: 4MINUTES
Entries.Description: A rich kid who can see four minutes ahead meets a kind surgical resident who just might change his future in more ways than one.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Great begins experiencing a strange phenomenon where he is seeing visions four minutes into the future. Meanwhile, Great's brother Korn is selected by his father to begin taking over a secretive "Investment" division of the family business.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: A conflict with Title lands Great back in the hospital, face to face with Tyme, who he has been having visions about.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: When Great confides in Tyme about his visions, Tyme offers to help him find someone to speak to and consults with his friend, Dr. Den.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Great and Tyme make a plan to save Nan. After three weeks away, Korn tries to reconnect with Tonkla.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Great and Tyme experience the fallout from their rescue of Nan. Fahsai pressures Korn into an uncomfortable situation.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Tyme secretly records his passionate affair with Great; Great has an accident while returning home alone.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Win discovers crucial evidence but is also targeted; Tyme accidentally finds his mother's diary.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Ton Kla and Korn are caught by Win while running away; Tyme is brooding after his grandmother's death.

Entries.Title: Love Sea
Entries.Description: Tongrak, a romance novelist, meets Mahasamut, a quirky southern man, during his travels. Their unexpected encounter leaves Tongrak captivated.

Episodes.Title: Love Begins With The Flick Of A Pen
Episodes.Description: Rak's friend, Connor, convinces him to take some time away while he writes his novel. However, Connor has arranged for an irritating man, Mahasamut, to look after Rak during his stay.

Episodes.Title: Echoes Across The Endless Blue
Episodes.Description: After a shared intimate moment, Rak finds inspiration to continue writing his novel.

Episodes.Title: Where The Sky Touches The Sea
Episodes.Description: Rak's time on the island is approaching its end. His family complicates his decision as he makes plans for the end of his stay.

Episodes.Title: From Seaside To Skyline
Episodes.Description: Unable to avoid his business back home, Rak returns to Bangkok with Mut by his side.

Episodes.Title: Supporting A Guy Is No Big Deal
Episodes.Description: Rak and Mut are faced with the arrival of Rak's sister, Prin, who immediately looks down on Mut.

Episodes.Title: Jealousy Is A Sign Of Love
Episodes.Description: Rak and Mut take care of Rak's niece when her grandfather starts lingering and making her scared.

Episodes.Title: The Role Of Drama Creators
Episodes.Description: Prin tries to create problems for Rak at the press conference for his upcoming series adaptation.

Episodes.Title: Return Of The Past
Episodes.Description: While the relationship between Tongrak and Mahasamut is going really well, a big obstacle emerges between them. When Jak, Tongrak's father, appeared, the past that was buried deep down in this author's heart has come back to him again. How can Mahasamut help Tongrak overcome his fear and go through this problem together?

Episodes.Title: The Chosen Path
Episodes.Description: Jak's attempts to hurt Mut put Rak into a position of making a painful choice.

Episodes.Title: Tongrak - Mahasamut
Episodes.Description: Feeling certain that Rak can't reciprocate his love, Mut returns to his home on the island.

Entries.Title: Century of Love
Entries.Description: To reunite with his long-dead love, a man uses a mystical secret to lengthen his life until her rebirth — only to learn her reincarnation is a young man.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Kept alive by a mystical stone, San searches for his dead lover's reincarnation. With months left to live, he finds himself drawn to a man named Wee.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: San takes Vee back to a place filled with past meanings, and he sees another side of Vee that others don't know.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: San is forced to propose to Vee, and Vee learns who San really is.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Vee moves into San's house, as he begins to search for the five-color stone.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: With Vee's life in peril, San confronts the enigmatic foe behind their troubles and soon finds himself in a rivalry with a familiar face from his past.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: San and Vee begin to develop a stable relationship, but strange visions gradually appear to San.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: San questions his spiritual connection to Vee after meeting a woman who resembles a figure from his past. Later, the five-colored stone goes missing

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: San tries hard to win back Vee and they have to work together to get the five-color stone back.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Vee is shot and San tries his best to save him, but his own health begins to deteriorate.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: With San's days numbered, Vee must find a way to save his beloved while still grieving.

Entries.Title: Pluto
Entries.Description:
Ai-oon is the disappointing twin of successful and beloved Ob-oom. They aren't close.

On Ob-oom's wedding night, she takes Ai-oon aside and makes a request of her. Ob-oon and her husband Paul will be going away for their honeymoon and she'll be leaving something important behind: a lover, May, she hasn't broken up with—and she wants Ai-oon to do it for her.

In the early morning following the wedding, Ai-oon learns that the newlyweds got into an accident. Paul has passed away and Ob-oom is in a coma. When Ai-oon decides to fullfil her sister's request, she's shocked to learn that May is both blind and a woman. She finds herself unprepared to complete the task.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Ai-oon's identical twin Ob-oom is in a tragic accident the night of her wedding. Ob-oom survives but is left in a coma and her husband doesn't make it. Helpless to do anything for her sister, Ai-oon resolves to do her the favour she'd refused hours earlier. This leads her to a woman she could not have prepared for her, a woman she finds herself drawn to even as she questions whether she could have been involved in Ob-oom's accident.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Jan, Ob-oom's best friend, tries to discover the truth behind the accident that happened to Ob-oom and her husband. Meanwhile, Ai-oon begins to get caught up in her attraction toward May.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Ai-oon realizes how small her position is in her grandmother's heart compared to her twin, as she also has to face complicated feelings between falling in love with May and realizing that May's love isn't for her, but for Ob-oom.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Ai-oon goes on a date with May.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Jealousy ensues when exes are visiting

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Aioon and May inspire each other to face their fears

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Ai and May go to a party. Heartbreak follows after some misunderstandings.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: May reminds Ai of their first real meeting.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Ai and May confirm their love. Oom wakes up from her coma.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Ai makes a heartbreaking decision. May fights for Ai. Oom is trapped between the two.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: Ai and May finally reveals all their shared secrets. Oom is heartbroken. Ai makes a sacrifice for her sister.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: A happy ending with a wedding.

Entries.Title: Blank
Entries.Description: Khun Nueng, M.L. Sipakorn, is a beautiful woman who's grown up under pressure from her grandmother. She's never been allowed to be herself, never met someone she could feel loved by or worthy of. Then she meets Anueng, cheerful and bright. Beneath the smiling face, however, there's a sadness hidden in her eyes. She makes her heart flutter like never before. Unfortunately, the sixteen years age difference, family and societal norms keep their love from flourishing.

Entries.Title: Fourever You
Entries.Description: Easter joins a northern Thai university to escape his past but reunites with his ex, Hill. Meanwhile, his roommate North faces chaos with his flirty creditor.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Ter met a new set of friends but also met his first love, Hill. He tried to avoid him but, later coaxed to join Hill and some Student union officers to dinner. Later, Hill posted a picture of Ter's hand and watch on his social media.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Ter called in sick so as not to attend the Union and avoid Hill. Hill learned about it and went to check on Ter but found out to be lying. Hill insisted on joining Ter outside so he brought him to the temple for an impromptu "date".

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Hill confessed that he wanted to be with Ter. In the restaurant, Ter and Hill encountered Johan, one of Hill's friends. Hill admitted that Ter is a "nong" that he is dating. Later, Hill posted another picture of them holding hands.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Ter helped as a Campus photographer. Hill got jealous when another male came close to Ter. Hill's friends Johan, Tonfah, and Arthit came to visit and tease Ter. After their mutual confession, Ter and Hill shared their first kiss.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Hill admitted publicly that he was trying to date Ter. Ter was disrespected and Hill defended him by hitting the miscreant. Ter, distressed, ran away from the scene. Meanwhile, Johan met North for the first time.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: There are still questions Ter needs answered, but in due time. Hill's friends come to help out at the student union. Ter and North start their job at the Japanese restaurant. Jo takes care of drunken North after he causes a bar fight.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Johan demanded North to pay the damage fees plus interest caused by the latter's drunkenness. North plans to find another job to pay for the damage. Johan agreed that he would cancel the interest only if North will do anything he said.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: North found another job at a bar. Johan was unhappy about it and forbade North to work there. North still pursued behind Johan's back and lied about it. Johan was upset when he found out and lamented about it to his close friends.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Johan picked up North at the dorm to sleep over at his place. Meanwhile, Ter met with Mind and was confronted why he abandoned Hill before. Later on, Ter wanted to learn about Hill's grandmother's condition, so he asked Hill's friends.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: North's ex wanted to reconcile but North rejected the idea. Later, he will be harassed at work, but Johan will be there to save him. Meanwhile, Hill and Ter have disclosed the truth and cleared up any misunderstandings about their separation.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: Johan saved North and they shared their first kiss, though they are not yet a couple. In the meantime, Duenao mistook North for Tiger's crush.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Hill had to return home unexpectedly for a family emergency. Ter's feelings of abandonment resurfaced. In the meantime, Johan continues to pursue North using his wealth, and North is not sure he's happy about it.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: North and P'Johan's bond is becoming closer and stronger. A glimpse of how Johan fell for North for the first time will be reminisced.

Episodes.Title: Episode 14
Episodes.Description: Johan has to leave for work in Boston for a few weeks. North has gifted him his Gear making him the official keeper of his heart. Ter and Hill's relationship has gotten so much sweeter with them showering each with love and affection.

Episodes.Title: Episode 15
Episodes.Description: North terribly misses Johan, who has left for Boston. As soon as Johan returns, they go out on a date. Unaware that they will be moving out of their dorm, Ter and North find themselves now living in their boyfriend's place.

Episodes.Title: Episode 16
Episodes.Description: The story unveils how Johan fell hard for North three years ago. Johan, learning about North's break-up and a study abroad has halted all his plans to pursue North until they met again in the University, thanks to Hill.

Episodes.Title: Episode 17
Episodes.Description: While the two couples Johan and North and Hill and Easter have gotten closer, Suea and Nao continue to plod along. Ter and North have noticed something is off between Tonfah and Typhoon. It's obvious that Typhoon leaves whenever Tonfah is around.

Entries.Title: Grudge: The Revolt of Gumiho
Entries.Description: For the sin of falling in love with a human, Gumiho gives birth to a daughter and enters the world of humans in order to protect her young, tender child. However, Yun Dusu, the man who chose her, is the father of a dying daughter. In order to obtain a liver to save his beloved, illness-stricken daughter, he is forced to do the unthinkable: to kill Yeoni, the daughter of Gumiho. Unaware of this fact, Gumiho opens her heart to Dusu, who protects her as if she is family, and once again falls in love with a human, ultimately suffering for it. And the one man who falls in love with Gumiho, a nonhuman with more humanity than any human, realizes he truly loves her and attempts to make their love work.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Gumiho has waited 10 years to marry a human and become one. On the night before the 10th year, Gumiho's husband breaks the promise and leaves her. However, Yeoni, the young daughter - half beast and half human - follows her father.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Gumiho and her daughter, who were about to leave Yun Dusu, are arrested by Governor Jo for digging the grave.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Yun Dusu wants to have Gumiho as the concubine. Gumiho tries to feed Yeoni the liver of a cow to have her half beast and half human daughter transform back into a human.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Jeonggyu reveals his feelings for Yeoni. The two children have their pretty, first kiss.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Gumiho finds out that there is a conspiracy to kill Yeoni, who is about to die by the hands of the gang at the request of Lady Yang.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Cho-ok's illness worsens as the day approaches, but Yun Dusu cannot kill Yeoni. He's conflicted as times goes by.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Finding out how Yeoni came to see him, Jeonggyu runs after her. Yun Dusu does everything he can to save the lives of Cho-ok and Yeoni.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Determined to sacrifice Yeoni to save Cho-ok, Yun Dusu gives a sword to Mansin. At the last moment however, Yeoni gets to escape.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: The mountain echoes with Yeoni's cry for her mother. Gumiho sheds the tears of blood, not being able to save her baby.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Yun Dusu is caught up with desire and pity as Gumiho looks at him with a bright smile. However, there is someone watching him in secret.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: After learning that she ate Yeoni's liver, Cho-ok begins to suffer from bizarre incidents. One day, Cho-ok is drawn to the tomb of Yeoni at the sound of bells beckoning her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Gumiho finds that Yeoni possessed Cho-ok. She tries to leave the town behind with her child. However.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: Yun Dusu, stabbed by Cho-ok possessed by Yeoni, loses his senses. Distraught, he blames Lady Yang.

Episodes.Title: Episode 14
Episodes.Description: Because Lady Yang's charms, Cho-ok's soul returns and Gumiho loses Yeoni once again.

Episodes.Title: Episode 15
Episodes.Description: Lady Yang is terrified by Gumiho who is closing in on to take the life of Cho-ok every moment. Lady Yang decides to visit Governor Jo to protect Cho-ok.

Episodes.Title: Episode 16
Episodes.Description: Yun Dusu finds out who Gumiho is and Gumiho also finds out the truth. She approaches him to kill him but Yun Dusu tries to strike back with Cheonwoo's life. However.

Entries.Title: Jing-Ju Cats
Entries.Description: Formally a paradise for all cats, the Cat Land Purpetua has been invaded and occupied by the dark lord AN, aided by his enslaved mutant monsters. The evil chaos reigns throughout the Purpetua and leads everything down to a wrong path. Only Jing-Ju Cats can overthrow An and resist the forces of evil chaos. A cat named LIL'PAI from the Clangour Town was once rescued by a Jing- Ju Cat at a very young age. He swore to be a great Jing-Ju Cat when he grows up. Once in a fight with monsters, he met the descendants of Jing- Ju Cats WU, ZAD and JEAN, and started to learn Kung Fu from their master Tang Ming and Granny GIN. The young LIL'PAI had neither blue blood nor outstanding talents. However, because of his amazing endeavor and the will of never giving up, he had succeeded through many trials and tribulations. LIL'PAI and his fellow Jing-Ju Cats rejoin forces to defeat the evil threat, reclaim their home and restore the peace in their land.

Entries.Title: Ju-On: Origins
Entries.Description: A paranormal researcher searches obsessively for a cursed home where something terrible happened to a mother and her child long ago.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: A young actress is troubled by mysterious footsteps in her apartment. Intrigued, paranormal researcher Yasuo asks her to record the sounds.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Things change for Kiyomi and her attackers after the incident at the abandoned house. Tetsuya's psychic mother reaches out to Haruka.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Kiyomi is now a mother, but her hard life takes a turn for the worse. Through it all, she continues to have visions of the woman in white.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: His obsessive search for the cursed house leads Yasuo to "M," an incarcerated child killer. A pregnant woman incurs her husband's wrath.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Yasuo realizes that he has a deep connection to the cursed house. After seeing her in a vision, he goes out in search of Kiyomi.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: A young couple expecting a child moves into the house. To get answers, Yasuo, Haruka and Michiko all pay a visit to the cursed home.
